 Why Choose Photok? * Hide photos and videos in a secure photo vault * Private encrypted gallery with AES-256 protection * Offline vault — your files stay on your device * Open source and transparent security, publicly reviewable on GitHub * Ad-free user experience * Built by an independent developer
 Vault Features * Import photos & videos from your gallery * Organize private media into albums inside your encrypted gallery * Export files anytime * Create and restore encrypted backups * Unlock your vault with fingerprint authentication * Share media directly to the vault * Option to hide the app icon * Automatically delete original files after import
 Privacy-Focused Design Photok is a private photo vault app designed for people who want real control over their private photos and videos. Encryption happens on your device. Privacy-friendly usage analytics are limited to improving the app and are never used for advertising or cross-app tracking.
 View the open-source project on GitHub. 
 Install Photok now and lock your private photos and videos away in a secure photo vault.

fdroid:com.urbandroid.dontkillmyapp.summary: The official DontKillMyApp app is here - make apps finally work properly even if
fdroid:com.urbandroid.dontkillmyapp.description:
The official DontKillMyApp app is here - make apps finally work properly even if you do not own a Pixel.
Helps you set up your phone background tasks so that your apps can finally work for YOU even when not looking at the screen right now.
See how is your phone doing and test different settings with DontKillMyApp benchmark.
Features:
• DKMA benchmark: Measure how aggressively is your phone killing background apps
• Guides: Get actionable steps to overcome most background process restrictions
• Make a change:️Help smartphones stay smart by sharing your benchmark report to dontkillmyapp.com
DontKillMyApp is a benchmark tool to see how well does your phone support background processing. You can measure before setting up your phone, then go through the setup guides and benchmark again to see how much has your phone been slacking in the background.
You can share your report through the app to the maintainers of the dontkillmyapp.com website who compile it and base the overall negative score on it.
How does the benchmark work? (Technical!)
The app starts a foreground service with a wake lock and schedules repetitive task on the main thread, a custom thread executor and schedules regular alarms (AlarmManager.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle). Then it calculates executed vs. expected. That's it!
For more details check the code. The app is open source available it https://github.com/urbandroid-team/dontkillmy-app
Special thanks to Doki (github.com/doubledotlabs/doki).

fdroid:org.bitsrc.schussel.name: Schussel
fdroid:org.bitsrc.schussel.summary: Bluetooth-triggered checklists that remind you of what you forgot.
fdroid:org.bitsrc.schussel.description:
Schussel is German for a scatterbrained, forgetful person: the one who drives off with the lights still on. This app is the antidote. You build a checklist, tie it to a Bluetooth device (typically your car), and when your phone connects, Schussel nags you only if you left something unticked.
You keep one or more checklists. Each list is linked to the Bluetooth device(s) that should trigger it. When your phone connects to a linked device:
* if everything on that list is ticked, you get silence;
* if anything is still unticked, you get a reminder naming exactly what you forgot.
It works even when the app is closed, and optionally sounds an alarm that repeats until you dismiss it.
Features:
* Optional daily reset (per list) — automatically untick everything at a time you choose, with a live "resets in HH:MM" countdown. Lists without a reset time keep their state.
* All data stays on your device — no network, no accounts, no analytics.
How it works:
1. Tap Add list and add the items you tend to forget.
2. Open the list's ⋮ → Settings and choose the Bluetooth device(s) that should trigger it. Optionally name the list, set a daily reset time, and enable alarm mode.
3. That's it. Next time your phone connects to that device with items left unticked, you get a reminder.
Requirements:
* Android 10 (API 29) or newer.
* A phone with Bluetooth, paired with the device you want to trigger on.
Privacy: Schussel stores everything locally and never sends data anywhere — no network, no accounts, no analytics.
Note on background reliability: manufacturer battery optimizers (Samsung, Xiaomi, Oppo, Huawei, …) can delay or drop the connect broadcast; exempting Schussel from battery optimization helps.

- INTERNET: to upload a file to a remote Docspell server
Docspell consumes your files, extracts and analyses the text and adds metadata automatically. It lets you manage your documents with minial effort. Check out the documentation .

fdroid:org.secuso.privacyfriendlyactivit.name: Pedometer (PFA)
fdroid:org.secuso.privacyfriendlyactivit.summary: (SECUSO) Counts your steps in the background. Customize daily goals.
fdroid:org.secuso.privacyfriendlyactivit.description:
Privacy Friendly Pedometer can count your steps in background, provides you an overview about your walked steps and allows you to define custom walking modes and notifications if the achievement of your daily step goal is in danger. The app requires minimal permissions (Run at startup and prevent phone from sleeping). It belongs to the Privacy Friendly Apps group developed by the research group SECUSO at Karlsruhe Intitute of Technology. More information can be found an secuso.org/pfa
Privacy Friendly Pedometer can count your daily walked steps while it runs in background. It gives you an overview about your walked steps, distance and about the calories you have burned while walking. You can add and choose different walking modes with different step lengths, such as walking or running, to improve the calculation of distance and calories.
In a special training mode you can track your training sessions. To each training session additional information, such as feeling or a description, can be added.
What makes Privacy Friendly Pedometer different from other pedometers?
1. Minimal amount of permissions:
* Run at startup: This permission is required to restart the step counting when your phone boots.
* prevent phone from sleeping: On some devices the processor falls asleep and prevents counting steps. With this permission the app can keep the processor awake while counting steps.
Most of Pedometer Apps in the Google Play Store require additional permissions. E.g. accessing the network or Internet which is mostly used to display advertisement. Some apps have access to GPS or telephony data.
2. No advertisement.
Many other free apps in the Google Play Store dazzle annoying advertising and also shortens battery life.

Ever type without looking at the screen and forget to switch your keyboard layout? blin catches it and fixes it right as you type, in any app on your Mac.
Typed "ghbdtn" instead of "привет"? blin fixes the word before you even finish it and switches the layout. Just keep typing.
FREE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
Every feature is available right away: no trials, no subscriptions, no paid tiers.
PRIVACY FIRST
Everything happens locally on your Mac. No internet, no accounts, no cloud. Only the last few typed words are held in memory, and nothing is ever sent anywhere. Password fields are never touched.
FIXES AS YOU TYPE
No need to hit space: the moment the layout is clearly wrong, the word is already fixed. A 680,000-word-form Russian and English dictionary and frequency models tell a layout slip from a real word, a name or a brand.
DOUBLE SHIFT
Press Shift twice and the last word or the whole phrase flips to the other layout. Select text and press double Shift to fix the selection. Works even with auto-correct turned off, if you prefer fixing things by hand.
YOUR OWN LANGUAGE KEY
Pick a handy key: right Command switches to English, right Option to Russian. Or record any shortcut you like. A quick tap changes the language, while Command-C and other shortcuts work as usual.
TYPOS AND CAPS
• Fixes common typos in Russian and English: "becuase" becomes "because". Only when it's sure, otherwise it leaves the word alone
• Fixes a sticky Shift: "HEllo" becomes "Hello"
• Changes the case of selected text via the Services menu
Each feature can be turned off in the Settings.
LEARNS FROM YOUR UNDOS
Fixed something by mistake? One Backspace undoes it. Undo the same word a few times and blin remembers it and leaves it alone. Learned words show up in your exceptions list.
WORKS OUT OF THE BOX
A ready-made exclusion list for terminals, IDEs, games and remote desktops. Abbreviations like CEO, currency codes, emails, links and usernames are left alone. And if something blocks blin, like an open password field in another app, it tells you in the menu.
DETAILS THAT MATTER
• Layout switcher right in the menu
• Lives in the menu bar as your active layout flag
• Handles trailing punctuation correctly
• Native Swift app for Apple Silicon and Intel, macOS 13 and later

flathub:io.github.bishop_333.omega-engin.name: OpenArena OmegA
flathub:io.github.bishop_333.omega-engin.description:
OpenArena OmegA is a modern and polished version of OpenArena, a free and open source first-person
 shooter game based heavily on the Quake III Arena-style deathmatch. Score frags to win the game
 using a balanced set of weapons each designed for different situations. Guns include a chaingun,
 rocket launcher, shotgun, and railgun.
 OpenArena OmegA's style of play is very fast and requires skill to be played successfully online.
 Gameplay modes include Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Tournament, Capture the Flag, Elimination,
 CTF Elimination, Last Man Standing, Double Domination and Possession.

flathub:org.flarerpg.Flare.name: Flare: Empyrean Campaign
flathub:org.flarerpg.Flare.description:
Flare is an open source, 2D action role playing game. Its gameplay can be likened to the games in the Diablo series.
 The Empyrean Campaign is a game made by the Flare team. The story begins with the player being exiled from their homeland of Empyrean, resulting in them embarking on a quest to regain entry. This journey takes the player through many regions, with plenty of side quests along the way.
 The player can choose between three different character classes with distinct strengths and skills. Each character class has unique powers to unlock and improve as they level up.
 Brute - A close-quarters fighter who utilizes swords, throwing-knives and other bladed weapons.
 Scout - A ranged weapon and trap specialist who primarily uses bows to defeat its foes.
 Adept - A spell caster who challenges enemies with fire, ice and lightning-based attacks.
 Players may find or buy different items to protect themselves from attacks or boost their stats. These include potions, scrolls, weapons, armor, and magical artifacts. Along with the normal equipment, there are enchanted, rare, and unique pieces of gear that provide extra bonuses.
 The Flare engine is licensed under GPL 3, whereas the Empyrean Campaign is licensed under CC-BY-SA 3.0. Both the engine and the game content are being actively developed, including new features, art, and content.

fedora-packages:geany-plugins/geany-plug.description: GeanyMacro is a plugin to provide user defined macros for Geany. It started out as part of the ConText feature parity plugin, which was split into individual plugins to better suit Geany's ethos of being as light as possible while allowing users to select which features they want to add to the core editor. The idea was taken from a Text Editor for Windows called ConText. This plugin alows you to record and use your own macros. Macros are sequences of actions that can then be repeated with a single key combination. So if you had dozens of lines where you wanted to delete the last 2 characters, you could simple start recording, press End, Backspace, Backspace, down line and then stop recording. Then simply trigger the macro and it would automaticaly edit the line and move to the next. You could then just repeatedly trigger the macro to do as many lines as you want.

Highlights: - GHC supports the entire Haskell 2010 language plus a wide variety of extensions. - GHC has particularly good support for concurrency and parallelism, including support for Software Transactional Memory (STM). - GHC generates fast code, particularly for concurrent programs. Take a look at GHC's performance on The Computer Language Benchmarks Game. - GHC works on several platforms including Windows, Mac, Linux, most varieties of Unix, and several different processor architectures. - GHC has extensive optimisation capabilities, including inter-module optimisation. - GHC compiles Haskell code either directly to native code or using LLVM as a back-end. GHC can also generate C code as an intermediate target for porting to new platforms. The interactive environment compiles Haskell to bytecode, and supports execution of mixed bytecode/compiled programs. - Profiling is supported, both by time/allocation and various kinds of heap profiling. - GHC comes with several libraries, and thousands more are available on Hackage.

fedora-packages:gsm/gsm.name: gsm

fedora-packages:gsm/gsm.description: Contains runtime shared libraries for libgsm, an implementation of the European GSM 06.10 provisional standard for full-rate speech transcoding, prI-ETS 300 036, which uses RPE/LTP (residual pulse excitation/long term prediction) coding at 13 kbit/s. GSM 06.10 compresses frames of 162 13-bit samples (8 kHz sampling rate, i.e. a frame rate of 50 Hz) into 260 bits; for compatibility with typical UNIX applications, our implementation turns frames of 160 16-bit linear samples into 33-byte frames (1650 Bytes/s). The quality of the algorithm is good enough for reliable speaker recognition; even music often survives transcoding in recognizable form (given the bandwidth limitations of 8 kHz sampling rate). The interfaces offered are a front end modelled after compress(1), and a library API. Compression and decompression run faster than realtime on most SPARCstations. The implementation has been verified against the ETSI standard test patterns.

Malware.AI Browser Security for Firefox
Avoid infections and other unwanted outcomes when you open suspicious documents or links to documents by checking it against Malware.AI . Malware.AI is a combination of intelligent image recognition mechanisms and self-learning neural networks to detect malware.
 Malware.AI Browser Security is an extension for Firefox that is accessible from the context menu. It instantly scans inline documents, downloaded documents and links to documents and blocks them if malicious content is found.
Features:
- Completely free
- Protects against links to malicious documents
- Protects against opening malicious inline documents
- Blocks downloading of malicious documents

firefox-addons:994865.description:
security.txt is a proposed web standard for communicating information about how to get in touch with a vendor regarding a security issue.
This extension is designed to make it faster for security researchers to get in touch with relevant vendors, by searching automatically for the /.well-known/security.txt file (and, as a fallback, the /security.txt file). It then collapses most of the information (save for the contact details), provides helpful warnings, and makes links clickable.

firefox-addons:2998612.name: DualView Translator
firefox-addons:2998612.summary: Dual-view translation: keeps the original visible with the translation right below. Google Translate / DeepL ready, with AI summaries on tap.
firefox-addons:2998612.description:
Tired of translation tools that swallow the original text? DualView Translator keeps it right there — the translation slides in right under the original, so you never lose the context.
Great for language learners, anyone reading foreign articles, or when you just want to double-check what a translator gave you.
■ What you get
 Dual-view display — the translation appears right under the original, no jumping back and forth
 8 translation modes — pick what fits: a single line, the whole page, just one element, with or without AI summary
 Auto-translation rules — set up your favorite sites once, and they get translated automatically when you open them
 Translation reset — undo per element with the × button, or wipe everything in one tap
 Two engines — Google Translate (free, no setup) or DeepL (sharper translations)
 AI summaries — Claude or Gemini sums up the translated content in 3–5 lines
 Tabbed popup — translation actions and settings, neatly separated
 Keyboard shortcuts — Ctrl+Shift+T, you know the drill
 11 UI languages — Japanese, English, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic
 Dark / Light theme — follows your OS, no fuss
■ The 8 translation modes
 Selection translation — highlight text, the panel pops up
 Full-page translation — translate the whole page in dual view
 Full-page + AI summary — translation plus a quick overview
 Element selection translation — click the element you care about
 Element selection + AI summary — same, but with a summary
 Right-click translation — select text, right-click, done
 Element translation (right-click) — right-click on a block to translate it
 Element translation + AI summary — same, with a summary
■ The translation bar
Open a foreign-language page and a small bar pops up at the top. One click to "Translate", one click to "Translate & Summarize". That's it.
■ Auto-translation rules
Got a site you read in another language every day? Register it once with a URL pattern, narrow down to the part you care about with a CSS selector (or just click the element to generate one), and you're set. Works with SPAs, dynamic content, even webmail.
■ Dynamic content
Lazy-loaded sections, infinite scroll — they get picked up and translated as they appear. No need to keep clicking "translate" again.
■ Translation engines
 Google Translate : free, no API key, ready to roll (default)
 DeepL : better quality. Free tier covers 500,000 characters/month
■ AI summaries
Hook up Claude (Anthropic) or Gemini (Google) and get a quick 3–5 line summary of the page you just translated. API key needed for these.
■ Privacy, plain and simple
 Your text only goes to the translation engine you picked
 API keys live in your browser's local storage, nowhere else
 No history collection, no tracking, no data goes to us

firefox-addons:3075997.name: NodeLane Comics - AI Manga Translator & Reader
firefox-addons:3075997.summary: Translate web and local comics with AI. Translate images or selected areas, compare originals, and save reading progress.
firefox-addons:3075997.description:
NodeLane Comics brings AI translation and comic reading together in your browser.
 Translate on the page: Stay on the original website, translate a single image from the context menu, or select an area to translate.
 Compare originals: Switch back anytime, or view originals and translations side by side in the built-in reader.
 Read in one place: Open local comic files and comics from supported websites, Google Drive, and OPDS libraries. Reading progress is saved automatically.
 Read offline: Cache supported content in advance and continue reading without a connection.
 Choose your service: Use official AI translation or connect a locally hosted translation service.
Reading local originals requires no sign-in. Official translation requires internet access and sign-in, with a free allowance and optional paid plans. Locally hosted translation requires no NodeLane account.
Official translation uploads images or selected areas for processing. Originals are deleted after tasks complete, fail, or are canceled; valid translations are retained for recovery and reuse. See the privacy policy.
Website compatibility depends on page structure and access permissions; import is limited to supported sites. AI translations may contain errors. Only process content you have the right to use.
Website: https://comics.nodelane.net/ 
Optional usage analytics is off by default. Only with your consent, limited usage and technical data and a random device identifier are sent through NodeLane to Google Analytics 4. You can disable it without affecting reading or translation.
Privacy policy: https://comics.nodelane.net/en/privacy/ 
Terms of service: https://comics.nodelane.net/en/terms/

firefox-addons:2735820.summary: Adds download buttons to TikTok videos!
firefox-addons:2735820.description:
This addon adds download buttons to the desktop version of TikTok.
This addon will attempt to download videos without the watermark. But it also has support for downloading videos with the watermark in cases where the user wants to download them with or where the API with non-watermarked videos are being fetched, isn't working.

firefox-addons:829451.name: Download with Download Accelerator Plus
firefox-addons:829451.summary: when activated, interrupts the built-in download manager to direct links to DAP
firefox-addons:829451.description:
This extension offers integration with "Download Accelerator Plus (DAP)". By default the toolbar icon is disabled. In this mode, downloads are handled by the internal download manager. Once the extension is enabled from the toolbar button (when the icon is colorful), then an observer is installed. This observer monitors new downloads and sends requests to Download Accelerator Plus (DAP) and cancels the built-in downloads. It is also possible to use right-click over links option to send links to Download Accelerator Plus (DAP) without installing the download observer.
Notes:
1. For the extension to work you need to have Download Accelerator Plus (DAP) installed; http://www.speedbit.com/ 
2. For the extension to be able to start Download Accelerator Plus (DAP) and communicate with it, a small native client is required. This native client can be found at https://github.com/belaviyo/native-client/releases . You will get the instruction on how to install this native client when extension tries to communicate for the first time.
For more info please visit:
 https://webextension.org/listing/download-with.html?from=dap

firefox-addons:279910.name: Stealthy
firefox-addons:279910.summary: Access blocked websites with a click of a button.
firefox-addons:279910.description:
Stealthy opens the websites that are blocked where you are. One click, and sites see one of our cities instead of yours. One more click and you're back to normal.
Free
• One location, picked for you. Nothing to set up, and no account.
• A fair speed limit: fine for browsing and for video up to HD.
• On Stealthy's own network.
• Normal windows, or private windows only.
• Sites you choose can skip Stealthy.
Stealthy PRO
• Choose your country: United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Japan, Australia or Canada.
• PRO's United Kingdom location is tested with BBC iPlayer, ITVX, Channel 4 and Channel 5, with a heads-up in the panel when one of them needs it.
• Ads and trackers blocked on PRO locations, on by default, with one switch. Ads that are part of a video, like YouTube's, still play.
• Servers only members use. No data caps and no speed limit.
• One login for the extension and our VPN for phones and apps (set up with the free OpenVPN Connect app). Sign in once. Changing country doesn't ask again.
• 3-day free trial and a 30-day money-back guarantee.
The panel shows what sites see: your city and provider when Stealthy is off, and our location when it's on.
Stealthy started during the Arab Spring, so people could read and speak freely. That's still the job. Opening blocked sites since 2012.
 https://stealthy.co/ 
Questions: https://stealthy.co/help/

AliScore sets our affiliate code on product links before you click them. When you open a product page and no affiliate code at all is on file, it opens that product once more through our affiliate link, at most once every 30 minutes, so the page loads a second time. When another extension's code is on file it never does that; it may offer a "secure my link" button instead, which does nothing unless you press it. firefox-addons:3065385.summary: Reveal passwords and copy values from password and select fields with one click. 100% local.
firefox-addons:3065385.description:
ViewPassword adds a small toolbar next to password and select fields so you can copy their current value with one click. Password fields also include a show/hide control.
The select-value feature can be enabled or disabled independently from the extension popup. Keyboard shortcuts are available for copying a focused supported field and revealing or hiding a focused password.
Everything runs locally in Firefox. ViewPassword has no servers, analytics, advertising, tracking, or network requests. Field values are only accessed when the user invokes an action and are never stored or transmitted.

firefox-addons:961538.name: PasswordGen
firefox-addons:961538.summary: Password generator - allows use the same password for every domain but generated password will be for every domain unique and different.
firefox-addons:961538.description:
PasswordGen is a single purpose password generator extension for Firefox browser. By user pre-specified preferences, this tool will generate same password on same domains every time. However on the other domains, generated password will be every time different. Users no longer have to remember all their different passwords what they use. With this extension users have and use only one master password for all domains and PasswordGen will generate unique password on every domain for them.
 You can use and manage different rules of generating for every domain individually
 Rules of generating for every domain could be stored
 All preferences and rules of generating could be exported or imported
 NO PASSWORDS ARE STORED 
 How to use it: 
1. Go to some sign-in page
2. Click to G icon on toolbar
3. Enter your master password
4. PasswordGen will generate domain-specific password
5. Generated password will be automatically stored in clipboard
6. Paste your generated password into password field on page you want to sign-in
Note:
The intent of this addon is to use and remember single password for all domains.
 It is recommended to use strong and long enough master passphrase.

bluejetty:00065092:ios.description:
We’ve built a different kind of high street bank. A bank where you can walk in without an appointment and walk out with a working account, debit card and all. A bank that tells you exactly what you’re getting, in language that actually makes sense. A bank that puts you first.
Now, wherever you are and whatever you’re doing you can manage your Personal and Business accounts with our mobile app.
Features
- Insights on your accounts and transactions
- Send International Payments
- A handy spending summary shows you where you’re spending your cash
- View transactions which are still being processed
- Temporarily block and permanently cancel your debit and credit cards
- Make payments to new and existing payees and transfer money in between your accounts
- Login with Apple TouchID
- View and cancel your Direct Debits and standing orders.
- Share your account details through WhatsApp, email and messages to easily receive payments from friends and family
- Create and edit Standing Orders
- Open Instant Access Savings Accounts
Registration - Getting Started
Whether you’re an existing or new Metro Bank customer it’s simple to get started.
- If you’re registered for online and telephone banking, you’ll need your 12 digit customer number, 8 digit security number and your password
- If you’re not registered for either, you’ll need your 12 digit customer number and the details of the card you used most recently or your Magic Word.
Metro Bank’s mobile app is available for Personal customers and also Business customers if they’re using Business Internet Banking only.
Standard data charges from your mobile service provider may apply.
Getting help
If you experience any issues downloading or registering the Metro Bank mobile app, please visit us in store or call us on 0345 08 08 500 or email us on ios-feedback@metrobank.plc.uk.

bluejetty:00119958:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch into your FAVORITE teacher of Cantonese.
◆ The most essential words and phrases of the language, each with native speaker audio. 
◆ Master your accent with the Speech Studio. Simply record yourself saying a phrase and then hear your voice next to the teacher’s. You’ll be AMAZED how quickly your foreign accent melts away.
◆ All audio is downloaded to the device and accessible even in airplane mode or without expensive international roaming fees.
◆ Nemo is NOT BUILT AROUND LESSONS at all. It is meant to be picked up and put down throughout the day, whenever you have a few minutes to spare.
◆ Builds a foundation of Cantonese empowering you to speak CONFIDENTLY in EVERYDAY CONVERSATIONS. 
◆ NO PRIOR KNOWLEDGE of Cantonese required.
Nemo® is specially DESIGNED to tap the remarkable power of your mobile device, and your brain, to their fullest. 
PERSONALIZED FOR YOU
Nemo is your personal trainer, tracking your PROGRESS across every single word and phrase.
◆ Practice Cantonese the way you'll use it. Nemo is fully customizable.
◆ Nemo immerses you in the sounds of Cantonese so you naturally speak with ease.
◆ Dive into WHAT YOU WANT to learn at any time.
◆ You control which words to practice – skip words you don’t want to learn or already know.
◆ Turn on Review Mode to study what you practiced earlier in the day to BOOST your memory retention.
◆ Hear English descriptions of all words, in a flashcard format.
◆ Quiz your mastery of the vocabulary.
◆ Nemo introduces words to you progressively to develop familiarity and reviews them at the right moment so they enter your LONG TERM MEMORY.
TARGET THE MOST COMMON WORDS
Maximize your time investment by targeting the most basic and high frequency words of the language.
Upgrade to the complete version to:
◆ Get off the beaten path or find comfort with DIRECTIONS, TRAVEL and HOTEL phrases.
◆ Decode menus with the most common FOOD words.
◆ Shop and find bargains like an insider with must-know SHOPPING phrases.
◆ Learn words useful for your time in hong kong.
◆ Build your proficiency with the most important verbs and SENTENCE BUILDING BLOCKS in Cantonese.
◆ Spark new friendships with COMPLIMENTS and CONVERSATION STARTERS.
Use your new skills to make friends, impress old friends, bring smiles to children, get out of jams, experience new things, speak confidently, and make your travel and cultural experience more rich and fulfilling.
Download this FREE app now!
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00148820:android.summary:
Video Downloader for Facebook helps you save videos and Stories for offline viewing.
With the built-in browser, you can easily browse content, watch videos, and download them directly to your device. You can also paste a video link to quic
bluejetty:00148820:android.description:
Video Downloader for Facebook helps you save videos and Stories for offline viewing.
With the built-in browser, you can easily browse content, watch videos, and download them directly to your device. You can also paste a video link to quickly open the page inside the app’s browser and download the video from there.
Once downloaded, your favorite videos and Stories can be watched anytime without an internet connection or shared with friends. This lightweight downloader provides a smooth and clean experience with an easy-to-use interface.
How to use:
Method 1 – Built-in Browser
Tap Browse Facebook for mobile.
Log in and browse your feed or pages as usual.
Tap the video or Story you want to save.
Select your preferred quality (HD or SD) and tap the download button.
Method 2 – Open Video Link
Copy a video link from your browser or app.
Paste the link into the app.
The page will open in the in-app browser.
Tap the download button to save the video.
Features:
Story Saving: Save Stories directly to your gallery.
Quality Options: Choose between SD or HD video quality.
Direct Link Support: Open video links inside the built-in browser.
Offline Viewing: Watch videos anytime with the built-in player.
Clean Experience: Simple interface with minimal interruptions.
Fast & Secure: Lightweight design optimized for performance.
Important Notes:
This app is NOT affiliated with or endorsed by any official social media network.
Any unauthorized re-uploading or downloading of contents is the sole responsibility of the user.
Please respect the intellectual property rights and terms of service of the content owners.

Discover how people build, live, and play in skyscrapers. Go up and down, through every floor, and underground. Spark a blackout, fix a pipe, or clog the toilets. Test your building’s engineering when dinosaurs invade, lightning strikes, or the earth quakes. Find out what keeps skyscrapers standing tall and people happy in them all. 
Skyscrapers is No. 7 in Tinybop’s Explorer’s Library series. Apps in this series have been downloaded more than 5 million times and have won Best of the App Store, App Store Editors’ Choice, Parents’ Choice, and Children's Technology Review Editor’s Choice awards. 
FEATURES
+ Explore skyscrapers from the ground, up to the roof. 
+ Design each building’s facade and top with different colors, spires, clock towers, and more.
+ Investigate a building’s structure, from the foundation to the frame.
+ See how soil affects a building’s stability.
+ Test and observe your building’s engineering in lightning storms, earthquakes, and high winds. 
+ Move people throughout the building: up and down in elevators, through bathrooms, and in and out of rooms.
+ Investigate the utilities: water, electricity, and safety features.
+ Save the building in emergencies! Put out fires and repair water breaks. 
+ Turn lights on and off. Cause a blackout!
FREE handbook
Our expert-reviewed handbook is full of facts, interaction hints, and discussion questions to support learning in this app, in the classroom or at home. Download in your app or at: http://tinybop.com/handbooks. 
Privacy policy 
We take your and your child’s privacy very seriously. We do not collect or share personal information about your child, nor do we allow any third-party advertising. 
When the camera, microphone, and other services are used within an app, your information is neither collected nor distributed outside of the app.
Read our complete privacy policy at tinybop.com. 
Tinybop, Inc. is a Brooklyn-based studio of designers, engineers, and artists. We make toys for tomorrow. We’re all over the internet.
Visit us: www.tinybop.com
Follow us: twitter.com/tinybop
Like us: facebook.com/tinybop
Peek behind the scenes: instagram.com/tinybop
We love hearing your stories! If you have ideas, or something isn’t working as you expect it to, please contact us: hi@tinybop.com.
Psst! It's not Tiny Bop, or Tiny Bob, or Tiny Pop. It's Tinybop.

bluejetty:00177915:ios.description:
Do you enjoy the excitement of classic word games? Are you a real puzzle game master? DOWNLOAD Word Connect for FREE! Start your word story and enjoy the brainstorm NOW! 
Simply swipe the letter blocks and build words to collect coins! Find the clues to solve the crossword puzzles! DOWNLOAD Word Connect NOW to begin training your brain and become a word master!
It’s time to uncover hidden words and build as many words as possible! Come  and begin your word story!
What makes Word Connect so special?
• Addictive gameplay! Simply swipe the letters to build words! 
• Tons of words! 30000+ levels in total await!
• Different Modes! You can choose from normal mode, crossword mode and the daily challenge! Come and solve different puzzles!
• Daily Bonuses! Log in every day to play exciting daily puzzles to collect big bonuses!
• Alternative Themes! Up to 11 cool themes for you to choose from!
• Vintage Style! Our wooden block graphics will bring back nostalgic childhood memories!
• Hidden Bonus! Extra words are waiting to be discovered! Find extra words to collect bigger bonuses!
• Play Together! Ask your family members and friends for help to solve the puzzles and send coins to each other on Facebook!
• No time limits! You can use your time wisely to find new words at your own pace!
• Level List! Want to check previous levels? Go back to the Level List and play again!
• Offline Mode! No wifi? Don’t worry, you can play Word Connect anytime, anywhere even without a network connection!
• Multiple Choices! Supported on iPhone, iPad and iPod.
• You will get free coins and Ads Free experience in exchange for safely using some of your device’s resources (WiFi and very limited cellular data), and only in a manner that will not substantially affect the device's operation. You may turn this off from the settings menu. Please see our Terms of Use: https://zenjoy-res.tuanguwen.com/privacy/term.html and the SDK Privacy Policy at https://bright-sdk.com/privacy-policy for further information.
Word Connect is an app designed to train your brain and learn new words all while having a great time. Share the fun with your family & friends and enjoy Word Connect together!
This year, we are going to have a series of updates to bring you a better game experience! Get ready for the new era of Word Connect and enjoy your own word story!
- Subscribe to the Word Club Weekly Membership to unlock the following features in the game:
1) You will instantly receive 1700 coins, 2 Hint boosters and 2 Multiple Hint boosters after your first subscription!
2) Collect 150 coins when you log in daily
3) Daily Bonus X2
4) 50% off on Booster
5) Unlock access to all themes
6) Ad-free in-game experience
- The Word Club Weekly Membership costs $6.99 per week to unlock the above features.
- Payment will be charged to the applicable iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. The prices may vary depending on country. The actual money charged may also be converted into your local currency based on the iTunes Account policy.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period and you must verify the cost of the renewal.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free pass period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
- Tap “Restore” to restore your weekly membership on your new device!
For more information, please refer to:
Privacy Policy: https//zenjoy-res.tuanguwen.com/privacy/zenjoy.html
Terms of Use: https://zenjoy-res.tuanguwen.com/privacy/term.html

bluejetty:00124391:ios.description:
Are you in need of having a work life balance, be able to screen unwanted calls and texts and allow yourself to run an efficient business and have a separate line for friends and family without two interfering with one another? Having a second line to separate work and personal life can help but it comes with carrier fees, contracts and head ache that no-one wants to deal with.
You don't have to go through that. WA Business allows you to conveniently access WhatsApp Web and Telegram Web through a dedicated browser interface, without the need for separate devices. You can easily manage your messaging needs through web versions of popular messenger apps.
Download it now and enjoy the benefits that come with additional accounts.
Your device have to connected to internet and you must scan qr code in device to use WA Business.
WA Business is an UNOFFICIAL tool for WhatsApp and Telegram Messenger. WA Business is developed by an independent developer. WhatsApp feature is loaded from the web version, published in http://web.whatsapp.com and Telegram feature is loaded from the web version, published in https://web.telegram.org/
Features:
-> Open WhatsApp and Telegram Accounts
-> Access daily quotes. (You see 10 new quotes every 24 hours.)
You can see and share beautiful different quotes everyday.
-> Access daily status messages. (You see 10 new status messages every 24 hours.)
You can see and share beautiful different status messages everyday.
Note: Quotes and status messages pages update everyday but if you want you can refresh both pages!
Premium Features (Subscription Required):
Whatsapp Web and Telegram Web.
Daily Quotes: Get 10 new inspirational quotes every 24 hours.
Daily Status Messages: View and share 10 new status messages every 24 hours.
Automatic daily updates and manual refresh options.
These features require an active paid subscription.
Subscription prices:
Weekly Subscription -> $2.99/weekly
Monthly Subscription -> $9.99/monthly
Yearly Subscription -> $29.99/yearly
Also users can use 3 days free trial subscription.
Users can manage subscriptions from "Account Settings".
Term of service : "http://bgnet.com.tr/WT/TermAndConditions.html"
Privacy policy : "http://bgnet.com.tr/WT/PrivacyPolicy.html"

bluejetty:00161898:ios.description:
Designed for real, meaningful connections.
tantan helps you meet new people through genuine interactions and shared interests — beyond endless swiping and surface-level chats. Whether you’re dating or expanding your social circle, tantan makes connecting feel natural and intentional.
We prioritise nearby users to make it easier to turn online matches into real-world connections. Discover people around you, start conversations, and build relationships that extend beyond the screen. Go beyond one-on-one matching with Tribe, tantan’s community feature for like-minded individuals. Join interest-based groups, connect over shared passions, and meet people through common experiences — not just profiles. Stay in the know with smart discovery tools. See who’s checking out your profile with the Visitors feature, and understand your visibility within the app.
Discover connections that feel right
Creating your profile on tantan is easy and expressive. Answer prompts, share about yourself, and upload photos that reflect who you really are. Slide Right to Like, Slide Left to Pass. When interest is mutual, it’s a match. Our double opt-in system ensures every connection starts with genuine interest on both sides.
Premium features to help you match smarter
Upgrade to Premium to unlock tools designed to save time and boost your chances:
• See Who Likes You — know who’s interested before you swipe
• Instant Match — connect immediately without waiting
• Visitors — revisit profiles that have viewed you
Global reach, local connections
Connect with singles from around the world while staying grounded locally. With instant chat and built-in translation, tantan makes it easy to communicate across cultures and build meaningful connections — wherever they are.
tantan. Date better.
We value your feedback! Drop us an email if you have any questions, comments or concerns via: hi@thetantanapp.com
Terms of Use: https://www.thetantanapp.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.thetantanapp.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00100540:ios.name: Jigmagic Solitaire - Puzzle
bluejetty:00100540:ios.summary:
► PICTURE PERFECT
Everyone loves a good jigsaw puzzle, but what about all the mess of cleaning it up, keeping track of the pieces, and finding the time to sit down and actually enjoy it? Enter Jigmagic Solitaire, your new favorite photo pu
bluejetty:00100540:ios.description:
► PICTURE PERFECT
Everyone loves a good jigsaw puzzle, but what about all the mess of cleaning it up, keeping track of the pieces, and finding the time to sit down and actually enjoy it? Enter Jigmagic Solitaire, your new favorite photo puzzle. Thousands of exciting picture puzzles are just waiting for you to solve them, and extra hard daily puzzles will give your brain an extra treat.
► GET JIGGY WITH IT
When you find yourself in need of some relaxation, just open up the game and feel your stress melt away as you merge puzzle solitaire cards and reveal works of art, picture after picture. Simple rules, fun pictures, and a low-stakes environment mean you’ll always feel better after playing, and the pick-me-up from winning will keep your mood high.
We think you’ll love:
● Thousands of levels – You’ll never run out of jigsaw puzzles to solve even if you’re an avid player thanks to the almost endless levels! On top of that there are daily puzzles available that are extra hard, to really get you in that picture-solving mood and test how good your logical and spatial skills really are.
● Maximum relaxation – Leave your stress at the door! Calming music, no crazy flashing lights or effects, and most importantly, no timer. The goal here is to let your brain chill out for a bit while you rearrange the jigsaw pieces, revealing stunning art and cute animals.
● From easy to hard – In addition to the extra hard daily puzzles, the regular levels range from basic 9-piece pictures on up. Each level is different, meaning your brain always has something to look forward to. Test your logic by trying to solve a level in as few moves as possible or have fun trying out different combos at your own pace – the choice is yours.
● Perfect for all ages – Thanks to the relaxing effect players both young and old can enjoy putting their logic skills to the test as they reveal each photo puzzle. The mechanics are simple enough for small fingers to handle, and even adults will appreciate how straightforward game play is. Your brain will also appreciate the break but don’t worry, you’ll still need your logical thinking skills at the ready if you want to make it past some of the levels.
► MERGE YOUR WAY TOWARDS RELAXATION
Enjoy all the fun of classic jigsaw puzzles with none of the real life clutter to deal with, thanks to Jigmagic Solitaire! Here you can spend hours and hours of relaxing fun, using your logic skills to merge photo pieces and reveal amazing pictures. With tons of levels to explore, daily challenges to take on, and a stress-free play environment, your brain is sure to thank you for this game. Download today and get your jigsaw puzzle game on!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00147287:ios.description:
Prosper: Your Self-Care Companion
Welcome to Prosper: your all-in-one companion for building healthier habits, understanding your emotions, and supporting you on your self-care journey. Whether you want to track your mood, create healthier routines, or simply have a safe place to reflect, Prosper gives you the tools and support to care for your mental and emotional well-being in a simple, approachable way.
Build Healthy Habits & Goals
Create habits tailored to your life and set reminders to help you stay on track. Each completed habit builds your streak, helping you stay motivated and turn small actions into lasting routines.
Reflect & Process Your Emotions
Use Prosper’s mood journal to check in with yourself throughout the day. Track how you’re feeling, explore what may be influencing your emotions, and use guided journaling to work through stress, anxiety, or challenging emotions in a healthy way.
See Your Progress Over Time
Understand how daily influences like sleep, exercise, social time, and more affect your mood. With Prosper’s calendar view, you can spot patterns, build self-awareness, and learn what helps you feel your best.
While Prosper is not a replacement for therapy, your insights can be shared with a clinician if you choose, making it easier to track progress and support conversations between sessions.
Discover Wellness Tools & Resources
Discover a growing library of meditations, breathing techniques, and self-care activities designed to help you manage everyday stress and anxiety. Within the resource tab, CBT-based exercises and tools provide support for healthier thinking and emotional balance.
Engage in Our Supportive Community
In Prosper’s community space, users can share encouragement, express how they’re feeling, and find support in a welcoming, judgment-free environment.
What Prosper Users Are Saying
“For someone who has multiple mental illnesses that makes every day tasks difficult some days, this has been a big help. I’m instilling better healthy habits & I really appreciate all the different animations, mediation videos, etc. it has been a change for the positive & I recommend this app to anyone who wants a lil more balance within their day & want to create more positive habits.”
“The Prosper app has been a valuable tool for our students' social-emotional learning and overall wellness this year. It offers a structured and engaging platform for students to reflect on their emotions, set personal goals, and practice mindfulness techniques regularly.” 
Privacy & Safety
Prosper was created with the mission to make self-care simple, private, and accessible. Your data is encrypted and secure, and your identity is always kept private.
Your well-being is our top priority. Prosper includes a Support Space that can recognize negative trends and offer crisis resources, including helplines and support options when they may be needed most.

bluejetty:00122366:ios.description:
Love Zapya but hate the ads? Upgrade to ZapyaPro today and you will never be interrupted by advertisements on the app again! Just like Zapya, ZapyaPro allows you to transfer files seamlessly from one platform to another in an instant! Not only is it easy to use, but it also includes a multitude of features. File sharing has never been simpler! With ZapyaPro, you can:
• Share multiple files using QR codes 
• Transfer files to a group of people 
• Chat offline with up to five devices
• Move the phone log and photos from your old device to your new one
• Collect, view, and share GIFs
• And much, much more! 
ZapyaPro can transfer massive files between devices with up to 10MB/second or up to 260 pictures in a minute - without the use cellular data. No matter what format or size of the file, you can instantly share it across multiple platforms with ZapyaPro. You can also use PeerCam, which allows you to control the camera of a connected device with peer permission to view and take photos remotely.Another feature of ZapyaPro is that you can select and lock important files that you want to protect into a hidden folder. This allows for you to protect your privacy awhile sharing with others. ZapyaPro helps you complete your daily tasks without risking your security.
sclaimer: This app may use your location even when it isn’t open, which can decrease device battery life.

bluejetty:00015809:ios.description:
TOPIK – 한국어능력시험 is a free Korean language learning app for self-study and TOPIK exam preparation.
It supports all TOPIK levels (TOPIK I and TOPIK II) and allows learners to practice Listening, Reading, Writing, Vocabulary, and Grammar in one complete app.
Whether you are preparing for your first TOPIK test or aiming for a higher score, TOPIK – 한국어능력시험 provides real exam-style practice, essential vocabulary, and clear grammar explanations.
Key Features
+ TOPIK Practice & Tests
 - Full coverage of TOPIK I and TOPIK II
 - Includes old TOPIK test formats (before the 34th TOPIK)
 - Practice Listening, Reading, Writing, Vocabulary, and Grammar
 - Question formats based on real TOPIK exams
+ Flashcard
+ Vocabulary & Grammar
 - 6,000+ essential TOPIK vocabulary words
 - Focus on common and frequently tested words
 - Interactive vocabulary quizzes with instant feedback
 - Detailed grammar references with examples and common mistakes
+ Study Modes
 - Practice Mode for step-by-step learning
 - Test Mode to simulate the real TOPIK exam
 - Test history analysis to help track progress
+ Extra Tools
 - Friendly and easy-to-use interface
 - Multi-language support: English & Khmer
 - TOPIK exam schedule, fees, and test center information
Who is this app for?
 - TOPIK I (Beginner) learners
 - TOPIK II (Intermediate & Advanced) learners
 - Students preparing for Korean study, work, or visa purposes
 - Self-learners studying Korean anytime, anywhere

In the quiet embrace of a forgotten town, where memories intertw
bluejetty:00135816:ios.description:
Have you ever wondered if there is a town that doesn't have at least one coffee shop?? Take your chance of merging ingredients, matching mansion to enrich or leave the town!! 
In the quiet embrace of a forgotten town, where memories intertwine with whispers of the past, lies the enigmatic tale of "Merge Passion." The merge cooking game begins with Jane, a soul burdened by the weight of loss and heartbreak. 
Just a year ago, she bid farewell to her parents, their absence casting a shadow that seemed insurmountable. As if fate wished to test her further, a cherished five-year relationship crumbled, leaving her adrift in a sea of emotions. Seeking solace, she returns to her hometown, a place that once overflowed with cherished memories and warm laughter. She loves cooking and in her hometown, there is no cafeteria. 
"Merge Passion" invites you to step into Jane's shoes, to experience her transformation firsthand. Engage in a captivating merge cooking game, where you'll blend ingredients, rejuvenate spaces, and touch the lives of the town's inhabitants. Delve into the mysteries, merge flavors with many ingredients to craft the perfect blend, and immerse yourself in an extraordinary tale of ambition and mystery.
With every sip of her determination, Jane's journey unfolds. The old and dilapidated house, chosen to be her canvas of creation, becomes a metaphor for her own merge cafe life. A mysterious man appeared. Is he a guardian angel, a ghost from the past, or perhaps something darker? Her uncertainty fuels the intrigue, casting an air of suspense that shrouds her progress. Yet, Jane's challenges are not confined to the realm of the supernatural or the atmosphere of the coffee shop. The town's inhabitants, fueled by prejudice and skepticism, cast their wary eyes upon her. 
Here's all you get when play this match puzzle game!
Captivating plot
Unlock new characters
Decipher the hidden secrets and mystery match
Drag and merge anything
Decorate and recover the childhood home
Discover all the exotic merge items
Merge food to level up your dish and cooking skill
Suitable puzzle games for kids and matching games for adults
Engage in an enchanting merge cooking game that challenges you to restore the town's café culture. Combine various ingredients, transform dilapidated spaces, and serve townsfolk to win their hearts with one of the coolest merge games. Uncover the enigmatic helper's story as you navigate through Jane's quest to overcome adversity and skepticism. Delve into a tale of mystery and personal growth while savoring the joy of and culinary creation. Are you ready to merge your passions and change lives? 
The journey awaits.

bluejetty:00155326:ios.description:
Stockgrowers Bank of Ashland is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Stockgrowers Bank of Ashland:
- Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
- Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
- Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
- Transfer money between your accounts
- Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
- Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
- View and save your monthly statements
- Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Stockgrowers Bank of Ashland app, you must be enrolled as a Stockgrowers Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00032561:ios.developer: Islam, Quran, Muslim & Prayer Apps (Pvt) Ltd
bluejetty:00032561:ios.summary: Muslim & Quran app has been developed with one single-minded goal, to help you become a better Muslim! It's the most advanced and comprehensive Islamic mobile application that is geared towards providing all the requisite Islamic informatio
bluejetty:00032561:ios.description:
Muslim & Quran app has been developed with one single-minded goal, to help you become a better Muslim! It's the most advanced and comprehensive Islamic mobile application that is geared towards providing all the requisite Islamic information and knowledge as and when required. Get accurate prayer timings along with Adhan notification alerts. Maintain your personal prayer record. Read the Holy Quran with translation, tafseer & audio recitation. Explore Hadith books, or Duas & Azkar from Hisnul Muslim. View accurate Ramadan times & track your fasting progress. Calculate your due Zakat. Find Qibla direction, or discover mosques, halal restaurants & other Islamic places in your vicinity. View Hijri calendar & track Islamic events. View Live Mecca & Medina channels, or listen to daily Haramain Salah recordings. Plus many more features!
KEY FEATURES
• Accurate Prayer Timings calculated for your exact geographical location.
• Prayer notifications with several beautiful Adhans (Call to Prayer) to choose from. Listen to Full Adhan in the lock screen notification, even when the app is not running. 
• Complete Holy Quran, with multilingual phonetic transliterations, translations & audio recitations. Beautiful original scripts & fonts including IndoPak, Uthmanic, & Mushaf al-Madina. You can pinch to zoom & change font size!
• 'Follow Reciter' feature to listen to the Quranic recitation followed by the Translation recitation.
• 60+ most authentic Quran Tafseers from renowned scholars in English, Arabic & Urdu languages.
• Word-by-Word meaning, Quranic Grammar, Syntax & Morphology for each Quran verse.
• Fully searchable Quran, allowing you to search for any text in the Arabic Quran, Transliteration, Translation or Surah name. You can also Bookmark, Share, Annotate or Copy any verse.
• 'Hadith Collection' section, containing complete Arabic Hadiths text & their translations for the 13 major Hadith books. Hadith section also supports searching.
• 'Prayer Log' feature, which allows you to keep a record of your offered & missed prayers. View your prayers' detailed statistics & graphs!
• 'Salah Guide' section, containing detailed guidance with pictorial illustrations & audio recordings for offering the Salah / Prayer. Very useful for kids, new converts to Islam, or anyone looking to perfect their Namaz knowledge.
• Use Qibla Compass to orient your device towards Qibla & find its exact direction.
• Access Prayer times & Daily Verse directly from the pull down Today Widget menu.
• Locate Islamic places in your vicinity on a zoomable map, which also shows you the exact route & distance from your current location. You can look for Mosques, Halal Restaurants, Islamic Schools, Stores etc.
• View accurate Ramadan Suhoor & Iftar timings. Use Fasting Tracker to keep a track of your missed & observed fasts. Print hi-resolution Ramadan timetable.
• View Duas & Azkar from Hisnul Muslim, on every topic & for every occasion
• 99 Names of ALLAH (Asma al Husna), with meanings & a beautiful audio recitation
• Accurate Zakat Calculator, with history for all your previous calculations
• Islamic Hijri Calendar, marked with Islamic Events. Convert between any Gregorian Calendar date & Islamic date
• Exclusive Greetings Cards for Ramadan, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha & Hajj
• "Hajj & Umrah Guide" section, with detailed instructions for Hajj & Umrah performance. Also contains a comprehensive guide about the historical places to visit in Mecca & Medina
• View Live stream from Mecca & Medina Haramain (The Holy Ka'bah & The Prophet's Mosque). You can also view Haramain Salah recordings from any past date
• Digital Tasbih with sound & vibration options.
• Listen to Quran recitation & Adhans, even when the app is in the background
• Watch Face Complication in the accompanying Watch app. View the time remaining in the next Salah with a quick glance at your watch
Terms of use: https://muslimandquran.com/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://muslimandquran.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00068709:ios.description:
VesselFinder is the world’s most popular and trusted vessel tracking and marine traffic app, delivering real-time information on ship positions and movements worldwide. Using a powerful network of satellites, roaming and terrestrial AIS receivers, VesselFinder provides accurate and up-to-date insight into global maritime activity.
Designed for maritime professionals, shipping enthusiasts, and anyone interested in live ship tracking, VesselFinder offers a fast, intuitive, and reliable way to explore vessel traffic across the globe.
VesselFinder key features:
 • Real-time tracking of over 300,000 vessels daily using global AIS data
 • Vessel movement history with track visualization
 • Predicted routes and ETAs to next port
 • Comprehensive vessel particulars, including technical specifications, and cargo capacity information
 • Contact details for the owning company, manager, ISM manager, and more
 • Port Calls per vessel, showing arrival times and duration of stay
 • Port Calls per port, with detailed lists of expected vessels, arrivals, departures, and ships currently in port
 • My Fleet – save and monitor favorite vessels, synchronized with your VesselFinder account
 • My Views – save preferred map views for fast and easy navigation
 • Ship Photos contributed by the VesselFinder user community
 • Multiple map styles: Simple, Detailed, Dark, Satellite, and Nautical
 • Weather overlays, including wind, waves, and temperature
 • See your location feature for instant orientation
 • Distance measurement tool for route and range estimation
Vessel visibility depends on AIS signal availability, with near-shore coverage consistent with the data provided on VesselFinder.com. If a vessel is outside our terrestrial AIS coverage area, its last reported position will be displayed and updated as soon as new data is received. Extended real-time coverage via satellite and roaming AIS sources is available through a subscription. While we make every effort to ensure accuracy, the completeness of the information cannot be guaranteed.
Connect with VesselFinder
 • Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/vesselfinder
 • Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/vesselfinder

bluejetty:00031725:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00031725:ios.description:
The Divine Office App is an opportunity for you to participate in the recitation of the Liturgy of the Hours, an ancient and meditative collection of psalms, hymns and scripture that represent the public prayer of the Christian community.
If you are unable to pray in community, but love the contentment of praying with others, a praised feature of the Divine Office App lets you view locations where other Christians around the world are simultaneously praying with you.
This version is the official prayer book of the Catholic Church, however, it is suitable for all Christian faith traditions. It contains the official text and audio of daily prayers from the Liturgy of the Hours of the Roman Catholic Church (Breviary) and has been approved for use in the United States by USCCB.
The Divine Office App is designed to make praying more convenient, enjoyable, and simple enough for anyone to use. It automatically downloads the appropriate prayers for each office, every day of the year, including Solemnities, Feasts, and Memorials.
When St. Paul advises us in 1 Thessalonians 5:17 to “pray without ceasing,” he intends more than simply bowing our heads and speaking to God on a regular basis. He means for us to adopt an ongoing attitude of prayer that is a way of life and a constant intercession for the salvation of all mankind.
As the mystical body of Christ prays in unison, it fulfills what Paul advises as Christian conduct, that believers at once pray for the good of themselves, their neighbors, and the world. In this way, prayers become liturgy, a way to fulfill our divine calling and a practical approach for addressing the suffering of the world.

bluejetty:00061521:ios.description:

PDF Export brings scanning, editing, converting, signing, compressing, chat exporting and 30+ PDF tools together in one simple app. Scan a document, edit a PDF, convert Office files, export WhatsApp chats, add signatures, protect files and much more — right from your iPhone or iPad.
Pay once. No subscription. No monthly fee.
# ANNOTATE & EDIT PDFs
- Work directly inside your PDF.
- Highlight important text, draw, add comments, annotate pages and edit PDF content without recreating the entire document.
# SCAN ANY DOCUMENT
- Turn your iPhone or iPad into a portable document scanner.
- Scan receipts, contracts, notes, forms and multi-page documents in seconds. Automatic edge detection helps create clean, professional-looking PDFs without needing a separate scanner.
# OCR — EXTRACT TEXT FROM IMAGES
- Need text from a photo, scanned document or handwritten document?
- OCR can recognize and extract text from images, scanned documents, handwritten documents and image-based PDFs.
- Copy, search or work with the extracted text without typing everything again.
# MERGE & SPLIT PDFs
- Organize PDF pages exactly the way you need.
- Combine multiple PDF files into a single document, or split a large PDF into smaller files. Great for reports, invoices, forms and document collections.
# SIGN DOCUMENTS
- Sign PDFs directly on your iPhone or iPad.
- No printing, signing and scanning again. Simply open your document, add your signature and share the completed PDF.
# CONVERT FILES TO PDF — OR BACK AGAIN
- Quickly convert documents between popular formats:
- Word to PDF
- PDF to Word
- Excel to PDF
- PDF to Excel
- PowerPoint to PDF
- PDF to PowerPoint
- JPG to PDF
- PDF to JPG
- Web Page to PDF
- PDF to Text
- PDF to HTML
- PDF to RTF
Keep your documents in the format you actually need.
# COMPRESS PDFs
- Large PDF taking too much space?
- Reduce PDF file size to make documents easier to email, share, upload or store while maintaining useful document quality.
# PROTECT, UNLOCK & WATERMARK PDFs
- Keep sensitive documents protected.
- Add password protection to PDFs, unlock files you have permission to access, and add watermarks to help protect your work.
# CHAT TO PDF
- Export WhatsApp chats as beautifully formatted PDFs or interactive HTML.
- Choose from WhatsApp-style or clean document layouts, personalize with themes, search messages, jump between months, and view shared media easily.
- Perfect for saving memories, keeping records, and archiving important conversations.
# ROTATE & CROP PDF PAGES
- Fix poorly oriented or badly cropped pages in seconds.
- Rotate pages with a tap, remove unwanted margins, or crop multiple pages to create a cleaner document.
# MORE PDF TOOLS
- PDF Export includes many additional tools for everyday document work, including:
- Blank PDF editor
- Web to PDF
- Clipboard to PDF
- Add page numbers
- Extract images
- Repair PDFs
- Transcribe content
- Send fax
And more

Import your own file for a trial, or use the built-in sample document anytime to explore available features.
# WHY PDF EXPORT?
- 30+ PDF tools in one app
- One-time purchase — no subscription
- Scan, edit, sign and convert documents
- Export WhatsApp chats to PDF or interactive HTML
- Designed for iPhone and iPad
- Many document tools work offline
- Simple tools for everyday PDF tasks

bluejetty:00037798:ios.description:
Feels - Where online communities turn into real-life connections.
Feels is the ONLY social & dating app made for people under 30 — built to help a digital-native generation reconnect in real life through shared interests and meaningful experiences.
You have exactly 628 weeks between 18 and 30.
Feels exists to help you live them fully — with the right people, in the real world.
More Than Dating. A Community That Meets IRL.
Feels is a platform where communities form online and connect in real life.
Whether you’re looking for a crush, new friends, or people who share your passions, Feels brings together those who actually have things in common — and want to experience life, not just swipe through it.
No more endless back-and-forth with people you don’t vibe with.
Feels helps you connect through shared interests, values, and real-life experiences.
Built for a Generation That Wants More Than Swipes
Feels is designed like a social network, not a traditional dating app.
Profiles are story-based, expressive, and human — so connections feel natural, positive, and real.
Discover people through their stories, not just selfies
React to content to start conversations effortlessly
Express your personality, your vibe, and your interests
Meet people who actually get you
Online connection is just the start — real life is the goal.
Why Feels?
Strictly Under 30
Connect with people who share your generation, your codes, and your energy.
Interest-Based Connections
Match through passions, values, and what truly matters to you.
Story-First Profiles
Browse creative, authentic profiles that go beyond appearances.
Natural Conversations
React to stories and slide into conversations — no pressure, no awkward openers.
From Online to IRL
A space designed to turn digital connections into real-world experiences.
Features That Feel Right
Creative Profiles – Share photos, videos, captions, and stories
Find Your People – Filter by interests and lifestyle
Effortless Chatting – Start conversations by reacting to content
Full Control – Go invisible, end chats anytime, total privacy
Make Every Week Count
Feels was created to rebuild real-life connection for the digital-native generation.
Unexpected encounters, shared moments, unforgettable experiences — all start here.
Whether it’s your next crush, your next friend group, or your next adventure,
Feels is where connection feels real again.
Subscription & Pricing
Feels is free to download and use, and our core features will always remain free.
If you want to get the most out of Feels, optional premium features are available.

bluejetty:00185076:ios.description:
Nail Designs is the perfect app to make your nails look stunning. 
If you ever thought that having plain red nails just looks extremely boring, then this app is exactly for you! 
Nail Designs is the only app of its kind on the App Store and features many nail design tutorials. The designs are specifically chosen so that they can be done by yourself at home in 10 min. Every tutorial consists of step-by-step instructions and high resolution images, each targeted specifically at someone, who is not an expert. And what if you really like a particular design? Mark it as one of your favorites so it's always at your fingertips.
Every tutorial also includes a list of required nail polish colors, so that you never find yourself half through the tutorial and suddenly realise that you are missing that yellow nail polish, that you just emptied last week. And when you're done, you can take a photo of the finished design and upload it to your social networks so that everyone knows, what an artist you are.
The designs are divided into packs of 20 manicure designs and each has its own theme, so there is something to be found for everyone; from casual to crazy party designs and from black elegant styles to cute and adorable ones. First pack is available for free, while each additional pack can be purchased inside the app.
Features: 
- Many great designs to make your nails look stunning
- All designs can be made at home by yourself
- Step-by-step tutorials with images
- Take a photo of your finished design and share it
- Beauty center - everything a woman needs
- Every design comes with a list of required colors
Subscription Plans:
Pro: $9.99 monthly
Please note that prices may vary by location. Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://kragerlabs.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00014216:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00014216:ios.description:
Every trade has a winner and a loser, and the difference is rarely luck. It is who knew more, sooner.
FundSpec is how you become the trader who knew. AI models that call the market as it moves and show you their full record. A clear read on what a company is actually worth. A live view of where the big money is going before the crowd catches on.
AI THAT SHOWS ITS WORK
Our models publish their calls. They also publish their record. Every trade they have ever made is right there to inspect, wins and losses alike. No black box, no marketing claims, just a track record you can judge for yourself.
Then build your own. Pick a ticker you actually trade and tell FundSpec how you like to trade it. Choose a supervised learning model that calls the next move when the evidence stands out, or a reinforcement learning agent that decides when to enter, how long to hold and when to exit, with every result shown after the trading cost you set. Watch it train, see how it performed on data it never saw, then follow every position from entry to exit. No code. No math degree.
SEE WHAT EVERYONE ELSE MISSES
Big money leaves footprints in the options market. FundSpec follows the premium, surfaces the boldest bets of the day, and tells you the moment something unusual starts happening in a name you care about.
KNOW WHAT IT IS WORTH
Price is what the market says. Value is something else entirely. FundSpec gives you a daily read on the gap between them, then hands you the tools to run the numbers yourself and find out whether you agree.
MOMENTUM THAT FITS HOW YOU TRADE
A long term investor and a day trader should never get the same signal. Tell FundSpec how you trade and every read adjusts to your horizon.
STOCKS AND ETFs, EQUALLY SERIOUS
Most apps treat ETFs as an afterthought. Here they get the same analysis, the same signals and the same attention your stocks get.
TORN BETWEEN TICKERS?
Put them side by side. A shared chart, a shared table: performance, volatility, analyst targets, fair value and momentum, stocks and ETFs alike. Arguments end quickly when the evidence sits together.
THE REST OF YOUR DESK
Charting you can actually think in. Earnings, filings and analyst views without the hunt. Alerts that reach you the moment your level prints. A screener that gets out of your way.
BUILT FOR PEOPLE WHO ARE SERIOUS
Day traders. Swing traders. Value investors. Anyone who is tired of guessing.
Download FundSpec and stop trading blind.

listings.description:
Every trade has a winner and a loser, and the difference is rarely luck. It is who knew more, sooner.

FundSpec is how you become the trader who knew. AI models that call the market as it moves and show you their full record. A clear read on what a company is actually worth. A live view of where the big money is going before the crowd catches on.

AI THAT SHOWS ITS WORK

Our models publish their calls. They also publish their record. Every trade they have ever made is right there to inspect, wins and losses alike. No black box, no marketing claims, just a track record you can judge for yourself.

Then build your own. Pick a ticker you actually trade and tell FundSpec how you like to trade it. Choose a supervised learning model that calls the next move when the evidence stands out, or a reinforcement learning agent that decides when to enter, how long to hold and when to exit, with every result shown after the trading cost you set. Watch it train, see how it performed on data it never saw, then follow every position from entry to exit. No code. No math degree.

SEE WHAT EVERYONE ELSE MISSES

Big money leaves footprints in the options market. FundSpec follows the premium, surfaces the boldest bets of the day, and tells you the moment something unusual starts happening in a name you care about.

KNOW WHAT IT IS WORTH

Price is what the market says. Value is something else entirely. FundSpec gives you a daily read on the gap between them, then hands you the tools to run the numbers yourself and find out whether you agree.

MOMENTUM THAT FITS HOW YOU TRADE

A long term investor and a day trader should never get the same signal. Tell FundSpec how you trade and every read adjusts to your horizon.

STOCKS AND ETFs, EQUALLY SERIOUS

Most apps treat ETFs as an afterthought. Here they get the same analysis, the same signals and the same attention your stocks get.

TORN BETWEEN TICKERS?

Put them side by side. A shared chart, a shared table: performance, volatility, analyst targets, fair value and momentum, stocks and ETFs alike. Arguments end quickly when the evidence sits together.

THE REST OF YOUR DESK

Charting you can actually think in. Earnings, filings and analyst views without the hunt. Alerts that reach you the moment your level prints. A screener that gets out of your way.

BUILT FOR PEOPLE WHO ARE SERIOUS

Day traders. Swing traders. Value investors. Anyone who is tired of guessing.

Download FundSpec and stop trading blind.

We're committed to continually improving your experience in our app. Please let us know how we're doing by leaving a review in the App Store.
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
