bluejetty:00187252:ios.name: Scan-IT to Office
bluejetty:00187252:ios.summary: Scan-IT to Office is the efficient solution for mobile data acquisition with real-time connectivity to arbitrary PC or Mac applications and databases accessible via ODBC - with enhanced support for Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, Google Sh
bluejetty:00187252:ios.description:
Scan-IT to Office is the efficient solution for mobile data acquisition with real-time connectivity to arbitrary PC or Mac applications and databases accessible via ODBC - with enhanced support for Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, Google Sheets and Google Chrome. Captured data like barcodes, NFC tags, texts, numbers, locations or images is transferred via cloud services immediately to targets on your desktop computer. This works regardless of your location, even across different offices, facilities or countries. 
VERSATILE
Data is captured into clearly structured input forms on the smartphone or tablet. Users can select from predefined standard forms or create their own input forms if required.
EASY TO USE
Scan-IT to Office is ready to use in just a few steps: This data acquisition app is paired with the corresponding target by scanning a QR code. Now the data transfer works on its own: captured bar-codes, pictures, manual inputs, timestamps or location data are automatically sent to their destination.
FEATURES
• Mobile data collection app for smartphones and tablets
• Captures barcodes, NFC tags, images, timestamps, texts, location data and numbers
• Real-time data transfer to any PC or Mac application
• Store data in any database accessible via ODBC
• Insert data directly into Word, Excel, Google Sheets or Google Chrome
• Custom and predefined data acquisition forms
• End-to-end encryption guarantees maximum privacy & security
• Works worldwide, independent of time and place
• For single and multi-user scenarios
FREE DEMO
The app is available as free trial, a paid subscription unlocks all functions. Without a subscription, the app replaces collected data at random intervals with a demo text and/or a notification is displayed.
IMPORTANT NOTICE
To use this app, you need to install the additionally required Scan-IT to Office software (available for free) on your desktop computer: 
Scan-IT to Office Tools enable arbitrary PC or Mac applications and ODBC-databases to receive data collected with the app. Download the tools using this link: https://www.tec-it.com/stodownload 
Scan-IT to Office Add-Ins are dedicated Add-Ins for Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets and Google Chrome, which provide optimized and seamless data acquisition functionality. Install the desired Add-In directly in the host application or from the respective store:
• Microsoft Word / Microsoft Excel: https://appsource.microsoft.com/product/office/wa104381026 
• Google Sheets: https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/scan-it-to-office/oeggkbdldochacapfbnbmhghcfinaehh
• Google Chrome: https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/scan-it-to-office/ijemakhbbjajapbmdonhjmfkkcpliafp
FREE SUPPORT
In case of questions, please contact us at support@tec-it.com (E-Mail), TECITSupport (Skype) or visit https://www.tec-it.com/sto. 
SUBSCRIPTION POLICY
• Monthly, quarterly or yearly subscriptions are available
• When buying a subscription, payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
• You may also manage your subscriptions via App Store.
• Auto-renewal of a subscription may be turned off by going to your Account Settings in the App Store after purchase.
Terms of use and privacy: https://www.tec-it.com/download/PDF/TEC-IT_AGB_EN.pdf

bluejetty:00119301:ios.description:
The POS system preferred by serious retailers in over 100 countries.
Lightspeed retail POS is more than just a cash register. It’s a smart, scalable, and dependable point of sale system with built-in features like inventory management, detailed reporting, customer management, multi-location compatibility, employee management, and so much more, all on the cloud. 
The app centralizes everything your staff needs based on their role. Now, cashiers have their own intuitive profile tab in POS-mode that lets them focus on sales, and managers can toggle into the Manager tab to perform daily tasks. This split-functionality minimizes distractions and potential for mistakes and requires almost no training time for new employees.
Complete transactions and instantly access your sales data from anywhere, so you can spend more time focusing on what’s most important—your customers.
Process sales
- Complete transactions from anywhere in your store to reduce wait times.
- Snap pictures of new stock straight from the sales screen.
- Perform on-the-spot returns, accept gift cards, apply discounts and sell on-account.
- Send receipts via email.
- Process special orders, layaways, and work orders.
- Provide customers with a clear view of the items in their transaction, including taxes and discounts, with a Customer Facing Display (CFD).
Manage inventory and collections
- Sell bundled, serialized or unique items.
- Easily manage multiple variations of the same product.
- Import up to 1,000 new items in 1 click.
- Combine purchasing, transferring, and multiple vendors into one master order.
Track data and performance
- Track sales and inventory with reports on profits and fluctuations over time.
- Identify opportunities for growth and improvement.
- Detect trends in your stock movement and learn what your top performers are.
- Get a clear view of your customers’ needs and shopping habits.
Take care of customers
- Track sales history to improve your shopping experience and personalize your sales approach.
- Record relevant customer information to better inform your targeting decisions.
- Collect emails to send current promotions and new arrival notifications to customers.
Provide employees with easy-to-use tools
- Empower your staff with an intuitive, easy-to-learn app. Minimal training required.
- Simplify your cashiers’ workflow with one screen for everything they need to open and close their day.
- Create a simple and logical workflow tailored to your business.
- Track sales and performance reports per employee.
- Limit access to refunds, products, pricing, or sales data with custom user permissions.
Supercharge the POS with integrations
- Sell in-store and online with Lightspeed’s fully integrated eCommerce solution, Lightspeed eCom.
- Drive more repeat business and build long-term customer relationships with Lightspeed Loyalty.
- Build your perfect system with over 250 integration options.
Add hardware and payment processing
- Lightspeed Payments: 2.6% + 10¢ - one rate per transaction for swipe, dip or tap—no matter the card type, no matter the sale amount.
- Connect external hardware like Bluetooth barcode scanners, receipt printers, cash drawers and customer-facing displays.
- Reduce credit card fraud with EMV-compatible hardware.
Get free onboarding and 24/7 support
- Receive a personalized one-on-one onboarding session with a Retail POS expert.
- Call or chat with support agents 24/7.

Bike and sporting goods
Fashion and apparel
Jewelry and accessories
Pets and supplies
Home decor
Electronics
Toys and hobbies
Fitness and supplements
Health and beauty
Questions?
Ask our friendly retail POS pros. Call 1-855-251-0441 or go to our support center for helpful tips, training videos, and system updates.

bluejetty:00131965:ios.name: Voice Recorder Super
bluejetty:00131965:ios.summary:
Voice Recorder turns your iPhone into a recorder you can trust for lectures, meetings, interviews, ideas and everyday notes. Tap once to start, and keep recording while the screen is off or while you use another app.
There is no time limit
bluejetty:00131965:ios.description:
Voice Recorder turns your iPhone into a recorder you can trust for lectures, meetings, interviews, ideas and everyday notes. Tap once to start, and keep recording while the screen is off or while you use another app.
There is no time limit — a take on your iPhone can run as long as your free storage allows.
KEY FEATURES:
‣ One-Tap Recording: Start from the app, a Home Screen widget, Control Center, Siri or a long press on the app icon. Pause and resume whenever you need to.
‣ Apple Watch: Record straight from your wrist when your iPhone is not with you, and control a running take from the watch. What you record moves over to your iPhone library.
‣ Lock Screen and Dynamic Island: Watch the timer and stop the take without unlocking your iPhone.
‣ Markers: Flag the important moment while you are still recording, then jump straight back to it when you listen.
‣ Transcribe to Text: Turn a recording into text on your device, tap any word to jump to that second, and share the transcript as text or as an .srt subtitle file.
‣ Summary: Get the key points of a long recording in a few lines.
‣ Trim and Edit: Cut what you do not need, split a long take into pieces, or merge several recordings into one. Nothing is overwritten until you save.
‣ Voice Effects: Play a recording back as a different voice, with 16 presets or your own settings.
‣ A Player Built for Listening: Waveform, skip, repeat and shuffle, plus full control from the Lock Screen and your headphones.
‣ Find Anything: Search by name, sort by date, name or length, and open a recording straight from Spotlight.
‣ iCloud Sync: Keep your recordings on every iPhone and iPad you own.
‣ App Lock: Keep your recordings behind Face ID, Touch ID or a passcode.
‣ Import Your Own Audio: Bring in files from the Files app, another app or your computer — mp3, wav, m4a and more — then trim, transcribe and share them like your own recordings.
‣ Share and Export: Send a recording to Messages, Mail, WhatsApp or any app that takes audio files, or export it as MP3, WAV, AIFF or FLAC.
‣ Made for Everyone: Full VoiceOver support, Dynamic Type, and a layout built for iPad as well as iPhone.
PRIVACY:
Your recordings stay on your device and in your own iCloud. Transcription runs on the iPhone itself.
Terms of Use: https://techsmart.bio/voicerecorder/terms-of-use.html
Privacy Policy: https://techsmart.bio/voicerecorder/privacy-policy.html

Whether you want to lose or even gain some weight, it is always difficult to control and track
bluejetty:00145232:ios.description:
yourWeight (formerly called WeightWatch) is a free, very simple to use tracker to monitor your weight and determine your body mass index (BMI).
Whether you want to lose or even gain some weight, it is always difficult to control and track your progress while understanding what is working for you. Maybe you have a goal to achieve, or maybe you just want to get back to your normal weight after pregnancy? The right tool can really help you achieve your ideal weight.
This app is a simple and user-friendly weight tracker and BMI (Body Mass Index) calculator app which allows you to enter your daily measurements.
In order to provide you with an application that is both ideal and simple, we have included the following main functions:
• Record your weight once a day, quick & easy. 
• Set your weight goal to track the remaining weight you need to lose or gain to get you motivated.
• Tracks your overall weight loss/gains based on your starting weight.
• Set a weekly goal so you can track your progress by milestones.
• Calculate your Body Mass Index (BMI) based on your profile to help you determine if your current weight is normal, underweight, or overweight.
• Trend graphs for quick visualization of your progress.
• Apple Watch support to quickly glance or record your weight progress.
• Reminds you to enter your weight so you can never lose track of your progress.
• Apple Health integration to import and sync weight entries seamlessly.
• Apple Health integration to seamlessly update your profile (Only needed to calculate BMI).
• Secure your data with passcode authentication using pin or face ID/touch ID if you don't like others to see your photos or data within the app.
• A lightweight app that respects your privacy. Tracking is mainly used to serve advertisements within the app.
Get additional premium features below with yourWeight+ subscription:
• Remove Advertisements
• Upload unlimited photos for tracking your visual progress.
• Enable user to enter weight directly from Apple Watch.
• Track your BMI history and integrate with Apple's Health App.
• More pro features, coming soon…
If you are already looking for an app like this one, it means that you are on the right track to enjoying a better and healthier life. Therefore, we can only wish you:
Healthy and happy life!

Maybe you have a goal to achieve, or maybe you just want to get back to your normal weight after pregnancy? The right tool can really help you achieve your ideal weight.
This app is a simple and user-friendly weight tracker and BMI (Body Mass Index) calculator app which allows you to enter your daily measurements.

In order to provide you with an application that is both ideal and simple, we have included the following main functions:
• Record your weight once a day, quick & easy. 
• Set your weight goal to track the remaining weight you need to lose or gain to get you motivated.
• Tracks your overall weight loss/gains based on your starting weight.
• Set a weekly goal so you can track your progress by milestones.
• Calculate your Body Mass Index (BMI) based on your profile to help you determine if your current weight is normal, underweight, or overweight.
• Trend graphs for quick visualization of your progress.
• Apple Watch support to quickly glance or record your weight progress.
• Reminds you to enter your weight so you can never lose track of your progress.
• Apple Health integration to import and sync weight entries seamlessly.
• Apple Health integration to seamlessly update your profile (Only needed to calculate BMI).
• Secure your data with passcode authentication using pin or face ID/touch ID if you don't like others to see your photos or data within the app.
• A lightweight app that respects your privacy. Tracking is mainly used to serve advertisements within the app.

Get additional premium features below with yourWeight+ subscription:
• Remove Advertisements
• Upload unlimited photos for tracking your visual progress.
• Enable user to enter weight directly from Apple Watch.
• Track your BMI history and integrate with Apple's Health App.
• More pro features, coming soon…

If you are already looking for an app like this one, it means that you are on the right track to enjoying a better and healthier life. Therefore, we can only wish you:

Healthy and happy life!

bluejetty:00120658:ios.description:
Welcome to a world where your imagination comes first! Make up stories in the colourful locations, and customize your own buildings – you can style your own outfits too!
Toca Boca World is all about open-ended play. There are no rules, just colorful ways to be creative. Build your world, and fill it with characters, pets, shops and all kinds of houses!
Almost everything inside Toca Boca World is customizable, or you can jump straight in and play! Try running a café, become a hair stylist, camp in the forest or throw a rooftop party. It’s a safe universe where kids explore and discover at their own pace.
BUILD YOUR OWN WORLD
• Explore apartments, shops and hangouts in Bop City 
• Design your own characters with unique hair, faces, outfits and accessories 
• Decorate spaces with Home Designer. Change the walls, furniture and colors 
• Add pets, food, toys and silly items so each place feels like your own
PLAY YOUR WAY
• Create your own stories. Become a chef, spa owner, rockstar, or teacher 
• Mix and match locations to invent your own mini games and challenges 
• Move characters between homes, schools, shops and secret spots 
• Try roleplay like running a pet hospital, opening a fashion studio or hosting a sleepover
EXPLORE, DISCOVER AND COLLECT
• Find hidden gems, secret rooms and surprises in the locations
• Visit the Post Office every Friday for free gifts including furniture, outfits, decorations and pets
• Grow your world as new packs and locations are added to the in-app shop
MADE FOR KIDS, EASY TO PLAY
• Simple, touch-first controls make it usable for all reading abilities
• No time limits or high scores. Just creative play
• Open-ended design lets kids follow their own curiosity
SAFE, SINGLE-PLAYER AND AD-FREE

• COPPA compliant, and carefully designed as a safe space for kids
• No third-party ads ever. Play is never interrupted by adverts or pop-ups
AWARD-WINNING FUN FROM TOCA BOCA
Our game has been recognized as App of the Year and an Editor’s Choice for its playful design and dedication to kids’ safety. Our award-winning kids game can be downloaded on phones, tablets and computers, with optional in-app purchases for families who want to expand their world. We believe in the power of play. That’s why Toca Boca World is built as a high-quality, ad-free game that lets children explore, create and imagine freely.
STAY CONNECTED
Discover new locations, events and collaborations by following Toca Boca World on social media and inside the in-app shop. There’s always a new story waiting.

bluejetty:00064535:ios.summary:
Professional version includes all extra features: user accounts and access restrictions, activity log, profit and loss report, projects and tags.
"The app is very user friendly, easy to use and is full of functions that covers almost all n
bluejetty:00064535:ios.description:
Professional version includes all extra features: user accounts and access restrictions, activity log, profit and loss report, projects and tags.
"The app is very user friendly, easy to use and is full of functions that covers almost all needs for making and following personal budget. Great! 10 out of 10!" - Guntars Kaneps
Key features:
• Sync data across multiple devices and PC
Several users can work with a single database and sync changes over the Internet. Alzex Finance is integrated with Files app: you can use virtually any cloud service (or SMB, FTP, WebDAV, etc) to share your budget with your family or colleagues. Instruction: https://community.alzex.com/knowledge-base/article/sync_ios
• Password protection and user accounts
Several people can work with the database. It allows you to track users who create transactions, protect transactions from changes with a password and hide them from other users.
• Activity log
Activity log allows user to see who, when and what exactly edited, deleted or added and undo any action.
• Profit and loss report
It is a financial statement that summarizes the revenues, costs, and expenses incurred during a specified period (month, quarter or year).
• Entering recurring data with a single click
You can enter recurring transactions very quickly, simply type first few letters and select a transaction from the list of frequently used transactions, and then the program fills data to all fields of the form.
• A rich set of data management tools
A possibility to undo and redo any changes. Batch editing (grouping, renaming and other actions over sets of records).
• Currencies
The program supports an unlimited number of currencies, cryptocurrencies and precious metals. Also you can add your own currencies, including "virtual" ones, i.e. you can keep track of money and other things. Exchange rates can be downloaded from the Internet.
• Accounts
This is the main way of separating transactions in the program. You can create any number of accounts, such as credit cards, bank accounts, cash, electronic money, etc.
• Categories, family members, payee, projects and tags
The program offers many features for organizing transactions – division by categories, family members, payee and projects. Each transaction can be defined with many tags.
• Scheduler
The scheduler lets you create recurring transactions automatically. These transactions will be created automatically, without any user intervention, or with his confirmation, if needed.
• Reports
Reports help you to analyze your financial situation. It will help you to understand where your money is going and manage your income in the most efficient way.
• Budget
The program makes it easy to monitor progress in achieving your financial goals and control expenses.
• Loans
Tracking debts and credits. You can borrow and lend money, and it will be displayed in the program. To repay debts, you can use any account and any currency.
Paid subscription is required.
In all the countries (except the USA) actual charges will be converted to the local currency. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy policy: www.alzex.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of service: https://www.alzex.com/terms-of-service.html
Contacts:
support@alzex.com
http://community.alzex.com
Your feedback is important to us in order to get an idea of how to make Alzex Finance software a better product for you. If you have a good idea of a new feature, or a better way of doing something, please drop us a note.
Technical support is provided by email. You can contact us at support@alzex.com.

ABOUT THE GAME
Have you been waiting for it? – Here you are!
This is not just a pinball. This is The Deep. Built up on the unique 3D engine, winning over by realistic physics and smashing music, The Deep Pinball will not leave untouched even the hypercritical gamer.
You are sailing the most perfect submarine in the world which will be your reliable guide in the mysterious world of ocean depths. Sunken ships and ruin tunnels, unde3rwater hunting and chests full of treasures are waiting for you.
And your assistant - on-board computer – will provide you with all information necessary for successful passing of secret missions. Oh, and don’t even try to flirt with it… ;-)
IMPORTANT
• You can find SOUND, MUSIC and THEME options in standard iPhone “Settings” section.
• During the game pinch your fingers together or apart to toggle camera mode from live to fixed.
FEATURES
– New improved 3D engine
– Missions and Checkpoints
– Hidden locations
– Realistic physics
– Multiball
– Camera effects with three modes
– Save/load game
– Unique sounds
– Original soundtrack
– On-board computer with voice management
– Player’s speech
– Table tilting
– Local scores table
– World scores table
HOW TO PLAY
When running the app, you are presented with a 3D simulated camera zoom, pan and fly-over of one of the games. Swiping right brings up Gameprom news and swiping left brings up the local score screen. Tapping on a game's fly-over screen starts game play. Controls in game:
• Tap ANYWHERE on the left side of screen to control the left flipper and ANYWHERE on the right side to control the right flipper.
• Shake your iPad to realistically shake the pinball table, but not too much or you'll tilt.
• Tap on the "electronic caption" at the top of the screen to pause or resume your game.
• Pinch your fingers together or apart to toggle camera mode from live to fixed

bluejetty:00156773:ios.summary:

* Choose the Right Habits to Lose Weight and Keep It Off

bluejetty:00156773:ios.description:
No Dieting, No Fasting…. 
* Choose the Right Habits to Lose Weight and Keep It Off
Meet HabitNu, an easy-to-follow CDC-recognized weight loss program built around the Science of Habits and Choice. HabitNu focuses on reducing weight through a highly interactive program that incorporates lifestyle modification support around healthy eating, increased physical activity, and stress reduction. HabitNu is a true lifestyle change program led by trained health coaches who personally teach you to eat better, get – and stay – active, and manage stress for the long-term.
* Get your own Personal Health Coach and Support
You get your own personal, human health coach who will help set achievable goals and follow up with continuous guidance and encouragement throughout the program. You can also choose to participate in a small exclusive support group.
* Get your Free Wi-Fi Scale and Health Device
HabitNu makes your healthy choice an easy choice. Depending on your program, you will receive a digital scale, an activity tracker, a blood glucose meter, or a smart blood pressure cuff. HabitNu offers easy integration with your connected devices.
* Log Your Food
Participants who keep a food diary typically lose weight. Track your meals with ease. Nutritional support is tailored to your food habits and contains an extensive food database, barcode scanner, recipe builder for home-cooked meals, and advice on ethnic foods.
* Educate Yourself
HabitNu’s exclusive short videos are fun and easy to follow. Topics cover CDC’s proven curriculum.
* Habit Tracker helps you Build Healthy Habits that last!
What habits would you like to change? Procrastinate less. Be more productive. Increase your physical strength. Adopt better nutrition habits. Name it, and Habit Tracker can help you get there! With Habit Tracker, you can set small bite-sized goals, track your progress, and receive action prompts via personalized nudges, all on your terms. When you can see progress, you’re much more likely to keep it up.
Join the thousands of participants who have changed their lives and you will pick up New Habits that will last!
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00121591:ios.summary:
To continue enjoying our app, we kindly request that you log in again after this update.
If you're a subscriber, please take a moment to restore your account to ensure uninterrupted access. You can find the “Restore Subscriptions“ button i
bluejetty:00121591:ios.description:
To continue enjoying our app, we kindly request that you log in again after this update.
If you're a subscriber, please take a moment to restore your account to ensure uninterrupted access. You can find the “Restore Subscriptions“ button in Settings under Subscriptions.
Welcome to a new app experience, we have optimized our app and giving it a facelift! This faster ios native app now has the following new features:
Your News:
Provide personalized recommendations for content based on user preferences. Users will be allowed to customize the content they want to engage with by selecting the topics they are truly interested in. By going to the “Your News” tab the user can bypass the noise of all that is published and home in on the content they want
Saved Articles:
Save feature that allows users to save articles or other content they are interested in for later reading or reference.Push notifications will remind users to read their saved articles or suggest related content
Custom Push Notifications:
The user can select what topics they want to be notified about which makes for a much less intrusive experience. 
Top Navigation Bar:
 A top navigation bar lets the user switch between sections by swiping or tapping.
Enews in-app:
Desire the newspaper experience? No need to open a separate app! By simply going to Settings and selecting E-News the user can browse the Digital Replica of the day’s paper.
Offline Reading:
This feature allows users to enable offline reading from Settings. Offline “Reading Preferences” can also be customized for Settings. 
Swipe Left:
Instead of going back to the main section to find more articles, users have the option to simply swipe, immediately opening other articles in the Section.
Follow Topics:
A user will be shown articles on topics they are following. To follow select “follow” at the article level and related articles will gain relevancy and be shown more frequently. Just as easily “Unfollow”
Terms of Use:
https://www.medianewsgroup.com/terms-of-use/
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00040442:ios.summary: Welcome to ALFA OBD, the ultimate Automotive Link & Finance App designed to enhance your car ownership experience. ALFA, short for Automotive Link & Finance App, connects seamlessly to your vehicle using a Bluetooth OBD adapter. Once connec
bluejetty:00040442:ios.description:
Welcome to ALFA OBD, the ultimate Automotive Link & Finance App designed to enhance your car ownership experience. ALFA, short for Automotive Link & Finance App, connects seamlessly to your vehicle using a Bluetooth OBD adapter. Once connected, you can scan, read, and analyze real-time car data with ease, ensuring your vehicle's health and performance are always optimized.
But ALFA OBD goes beyond diagnostics. It features advanced vehicle finance tools that empower you to take control of your finances effortlessly. Track your expenses, monitor income, and manage your vehicle finance details right within the app. Whether you're a car enthusiast, mechanic, or simply a conscientious driver, ALFA OBD offers intuitive tools to support your financial and automotive needs.
Key Features:
• Bluetooth OBD Connection: Connect to your car wirelessly for comprehensive diagnostics.
• Real-Time Data: Scan and read car data to monitor performance and diagnose issues promptly.
• Vehicle Finance Tools: Manage expenses, track income, and stay on top of your vehicle finance effortlessly.
• User-Friendly Interface: Intuitive design for easy navigation and seamless user experience.
• Comprehensive Support: Compatible with various car models and systems.
ALFA OBD is your trusted companion for automotive diagnostics and smart financial management, ensuring you're always in control of your vehicle and your finances.
Subscription Terms and Payment Options:
This app offers two auto-renewing subscriptions listed below, which unlock full access to all premium features:
1. Weekly Subscription ($1.99 USD / week)
2. Monthly Subscription ($4.99 USD / month)
Subscription can be canceled at any time
Your account will be automatically charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period.
You may cancel auto-renew at any time, as long as the cancellation is at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Any unused portions of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase an auto-renewing subscription.
Managing subscriptions:
Auto-renew may be cancelled from within settings.
- Open settings
- Click name
- Click Subscriptions
- Here you can see and manage all your subscriptions

[About LUPINAS]
・Enjoy with extra-refreshing hack and slash action game with numerous character makeover.。
・Dress-up in to your style with your favorite "cute" and "charming" characters.
・Meet many players, sometimes cooperate, and sometimes battle each other.
...You belong here!
[About the game]
◆Grass plain, snowy mountain, desert……
LUPINAS's main stage for adventure is the tower that reaches to heaven overlaps different worlds.
Unfold each world and reach to the top.
There will also be auto-mode function, to move on quickly.
◆Play within dungeon! Complete with item!
There will be dungeons not only defeating monsters, but also collecting rare items and also challenging yourself.
Many dungeons to suit your adventure and playstyle.
Synthesize the items you collected to enhance and activate new skills.
◆Use various classes and skill systems!
There will be 6 main classes such as "Warrior" and "Magician," and additional "Gladiator" with skill system.
You can nurture your own, unique characters.
◆Meet new people…
LUPINAS will be full of many adventurers where you can meet and create a party to cooperate for a quest!
You can achieve quests that you couldn't achieve yourself, but also with your friends!
There will also be "emotion function" to express "smile" or "cry," to communicate and be closer with your party!
[Story]
"Where everyone can be free ---
Tower that reaches to the sky appears out of nowhere
For those who have reached to the top,
 will be able to make any wish come true,
 and invited to eternal paradise."
The world of sword and magic.

bluejetty:00135013:ios.description:
Transform your physique from anywhere using the innovative system that the world’s best bodybuilding athletes trust: FST-7.

WHAT IS FST-7?
FST stands for Fascia Stretch Training and the 7 refers to the seven sets that are usually performed as the final exercise for a target body part. This innovative training system is designed to give you rapid results and is targeted at stretching your fascia to allow more room for muscle growth.
WHAT DO I GET?
Get exclusive access to workouts and nutrition plans that elicit maximal hormonal response and muscle hypertrophy - packaged together in a powerful, easy-to-use app.

Support from the FST-7 team and the Pro Creator himself

bluejetty:00026937:ios.description:
Parcels Hub is the place to track all your packages from your favorite online stores: AliExpress, SHEIN, Amazon, eBay, and many more.
• Tracking over 700 postal services 
Exceptional quality tracking enables over 700 postal and courier services worldwide to be added to our tracking database. In our service you can track the parcels transported by: fedEX, DHL, UPS, USPS and hundreds of other carriers.
• Fast addition and automatic update of parcels
Forget about anxious waiting for a few minutes when adding a package. We will find information about it within 10 seconds! And with automatic updates every 6 hours, you will always be aware of the most current status of the shipment.
• Ability to independently update information about parcels 
If you do not want to wait for the next scheduled update - just go to the application and update the information yourself.
• Push notifications
Timely notifications about the movement of parcels will help you remember to pick up the parcel from the mail or find a problem in time in order to quickly solve it.
• No ads
There's no need to watch intrusive videos or search for the content you want between banner ads. This allows you to fully access your content quickly and without hindrance, and nothing extra takes up any of your screen space.
We will be happy to help you find and track your parcels. Hurry up to try all the benefits of Parcels Hub!
If you choose to purchase Parcels Hub PRO, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. Current Parcel Hub PRO subscription price starts at $2,49 per week. Prices are in US dollars, may vary in countries other than the US and are subject to change without notice. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://telegra.ph/Privacy-Policy-05-08-7
Terms & Conditions: https://telegra.ph/Terms--Conditions-05-08
Questions, issues or bugs? Contact parcelshub.help@gmail.com and we’ll be happy to help. 
Your feedback is music to our ears, and it make Parcels Hub even better.

bluejetty:00073391:ios.summary: The myQ smart access app allows you to seamlessly open, close and monitor your garage door, commercial door, or gate from ANYWHERE. The app supports myQ-enabled products from leading garage door manufacturers including Chamberlain and LiftM
bluejetty:00073391:ios.description:
The myQ smart access app allows you to seamlessly open, close and monitor your garage door, commercial door, or gate from ANYWHERE. The app supports myQ-enabled products from leading garage door manufacturers including Chamberlain and LiftMaster. myQ helps you keep your home or business safe and secure. 
With the myQ Smart Garage Camera, you can keep an eye on your home’s busiest access point. myQ lets you know who’s coming and going, alerting you when someone is detected. With a video storage plan, myQ captures and stores the important motion events, saving the video clips so you can quickly filter, download, and share with your friends and family. 
The myQ Smart Garage Video Keypad lets you know who’s entering your garage, so you can know your loved ones are home safe. 
Additional myQ Features: 
Set up smart access alerts that notify you when there’s activity 
Set schedules to close your garage doors or gates 
Share access with family, friends or service providers 
For myQ smartphone control, you need either: 
A compatible Wi-Fi garage door opener OR 
The myQ Smart Garage Control to retrofit older non-Wi-Fi garage door opener 
Download the app today to check your compatibility. 
With myQ Connected Garage, you can use your vehicle’s infotainment system as a remote to open, close, and monitor your garage door, from anywhere, with no additional hardware. myQ Connected Garage is currently available in select Tesla, Honda, Acura, Volkswagen, Mercedes, and Mitsubishi vehicles. 
Additional smart access products and services within the myQ ecosystem include: 
myQ Smart Garage Video Keypad 
myQ Smart Garage Camera 
Amazon Key In-Garage Delivery 
Walmart+ InHome Delivery 
To turn your existing garage door opener into a smart opener, visit www.myQ.com for accessory options.

Key Features of the app Chaupai Sahib:
1) One can listen to path using soft keys(Play, Pause or Stop).
2) Meaning of the path on every page.
3) One can change the text size (i.e. increase or decrease) within app.
4) One can select path language from Gurmukhi, Hindi and English.
5) One can share this app with friends and family.
6) Themes: User can change theme. 
7) User can use Go option to quickly go to any page.
The design of app is very simple.
We hope you will like our app.

FAQ
What is an eSIM? An eSIM, is a digital SIM card embedded directly into a device's hardware. It serves the same purpose as a physical SIM card but doesn't require a physical card to be inserted into the device.
Which devices support eSIMs?
Please check out our article: https://instabridge.com/esim-compatible-devices/
Can I use an eSIM with my existing phone number?
Yes! Instabridge provides cost efficient data plans that does not affect your phone number. We only replace the mobile data of your physical SIM card. Just keep your physical SIM card to keep using your phone number just as before.
Can I use an eSIM on more devices than my phone?
Yes, eSIMs can be used on tablets, laptops, smart watches and other devices that require mobile data connectivity. With Instabridge you can use as many devices you want without any extra cost!
How do I use Instabridge eSIM Data Plans effectively? 
Keep your existing phone number for calls and texts, and use Instabridge's cost-efficient Data Plans to eliminate costly roaming fees and long-term commitments.
Can I have multiple eSIM profiles on one device?
Yes, many devices support multiple eSIM profiles. Usually it’s a limitation of between 5-10 eSIM profiles per device.

bluejetty:00021468:ios.name: Toby: Offline Book for Reading
bluejetty:00021468:ios.summary: Immerse your little ones in the ocean adventure of “Toby, the Lost Whale” — an educational bedtime story app perfect for preschool and kindergarten children! Designed for kids (ages 3–7), this animated adventure storybook delivers valuable
bluejetty:00021468:ios.description:
Immerse your little ones in the ocean adventure of “Toby, the Lost Whale” — an educational bedtime story app perfect for preschool and kindergarten children! Designed for kids (ages 3–7), this animated adventure storybook delivers valuable lessons right to your home or school classroom.
— DIVE INTO INTERACTIVE LEARNING
* Read-Aloud & Read-Along: With professional voice narration, children can listen to the story aloud as they follow along or read along with the text. The entire book features clear English audio and text, helping them build vocabulary and reading comprehension.
* Offline Adventures: All activities and educational lessons in this book work completely offline. Your child can enjoy these tales anytime, anywhere, with no internet connection required.
* Beginner Reading Support: Designed for beginner-level learners, this interactive story uses basic words and simple sentence structures to help young children build confidence in early reading.
* Interactive Storytelling: This engaging app invites early learners to tap, pull, pop, and drag objects within the interactive picture book, bringing Toby’s ocean adventure to life. Children can explore the ocean while enjoying a fun, interactive game-like experience.
* Biblical Parable: “Toby, the Lost Whale” draws inspiration from the Bible parable of the Prodigal Son, teaching important Christian lessons about God’s unconditional love and forgiveness. The Bible verse from Luke 15:32 reinforces this powerful message: “It was fitting to celebrate and be glad, for this your brother was dead, and is alive; he was lost, and is found.” This app is designed to inspire children in nursery school, preschool, pre-K, grade 1, and grade 2.
* Kid-Safe Environment: Rest easy knowing this app is 100% kid-safe, with no ads, in-app purchases, or external links. It provides a secure space for little ones to explore, learn, and enjoy a meaningful children’s book.
* Perfect for Any Time: Ideal for 5-minute bedtime stories or engaging activities for kids (ages 3–7). Whether at home or in the classroom, kids can enjoy a fun and educational reading experience.
* Explore and Learn: Help children learn words, improve reading skills, and explore a heartwarming whale story inspired by the teachings of Jesus. Follow Toby’s ocean adventure and encounter fascinating sea creatures, including humpback whales and orcas.
* Build Reading Skills: Build vocabulary and reading comprehension skills while enjoying a fun, interactive experience. Simple text, professional narration, and engaging activities make the story accessible to beginner readers!
— AN EDUCATIONAL JOURNEY THROUGH THE SEA
This educational reading app helps kids develop empathy, communication skills, and an understanding of unconditional love through Toby’s journey to reunite with his family. The vivid picture book captures the imagination and provides an exciting ocean adventure for young readers.
As children explore the ocean with Toby, they can enjoy an engaging storybook experience filled with animation, sound, and interactive activities. The combination of reading, listening, and play encourages kids to discover the story at their own pace.
— AVAILABILITY
Available on iPad, iPhone, and Mac, “Toby, the Lost Whale” is a storybook app for young learners who enjoy Bible stories, Christian themes, and engaging interactive adventures.
— WALA BEAR INC.
https://www.walabear.com

bluejetty:00088023:ios.description:
Felt is the highest quality, most personal way to send real, handwritten cards and photos to friends and loved ones. Your handwriting is 100% authentic, like you wrote it with pen and paper. It’s personal mail for the modern world: beautiful, fun and couldn’t be simpler.
SHARK TANK | INSTYLE | NPR | NY TIMES | SXSW | REALSIMPLE | BRIT+CO | GLAMOUR
Use Felt for every occasion:
- Photo Cards
- Thank You
- Birthdays
- Holidays
- Grandparents
- Babies
- Weddings
- Graduations
- Travel
- Invitations 
- Father’s Day
- Mother’s Day
- Anniversary & Love
- Thinking of You
- Get Well Soon
- Congratulations
DETAILS
 - Felt cards are mailed within 24 hrs. Monday - Friday.
 - Cards are 4 inches wide x 4.5 inches tall. We call them card frames. You can connect up to four frames to create one amazing card!
 - Select from cards made by famous designs and discover unique works by independent artists.
 - We use premium Mohawk paper and envelopes.
 - We hand apply a first class stamp.
 - You can send your Felt card to one person or multiple recipients at once.
 - Felt cards start at just $4.50 (including postage) or send 3 cards for $6 a month.
 - Volume discounts are available in the app for larger card sending needs.
 - Make it a gift by adding fresh-cut flowers, real cash money or select a gift card from popular brands.
 - Adding contacts is easy! Import them right from your phone into the app or upload a spreadsheet here: https://myfelt.feltapp.com/addressbook.
HOW IT WORKS 
Just select one of our many original card designs, or select a photo from your phone. Then write a personal message on the front or back of the card with a stylus or just your finger. (Don’t worry you can type too, and we have several fun designer fonts to choose from.) You can then add up to three additional photos to your order, or a gift card. We print your cards, photos and handwritten message on premium Mohawk card stock. 
Multiple card frames come in our own unique square accordion-style format, with micro-perforations between each fold. We seal them by hand, add a first class hand-applied stamp and try to mail them within 24hrs.
We go to great lengths to make sure the final product is as personal and heartfelt as if you sent it yourself.

bluejetty:00136301:ios.description:
Get the Swellnet app featuring accurate surf forecasts, live surfcams & replays, surf reports, tide, wind and detailed weather charts.
Swellnet has been Australia's home-grown source for surf reports, forecasts and live surfcams for twenty five years - built by surfers, for surfers. Now available worldwide with an expanding network of global surfcams, and a team of surf forecasters who know the coastlines better than anyone. Whether you're chasing the dawn patrol at your local, planning a road trip up the coast or travelling overseas, Swellnet gives you everything you need to pick the right spot, at the right time, with the right board.
Live Surfcams
* Watch the waves live across Swellnet's high-vantage surfcam network, positioned to show the whole bank - not just one peak.
* Pinch-to-zoom and pan for a closer look at conditions before you paddle out.
* Missed the morning session? Scrub back through Surfcam Replays with fast-forward and adjustable playback speed to see exactly how the swell built (or dropped off) through the day.
Surf Reports and Forecaster Notes
* Get daily Surf Reports from Swellnet's national team of surf forecasters, updated multiple times a day so you're never working off stale info.
Accurate Local Surf Forecasts
* Plan up to 16 days ahead with forecasts built specifically for surf, not general weather.
* Read comprehensive Forecaster Notes from Swellnet's qualified forecast team, explaining the swell, wind and tide picture in plain English - not just a chart.
* Detailed wind and tide data, and swell train visualisation for every forecast, so you can pick the right tide and time of day for your spot.
The Best Wind & Swell Charts
* Wind, swell, period, LWT, switch between multiple weather models. 
* Slick user interface with new features being added regularly.
Built Around Your Spots
* Save your favourite forecast locations and surfcam and add them to your home screen for instant access and viewing.
* Fast, accurate location search with surfcams prioritised so you can jump straight to a live view.
* Choose your preferred units - tide in feet or metres, region-based defaults - so the numbers make sense to you.
Swellnet Pro
Upgrade to Swellnet Pro for the full 16-day surf forecast, an ad-free surfcam experience, and full access to the Forecaster Notes. Swellnet Pro is available as a subscription or short-access pass, so you can grab it just for a swell event or keep it running year-round.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID account settings. Terms of Use: https://www.swellnet.com/terms | Privacy Policy: http://www.swellnet.com/privacy

bluejetty:00185254:ios.description:
LillyPlayer is your all-in-one IPTV & Xtream player — live TV, your movies, your series and all your media in one premium app for iPhone and iPad. Live TV with full program guide, replay and return-to-live, a rich movies and series catalog (artwork, cast, sagas), and playback of your files from your network sources. Stream your IPTV and Xtream sources, or your own media library — all in one app.
Important: LillyPlayer is a media player — it does not include any channels or content. You need your own IPTV subscription, M3U playlist, Xtream account or personal media to use it.
No conversion needed: all major video and audio formats are supported directly on your device.
- Play / download via your SMB/FTP/WEBDAV/UPnP access.
- AirPlay / external screen support.
- Chromecast support.
- Picture-in-Picture (PiP) playback.
- Support 4K HDR videos / Dolby Vision / HDR10(+)
- AetherEngine playback engine: Dolby Vision, HDR10+, Dolby Atmos, DTS-HD, TrueHD, AV1 and much more.
- Broadcast support on UPnP/DLNA compatible devices.
- IPTV support: Xtream extension (EPG, Replay), M3U playlists.
- Jellyfin and Plex support.
- External subtitles support (opensubtitles.com).
- TVHeadend support for channels / records.
- iCloud synchronization support.
- Playlist management.
- Synchronize what you're watching with Trakt.tv.
- Hardware acceleration.
- Video / audio equalizer.
- Automatic audio / video synchronization (also over Bluetooth).
- Subtitle support, multiple video / audio tracks.
- Continuous playback.
- Automatically detect all video files on your device.
- Easily control volume, brightness and playback progress.
- Multiple playback options: auto-rotate, aspect ratio, screen lock and more.
LillyPlayer PRO subscription:
- Your subscription lasts 1 month, 6 months, 1 year or life time.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription.
- You can manage your subscription and switch off auto-renewal by accessing your account settings after purchase.
- You cannot cancel the current subscription during the active subscription period.
- Any unused part of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
- Privacy Policy: https://lillyplayer.com/rgpd.html
- Terms of Use: https://lillyplayer.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00165313:ios.description:
Tomb Raider blasts onto mobile. Play as the legendary Lara Croft like you’ve never seen her before!
Inspired by the original Tomb Raider games, wield Lara’s iconic twin-pistols and get ready for a globetrotting adventure!
Travel through the golden arch-shaped doors of the treacherous underground tombs, across hazardous mountain caves, flourishing jungles and lush waterfalls.
On your quest you’ll avoid hidden traps, discover ancient relics, solve a wide variety of puzzles and face off against different enemies and bosses (is that a T-Rex I hear!?) both new and familiar to the Tomb Raider series including bloodthirsty wolves, poisonous snakes, fearsome golems and magical elemental creatures!
Gameplay features roguelike and procedurally generated stages for a new and varied experience with every run. As you progress through each level, you’ll be able to stack abilities and perks such as piercing shots, experience boosts, grenade throws and arch shots for more powerful attacks, quicker character leveling and a wider range of damage.
Dropping to a knee after an epic run doesn’t signal the end! You’ll be awarded a trove of coins and experience points to upgrade Lara’s outfits and weapons, increasing your base attack and HP stats.
Additional Features:
• Stylised cartoon visuals that reimagine Tomb Raider in ways you’ve never seen before
• An original orchestral soundtrack with reworked classic scores that pay homage to Tomb Raider’s iconic legacy
• Trademark Lara Croft actions: see Lara shoot, run, jump and handstand in classic Croft fashion
• Stumble upon collectables and unlockables including relics that provide increased damage and healing stats and blueprints that let you craft powerful new weapons, such as shotguns and mystical staffs

bluejetty:00180559:ios.name: Lira Exchange
bluejetty:00180559:ios.summary: Lira Exchange shows the real price of the dollar where the official rate is not the whole story. Since 2019 it has tracked the Lebanese and Syrian lira on the street, minute by minute. Today it covers 13 parallel markets: Lebanon, Syria, Ir
bluejetty:00180559:ios.description:
Lira Exchange shows the real price of the dollar where the official rate is not the whole story. Since 2019 it has tracked the Lebanese and Syrian lira on the street, minute by minute. Today it covers 13 parallel markets: Lebanon, Syria, Iraq, Turkey, Egypt, Algeria, Libya, Nigeria, Ethiopia, Zimbabwe, Cuba, Argentina and Venezuela. Every market shows the street buy and sell rate, the official rate and, where it exists, the bank rate, so you always see the gap.
MARKET RATES
• All markets on one screen, with your own country first and the markets you pin on top.
• Buy, sell and official rates, updated automatically throughout the day.
• The archive: every change since 2019 with the green and red arrows, searchable by date.
• History charts for one month, three months, one year or all time, with the change, high and low.
• Sayrafa archive, banking rates and fuel prices for Lebanon.
• Converter from dollars to local currency and back, at the street rate.
• Share any rate as a picture or as text with one tap.
DAILY PULSE
Where is the dollar heading today? Vote up, down or steady once a day, see what the community thinks, and get the verdict the next morning: who was right, the crowd or the market. Keep your streak going. A Home Screen widget lets you vote without opening the app.
METALS
Gold, silver, platinum and palladium per ounce in dollars and per gram in your currency, with 24, 21 and 18 karat prices for gold and alerts when the price moves.
RATE ALERTS AND LIVE ACTIVITY
• Choose the markets that may notify you and receive a push the moment the rate moves.
• A morning digest with the rates and yesterday's vote result.
• Pin a market as a Live Activity and follow it on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
GLOBAL RATES AND CRYPTO
• Official rates for more than 160 currencies, with a converter and your favourites first.
• The top 100 cryptocurrencies with 24-hour change, 7-day charts and their value in the market of your choice.
ON YOUR HOME SCREEN AND YOUR WRIST
• Widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen in every size. Edit the widget to choose the market it shows.
• Apple Watch app with complications for the market you pick.
• Siri and Shortcuts: "What is the dollar rate in Lira Exchange?"
MORE
• A five-day forecast for any market, based on its own history.
• Nearest currency exchange shops on a map, with directions in Apple Maps or Google Maps.
• Works offline with the last rates received.
• English, Arabic, French, Turkish and Spanish.
• Remove Ads with a single purchase.
DISCLAIMER
Lira Exchange is an indicator, not an official or formal reference for any exchange rate. Rates are collected from public sources and local exchangers and are provided as is, without any guarantee of accuracy or timeliness. The content is for information only and is not financial advice. Please consult a professional financial advisor before making any financial decision.

bluejetty:00016756:ios.description:
Unlock the power of a handy detection toolkit with Metal and Spy Camera Detector, an all-in-one mobile app designed to enhance your safety and assist in everyday tasks. This versatile tool is your go-to companion for privacy concerns, home improvements, and much more. Our app equips you with a comprehensive suite of powerful tools to find metals, magnetic fields, hidden cameras, and other critical elements in your surroundings.
Key Features:
Metal Detector: Easily locate hidden metal objects. Ideal for finding screws, nails, and other metallic items in walls or beneath surfaces, making it perfect for DIY enthusiasts and professionals alike.
Magnetic Detector: Tap into magnetic field detection to identify unusual magnetic activity that could indicate the presence of spy devices or other hidden objects.
WiFi Device Detector: Secure your personal WiFi network by identifying unknown devices connected to your network. Ensure that only trusted devices have access and maintain your privacy.
Hidden Camera Detector: Traveling or worried about your privacy? Use your device’s camera to scan for hidden cameras in dressing rooms, hotels, or bathrooms. Stay one step ahead and protect your privacy wherever you go.
Mail Checker: Keep your digital identity secure with our Mail Checker tool. Check if your email address has been compromised in a data breach, and take immediate steps to secure your accounts.
Stud Finder: Effortlessly locate hidden studs in your walls, essential for any construction or home renovation project. Perfect for ensuring secure placements for shelves, frames, and other fixtures.
User-Friendly Interface: Designed with simplicity and ease of use in mind, our app offers intuitive navigation and quick access to all tools. Whether you are tech-savvy or a beginner, you'll find Metal and Spy Camera Detector straightforward and effective.

bluejetty:00026742:ios.description:
Named by Time.com's @Techland as one of the best weather apps for your iPhone and Apple Watch.
Severe weather alerts for your exact location. Storm Shield gives you storm-based alerts for tornado, hurricane, flood, thunderstorm, winter storms and other life-threatening weather events via voice and push notification.
Storm-based alerts help reduce false alarms by alerting you to severe weather based on your exact location within a county. County-based alerts can result in false alarms, warning you when your location in the county is not within the threatened area.
What people are saying:
• Storm Shield "alerted our family of the Broken Arrow, OK tornado, faster than the TV and tornado sirens." - Robyn
• "I was in Oklahoma City during the tornado... we were right in its path. Your app literally was a life saver." - dcalk12
Benefits:
• Get voice alerts just like a NOAA weather radio via push notification anywhere in the United States.
• With Apple Watch, get a tap on your wrist when alerts are issued for your locations.
• Add Storm Shield's widget to your Today screen to get quick access to active alerts for the first location in your app.
• Touch Storm Shield's app icon on your 3D-Touch enabled iPhone for widget access.
• Hi-Def radar map is your home screen so you can quickly see what's going on at your locations.
• Fully supports Dark Mode in iOS 13.
• Long-tap on the map to get current conditions, hourly and daily forecasts.
• Save additional locations to ensure family members stay safe.
View NOAA severe weather alerts on the map to see where dangerous weather is happening:
• Tap alerts to view info
• Flood watches & warnings
• Tornadoes & Thunderstorms
• Hurricane & Tropical Storm forecast tracks
• Winter storms
• Marine & Coastal alerts
• Radar & Clouds
• Wind Speed
• Snow Fall
• Water Temperatures
• Road Weather
• Premium Weather (purchase required)
• Lightning Alerts and notifications (purchase required)
Enhance your app with auto-renewing monthly subscriptions:
• Buy 'Premium Weather' to unlock these features and see predicted imagery for these map layers:
1) Future Radar
2) Future Clouds
3) Future Clouds & Radar together
4) Future Surface Temperature Land
5) Future Surface Temperature Water
6) Future Surface Temperature Land & Water together
7) Future Wind Speeds Map
8) Storm Tracks: See how fast storms are moving & where they're headed.
• Buy 'Lightning' to unlock these 2 features:
1) Lightning strike push notifications up to 10 miles away.
2) See lightning on the map within 100 miles of a selected location.
Note:
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
• Privacy Policy: https://www.stormshieldapp.com/privacy_stormshield_wxs.html
• Terms of Use: https://www.stormshieldapp.com/terms_stormshield_wxs.html
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Storm Shield is made possible by The E.W. Myers, WTMJ Milwaukee, WGBA Green Bay, KIVI Boise, KTNV Las Vegas, KGUN Tucson, WTXL Tallahassee, KXXV Waco, KRIS Corpus Christi.

bluejetty:00064975:ios.description:
This app currently exists only in Swedish – keep an eye out for an English version!
Find your next home on Sweden’s largest property platform.
Hemnet brings together almost the entire Swedish housing market in one place. With tens of millions of visits every month, we are the country’s most popular destination for home seekers. Use the Hemnet app to find your next home, estimate the value of your property, connect with real estate agents, stay up to date with the housing market, and more!
SEARCH FOR HOMES
* Discover thousands of apartments, houses, and newly built homes – both upcoming and for sale.
* Explore more than 1.5 million final sale prices for sold properties.
* Easily switch between list view and map view while searching for a home.
BETTER INSIGHTS INTO HOMES FOR SALE
* Property history: many listings now include a timeline with previous sales and final sale prices going back 15 years.
* Restyle with AI: see how a property could look unfurnished or redesigned in a clean Scandinavian style.
* View sunrise and sunset positions in relation to the property, directly on the map.
SHARE WITH COLLECTIONS
* Make home searching easier – save properties you like, create your own collections, and invite others to add and view shared content.
VALUE YOUR HOME AND FOLLOW 3.5 MILLION PROPERTIES
* Get a free home valuation in just a few clicks and track your property’s value over time.
* Add and follow other properties you’re interested in – whether they’re currently on the market or not (such as your summer house, your neighbor’s apartment, or your childhood home). You can now follow 3.5 million properties across Sweden!
* Access the latest data and statistics for your local housing market.
FIND REAL ESTATE AGENTS
* Find agents and real estate agencies with our agent search service when it’s time to sell your home.
* Filter by name, most recent sale date, or highest number of sales.
* View all of an agent’s and agency’s previous, current, and upcoming listings.
MY HEMNET – CREATE AN ACCOUNT FOR A BETTER EXPERIENCE
* Save your favorite homes and receive important updates via push notifications, such as viewing reminders, bidding updates, and final sale prices.
* Save your searches and receive emails or push notifications when new properties appear in your selected areas. Choose between daily summaries or instant live notifications as soon as a new listing is published.
* Register your home in just a few simple steps and receive a free estimated valuation.
* Get quick access to your personalized “Explore” home screen, where you can find your saved searches and properties, and continue where you left off.
Download the app and use Hemnet like a pro!
HOW TO SEARCH FOR AND BUY A HOME IN SWEDEN
1. UNDERSTAND THE BASICS
In Sweden, the most common property types are houses (you own the building and land) and co-op apartments (bostadsrätt), where you buy the right to live in an apartment within a housing association.
2. SEARCH FOR HOMES ON HEMNET
Homes are advertised on Hemnet with detailed listings, photos, floor plans, and pricing. You can search by location, price, size, features and key words.
3. VIEWINGS 
Most homes are shown at open viewings, where multiple buyers visit at the same time. Digital viewings are sometimes available.
4. FINANCING
You usually need a mortgage from a bank. In Sweden, you can typically borrow up to 85% of the property’s value (changing to 90% during 2026), and many buyers secure a loan commitment before bidding.
5. BIDDING
Bidding usually starts after viewings and is handled by the real estate agent. Bids are not legally binding until a contract is signed.
6. BUYER RESPONSIBILITY 
As a buyer, you are responsible for inspecting the property and understanding costs such as fees, maintenance, and running expenses.
7. CONTRACT AND COMPLETION
Once an offer is accepted, a purchase contract is signed, a deposit is paid, and the remaining amount is settled on the move-in date when you receive the keys.

bluejetty:00071398:ios.description:
WP Poczta to bezpłatna i łatwa w obsłudze aplikacja pocztowa.
Przejrzysty układ i wygląd aplikacji pozwala sprawnie wykorzystywać wszystkie funkcjonalności WP Poczty.
Z WP Pocztą błyskawicznie odbierzesz wiadomości dzięki powiadomieniom push. Napiszesz odpowiedź zarówno w trybie online i offline. Szybko przeszukasz foldery i odnajdziesz starsze, ważne wiadomości.
Aplikacja WP Poczta to także:
Segregatory – automatyczne porządkowanie wiadomości w tematycznych segregatorach. Dzięki nim uporządkujesz swoją pocztę i zyskasz szybszy dostęp do tego, co ważne.
Kontakty – szybki dostęp do wszystkich adresów, zarówno z konta pocztowego, jak i z telefonu.
Galeria załączników – w łatwy sposób możesz odnajdziesz, przejrzysz i udostępnisz swoje pliki.
Konwersacje - łączymy wiadomości i odpowiedzi w konwersacje, w porządku chronologicznym.

Hook and Smash is a fun and addictive game which will have you destroying cities all across the world!

- Colorful art
- Unlock new cities to take down

Subscribe to Hook and Smash for all of the following benefits:
* Unlock the Golden Hook
* Receive 10% Extra Distance
* Get the Giant Claw!
* No Ads, which removes non-optional adverts from the game
SUBSCRIPTIONS INFORMATION:
Hook and Smash VIP Membership access offers two membership options:

- The user may manage the subscription and auto-renewal by accessing the user's account settings after purchase in the store
- No cancellation of the current subscription is permitted during the active subscription period
- Any unused portion of the free trial period will be forfeited when the subscription is purchased

- In order to cancel a subscription during the free trial period you need to cancel it through you

bluejetty:00024516:ios.name: Easy Long Exposure Camera
bluejetty:00024516:ios.summary:
This app makes it easy to take long-exposure photos with your iPhone.
Capture the passage of time in a single image—from city lights, starry skies, star trails, and fireworks to flowing waterfalls and rivers.
Choose from three blending mod
bluejetty:00024516:ios.description:
This app makes it easy to take long-exposure photos with your iPhone.
Capture the passage of time in a single image—from city lights, starry skies, star trails, and fireworks to flowing waterfalls and rivers.
Choose from three blending modes to create the look you want.
【Light Trails】
Adds up the light from each frame to draw trails from car headlights and brighten subjects that are too dark to see.
Perfect for night scenes and faint auroras that are hard to see with the naked eye.
【Motion Blur】
Averages multiple frames to give waterfalls and rivers a smooth, silky appearance.
It can create a slow-shutter effect even in bright conditions and can also make moving people less noticeable.
【Lighten】
Keeps only the brightest parts of each frame, so the background doesn’t wash out even during long exposures.
Ideal for fireworks, star trails, and auroras that are clearly visible to the naked eye.
【Create from Video】
Turn videos you’ve already recorded into long-exposure photos. Choose the part of the video to use and blend it with Motion Blur or Lighten. Stabilization is also supported.
Key Features
・Exposure times from 1 to 180 seconds, plus Bulb mode that you can stop whenever you choose
・Live preview of the blended image while shooting
・Image stabilization to reduce camera shake without a tripod (up to 3 seconds in the free version)
・Post-capture brightness adjustment from −2.0 to +2.0 EV, with the option to save multiple versions
・Auto and manual focus, plus pinch-to-zoom
・Switch between lenses and front/rear cameras
・3-second and 10-second self-timers
・Grid and level tools for composing your shot
・Shoot using the iPhone volume buttons or a compatible Bluetooth remote shutter
・Selectable image quality and JPG saving
・EXIF metadata including exposure time and ISO
Great For
・Cityscapes and illuminated night scenes
・Starry skies and star trails
・Fireworks
・Auroras
・Car and train light trails
・Motion blur in waterfalls, streams, oceans, and clouds
・Making moving people less noticeable in busy locations
The free version includes all the essential features you need to enjoy long-exposure photography.
The Pro version is available as a one-time purchase and adds manual ISO control, ad removal, noise reduction, unlimited stabilization duration with Bulb mode support, full-resolution saving for photos created from videos (the free version reduces the long side to 2048 px), high-bit-depth 16-bit PNG saving, direct saving without the preview screen, and more.
Tips for Better Results
For standard long-exposure photography, mount your iPhone on a tripod or place it on a stable surface for sharper results.
Image stabilization helps reduce camera shake when shooting without a tripod, but the edges of the resulting photo will be cropped slightly.
Results and available lenses may vary depending on your iPhone model and shooting conditions.

- Hazard Perception Test

** DVSA revision questions ***
Practise revision questions licensed to us by the Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency (people who set the test)

Practise for the driving licence test anywhere, anytime.

Just like those you'll encounter during your actual test.

Take unlimited mock tests which are just like the actual DVSA exam.

Driving Theory Test 4 in 1 Kit comes with powerful and easy-to-use settings which make practising for the licence exam easy for everyone.

Take control of your mental wellness with Daily Journal—an evidence-based tool designed to help you combat loneliness, reduce anxiety, and build healthier habits through scientifically-proven techniques.
**ADDRESSING THE LONELINESS EPIDEMI
bluejetty:00127664:ios.description:
Take control of your mental wellness with Daily Journal—an evidence-based tool designed to help you combat loneliness, reduce anxiety, and build healthier habits through scientifically-proven techniques.
**ADDRESSING THE LONELINESS EPIDEMIC**
The U.S. Surgeon General has declared loneliness a public health crisis. Daily Journal provides a private, supportive space where you can express your feelings and find comfort in daily reflection. When you're feeling alone, sometimes just writing can be a powerful first step toward connection and healing.
**SCIENCE-BACKED TECHNIQUES**
Built on the foundation of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), our app employs clinically validated methods to help you:
• Identify and challenge negative thought patterns
• Track mood fluctuations and recognize triggers
• Practice gratitude to boost optimism and resilience
• Process complex emotions through expressive writing
• Build sustainable mental wellness habits
**PROVEN BENEFITS**
Research shows that regular journaling can:
• Reduce stress and anxiety by up to 40%
• Improve mood and emotional regulation
• Enhance self-awareness and mindfulness
• Support better sleep quality
• Strengthen psychological resilience
• Combat feelings of isolation and loneliness
**KEY FEATURES**
• **CBT Thought Records**: Interactive exercises to reframe negative thinking
• **Mood Tracking**: Visual insights into your emotional patterns
• **Gratitude Prompts**: Daily practices linked to increased happiness
• **Private & Secure**: Your thoughts are protected with end-to-end encryption
• **Evidence-Based Prompts**: Curated questions from mental health experts
• **Progress Analytics**: Track your mental wellness journey over time
**DIGITAL THERAPEUTIC APPROACH**
Daily Journal represents the cutting edge of digital therapeutics (DTx)—mobile health solutions with proven clinical efficacy. Our methods are grounded in peer-reviewed research and continuously refined based on user outcomes.
**YOUR PRIVACY MATTERS**
Everything you write is encrypted and private. We never sell user data or display ads. Your journal is your safe space, always.
**OPTIONAL PERMISSIONS**
• Notifications: Gentle reminders to maintain your journaling practice
**DAILY JOURNAL PREMIUM**
Unlock unlimited entries and advanced features with Premium:
• Annual subscription: $19.99/year ($1.67/month)
• Free 7-day trial included
• Cancel anytime, including during trial
Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions in your iTunes Account settings.
Pricing in USD. International pricing may vary based on location and currency conversion.
**TAKE THE FIRST STEP**
Join thousands who have discovered that taking control of their mental wellness starts with just a few minutes of daily reflection. Download Daily Journal today and begin your journey toward better mental health.

Privacy Policy: https://bit.ly/3LDQdM2

Instantly find and pay less for diesel using our nationwide fuel map — and enjoy fuel discounts at truck stops you love including Love's, TA Petro, Circle K, Speedway, Racetrac and more. No transaction or monthly fees. Just instant savings.

Drivers saved an average of $377 per month in fuel using the 10-4 by WEX app.*

Here’s how it works:
1. Download the 10-4 by WEX app.
2. Create an account and add your credit or debit card. 
3. Use the fuel map to find diesel stations along your route.
4. Activate at the pump and pay using a secure fuel code.
5. Track your fuel purchases, rewards, and savings in the app.

*Average monthly discount based on app data from 10/1/25 to 12/31/25. Actual savings may vary.

bluejetty:00155451:ios.description:
Ruby Chat: Premium AI Girlfriend, AI Boyfriend & Virtual Companion
Your AI girlfriend is one download away. Ruby Chat gives you characters that text back, call you, send photos, and actually remember what you tell them. No scripted replies. No goldfish memory. Just conversations that feel real.
▶ VOICE CALLS ◀
Call your AI girlfriend anytime and talk in real-time. She picks up, she listens, she answers in her own voice. It's the closest thing to a real phone call an AI companion can get.
▶ PREMIUM AI CHARACTERS ◀
Pick from 20+ characters, each with their own personality, backstory, and way of talking. Some are sweet, some are sarcastic, some will keep you on your toes. None of them feel like a generic bot.
▶ IMAGE MESSAGES ◀
Your AI girlfriend sends you photos while you chat. Every image lands in your personal gallery so you can go back to them whenever you want.
▶ INTERACTIVE STORIES ◀
Start a story and see where it goes. Every AI girlfriend has her own style, whether you want a thoughtful conversation or a fun adventure. New stories whenever you feel like it.
▶ SCENARIOS & CUSTOM SCENARIOS ◀
Use built-in scenarios or build your own from scratch. You pick the setting, the plot, the tone, and the characters. Your story, your rules.
▶ CUSTOM PERSONAS ◀
Decide who YOU are in the chat. Nerdy gamer, sports fan, world traveler — save multiple personas and switch anytime. Characters respond to whoever you choose to be.
▶ VOICE MESSAGES ◀
Tap any message and hear her say it. Every character has her own voice, and it changes how the whole conversation feels.
▶ LIFELIKE CONVERSATIONS ◀
Ruby Chat remembers. Tell your AI girlfriend your dog's name in January and she'll ask about him in March. She learns what you like and gets better the more you talk.
▶ MULTIPLE LANGUAGES ◀
Chat with your AI girlfriend in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, or Korean. Pick your language and every character speaks it fluently.
▶ PRIVATE & SECURE ◀
Your conversations are private and never shared. Ruby Chat is built for personal, one-on-one chats you can trust.
Why Ruby Chat?
- Voice calls with your AI girlfriend
- 20+ characters with real personality
- Photo messages + personal gallery
- Voice messages on every chat
- Custom Personas & Scenarios
- She remembers everything you tell her
- Private and secure
Download Ruby Chat and start chatting today.
