bluejetty:00138714:ios.name: Noodle: Animate your Doodles
bluejetty:00138714:ios.summary:
Introducing Noodle - An app that will bring your doodles to life!
Noodle transforms your hand-drawn sketches into amazing, dancing characters in the blink of an eye using innovative AI tech. Just snap a photo, tap ‘Animate!’ and let us wor
bluejetty:00138714:ios.description:
Introducing Noodle - An app that will bring your doodles to life!
Noodle transforms your hand-drawn sketches into amazing, dancing characters in the blink of an eye using innovative AI tech. Just snap a photo, tap ‘Animate!’ and let us work our magic.
Designed for creatives, parents and daydreamers alike, Noodle detects the arms, legs and head of your sketches, transforming simple drawings into captivating, moving characters, ready for you to share with the world.
What will you bring to life with Noodle?
Features:
Animate with Ease: Simply snap a photo of your hand-drawn doodle and watch as Noodle brings it to life. Experience the joy of seeing your creations move and dance with just a few taps.
Unique Movements: Choose from a range of unique animations custom made by our team — from whimsical dances to expressive gestures — to really add character to your creations.
Preserve Your Art: Keep all your cherished doodles safe and sound. Noodle provides a digital space to store your hand-drawn masterpieces and timestamps each one, ensuring the original doodle is stored along with each new character you create.
Share Your Creativity: Export your animated doodles as transparent GIFs or videos. Share them privately with friends & family or flaunt your animated sketches on social channels for everyone to see! Imagine the stories you will tell with the power of character animation at your fingertips…
Is Noodle for you?
The short answer is… yes!!
For our amazing artists:
Need to grab attention on your instagram feed, want to see your character wave back at you - simply want to add sparkle to your website? Learning character animation takes time you might not have - let Noodle do the hard work for you.
For our adoring parents: Get ready to see you kid’s jaw hit the floor when you make one of their very own precious stickmen dance off the page! And Noodle has a second purpose… by snapping photos of your kid’s artworks as they grow, you’ll be building an archive of characters to look back on fondly, long after they stop bringing binders of doodles home from school every day.
For the exceptional educators: Teachers and students can use Noodle to animate all kinds of classroom projects - get ready to have the whole school clamouring for art class after they see their artworks brought to life in front of their own eyes.
…or really, for anyone curious: You don’t need to be an expert doodler or artist to have fun with our app. You don’t even need to pick up a pencil! Noodle is preloaded with our very own mascots, designed in-house. Have fun animating them before you start looking around to see what else you can animate with Noodle!
Privacy by Design:
Your drawings and personal data are treated with the utmost respect and confidentiality. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring that your creations remain yours alone.
Support and Feedback:
We love hearing from our users! If you have any questions, suggestions, or need help, please contact us at explore@cardinalblue.com
Experience the joy of Noodle—where your doodles come alive!

bluejetty:00109616:android.description:
🏆 Race to the Top: Embark on an exciting journey of brain-teasing challenges and rapid-fire questions in Trivia Race. This game combines the best elements of classic trivia games like trivial pursuit and quizup to offer an immersive and competitive quiz experience that you won't be able to put down. Engage in intense head-to-head battles against friends or fellow trivia enthusiasts from around the world, as you race against the clock to outsmart your opponents.
🧠 Put Your Knowledge to the Test: How well do you know a wide range of topics? From history and science to pop culture and sports, Trivia Race covers it all. Prepare to be both entertained and educated as you tackle an array of intriguing questions that will push your memory and intellect to new heights. Whether you're a trivia crack or a newcomer to the world of quizzes, there's something here for everyone.
🌐 Global Competition: Join the global community of trivia lovers and compete in real-time against players from different corners of the world. Showcase your expertise as you climb the ranks and establish your presence as a true trivia virtuoso. Will you be the one to claim the coveted title of the Trivia Race champion?
🎮 Engaging Gameplay: Trivia Race isn't just a regular quiz game – it's a fast-paced, heart-pounding battle of wits. Challenge your friends to thrilling trivia matches, or dive into solo matches to put your own knowledge to the ultimate brain test. With a sleek and intuitive interface, you'll be navigating through questions and answers with ease.
🏁 The Ultimate Trivia Showdown: Imagine the excitement of a trivia face-off, the tension of a quizup match, and the thrill of a high-stakes trivial pursuit – all rolled into one captivating gaming experience. Trivia Race delivers all of this and more. Are you up for the challenge?
🔥 Unleash Your Inner Trivia Prodigy: Are you ready to be exposed to an adrenaline-pumping, mind-bending adventure? Trivia Race isn't just about answering questions; it's about outsmarting your opponents and proving your mettle as the ultimate quiz champion. Sharpen your memory, expand your knowledge, and rise to the top in this cutthroat race of intellects.
Don't miss out on the excitement – download Trivia Race now and embark on a journey that will keep you hooked for hours on end. Whether you're seeking a brainy challenge

bluejetty:00126665:ios.description:
Você precisa da furadeira por uma tarde, não pela vida inteira.
A box24x7 aluga o que você precisa usar hoje: ferramentas, equipamentos de
limpeza pesada, eletrônicos, videogames e utilidades para a casa. Você escolhe
por quanto tempo usar, recebe no seu endereço e devolve quando terminar. Sem
comprar, sem guardar, sem manutenção.
COMO FUNCIONA
1. Escolha o produto e o tempo de uso — horas ou dias.
2. Confirme o endereço. Um distribuidor perto de você leva até a sua porta.
3. Use pelo tempo que contratou.
4. Terminou? Agende a coleta no app. A gente busca.
O QUE VOCÊ ENCONTRA
Ferramentas: furadeira, parafusadeira, martelete perfurador, serra circular,
esmerilhadeira, lixadeira, plaina, politriz, trena e nível a laser, scanner de
parede, escada e caixa de ferramentas completa.
Limpeza pesada: extratora para sofá, colchão e tapete, lavadora de alta
pressão, aspirador sem fio, limpador de vidros, passadeira portátil.
Casa e cozinha: airfryer, batedeira, liquidificador, panela elétrica de
pressão, fondue, máquina de gelo, ventilador, aquecedor.
Lazer: projetor com streamings inclusos, caixa de som com microfones,
videogames e controles, churrasqueira portátil, gazebo.
Beleza: secador, chapinha, modelador, babyliss.
Mudança: kit de caixas reutilizáveis que substituem o papelão.
POR QUE ALUGAR
Uma furadeira passa quase toda a vida guardada. Um projetor, uma extratora, um
gazebo — a mesma coisa. Alugar resolve o dia em que você precisa e devolve o
espaço no armário no dia seguinte.
Você paga pelo tempo de uso, com o valor na tela antes de confirmar. Nada de
manutenção, conserto ou aquele objeto parado ocupando lugar.
NUNCA USOU? A GENTE ENSINA
Cada produto traz instruções passo a passo e vídeo de como usar dentro do app.
Da montagem ao cuidado na devolução. Você não precisa saber operar uma
extratora para deixar o sofá limpo.
ENTREGA E COLETA NO SEU ENDEREÇO
Nossa rede de distribuidores locais entrega e busca o produto onde você estiver.
Você não sai de casa, não pega fila e não carrega peso.
ONDE ATENDEMOS
Grande São Paulo, com cobertura em expansão.

Você precisa da furadeira por uma tarde, não pela vida inteira.

A box24x7 aluga o que você precisa usar hoje: ferramentas, equipamentos de
limpeza pesada, eletrônicos, videogames e utilidades para a casa. Você escolhe
por quanto tempo usar, recebe no seu endereço e devolve quando terminar. Sem
comprar, sem guardar, sem manutenção.

COMO FUNCIONA

1. Escolha o produto e o tempo de uso — horas ou dias.
2. Confirme o endereço. Um distribuidor perto de você leva até a sua porta.
3. Use pelo tempo que contratou.
4. Terminou? Agende a coleta no app. A gente busca.

O QUE VOCÊ ENCONTRA

Ferramentas: furadeira, parafusadeira, martelete perfurador, serra circular,
esmerilhadeira, lixadeira, plaina, politriz, trena e nível a laser, scanner de
parede, escada e caixa de ferramentas completa.

Limpeza pesada: extratora para sofá, colchão e tapete, lavadora de alta
pressão, aspirador sem fio, limpador de vidros, passadeira portátil.

Casa e cozinha: airfryer, batedeira, liquidificador, panela elétrica de
pressão, fondue, máquina de gelo, ventilador, aquecedor.

Lazer: projetor com streamings inclusos, caixa de som com microfones,
videogames e controles, churrasqueira portátil, gazebo.

Beleza: secador, chapinha, modelador, babyliss.

Mudança: kit de caixas reutilizáveis que substituem o papelão.

POR QUE ALUGAR

Uma furadeira passa quase toda a vida guardada. Um projetor, uma extratora, um
gazebo — a mesma coisa. Alugar resolve o dia em que você precisa e devolve o
espaço no armário no dia seguinte.

Você paga pelo tempo de uso, com o valor na tela antes de confirmar. Nada de
manutenção, conserto ou aquele objeto parado ocupando lugar.

NUNCA USOU? A GENTE ENSINA

Cada produto traz instruções passo a passo e vídeo de como usar dentro do app.
Da montagem ao cuidado na devolução. Você não precisa saber operar uma
extratora para deixar o sofá limpo.

ENTREGA E COLETA NO SEU ENDEREÇO

Nossa rede de distribuidores locais entrega e busca o produto onde você estiver.
Você não sai de casa, não pega fila e não carrega peso.

ONDE ATENDEMOS

Grande São Paulo, com cobertura em expansão.

bluejetty:00165900:ios.description:
Have you ever stopped and asked yourself: "What is this plant called?", "What bug just crawled past me?" or "Could this coin actually be valuable?" We've all had those moments of curiosity when the world shows us something unfamiliar. That's exactly where Identify Anything comes in.
With just one photo, Identify Anything uses advanced Al-powered recognition technology to give you instant answers. Whether it's nature, animals, coins, antiques or everyday objects, Identify Anything helps you understand and explore the things around you.
What Can Identify Anything Do?
EXPLORE NATURE
Identify Anything is the ideal companion for nature enthusiasts. Use the app during hikes or trail adventures to identify animals, plants, trees and other natural elements around you.
- Animals Identification
Curious about "what animal is this"? Use Identify Anything to instantly identify animals, including specific breeds and characteristics. From cat breed recognizers to dog breed identifiers, this mobile app is your essential tool for animal recognition.
- Insect and Reptile Recognition
Dive into the insect world with our bug identifier. Capture images of caterpillars, spiders and snakes using your mobile device.
- Mushroom and Plant Insights
Simply snap a picture to identify plants and fungi safely with your phone. Our app's flower and mushroom identifiers provide detailed care tips and safety information directly enhancing your botanical knowledge.
IDENTIFY OBJECTS
Whether you're exploring items for a hobby or solving everyday curiosities, this app is your reliable digital assistant. Its versatility makes it an essential tool for enthusiasts, professionals, and casual users alike.
- Stamp Recognition
A dream tool for collectors! Identify Anything's intelligent stamp identifier lets you scan rare or common stamps to learn about their details and history with ease.
- Coin and Jewelry Examination
Easily scan coins and jewelry with your mobile to determine their value and history, answering queries like "how much are my coins worth?" Our coin scanner feature helps you check your coins' worth and origins swiftly.
- Reverse Image Search
Ever wondered, "What movie or series is this scene from?" Simply capture a still from any video to identify movies, series, games, and even anime.
Why Choose Identify Anything?
Fast & Accurate: Point your camera, snap a picture, and get results in seconds.
More Than Just Names: Identify Anything goes beyond simple identification. You'll also receive context, background information, and care advice when relevant.
All-in-One Discovery Tool: Instead of downloading different apps for plants, animals, insects, or coins, Identify Anything puts everything in one powerful app.
Who Is Identify Anything For?
Nature lovers & gardeners: Quickly identify plants and get actionable care tips.
Pet owners& animal enthusiasts: Learn more about breeds, traits, and species.
Collectors: Discover insights about coins, antiques, and rare finds.
Parents & kids: Turn curiosity into a fun, educational adventure.
Questions You Can Ask Identify Anything
"How do I know if my houseplant needs more sunlight?"
"What type of tree is this?"
"What breed of dog did I just see?"
"What bug is this and is it safe?'
"Is this coin rare or valuable?"
"What era is this antique from?"
"What's the history of this object I found?"
Identify Anything requires a subscription to use. Subscriptions are managed by users and you can cancel at any time. Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel your subscription at any time using the account settings on your phone. Manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings after purchase if you would not like to get an auto renewing subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://famoconnect.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00175213:ios.description:
Your next-generation chartplotter.
Navigate with the world’s #1 marine charts app for coastal boating, sailing, and fishing.
Marine GPS, nautical charts, AIS Online, tides & tidal currents, anchoring, marine weather, radar, sounder, and NMEA data — everything you need for safer navigation at sea.
Built for sailors, boaters, and fishermen who need reliable navigation anywhere, online or offline.
THE SMARTEST AND CLEAREST NAVIGATION INTERFACE AT SEA
A cutting-edge interface makes navigation clearer and faster:
• TZ Bar: quick access to key features
• Dedicated screens: Weather, Fishing, NavData, Logbook, Mooring, Tides, Sounder
• Cleaner chart view, easier to read
• Customizable interface for faster access
• Modern design focused on readability
WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH TZ iBoat
• Navigate with marine GPS and nautical charts
• Monitor AIS targets locally and globally
• Plan routes and anchor safely
• Access tides, currents, and weather forecasts
• Fish smarter using oceanographic data
FOR SAILORS & BOATERS – Navigate safely
• TZ MAPS: vector, raster, satellite, and bathymetry charts
• SMART SEARCH: find marinas, buoys, tide stations, routes
• DYNAMIC LIGHTS: real-time light sectors
• DYNAMIC MOORINGS: wind-aware anchorage
• Precise GPS for coastal navigation
AIS & SAFETY – Stay aware beyond your horizon
• AIS ONLINE: global AIS targets via internet (Essential plan)
• Share AIS data with the community
• Radar and onboard instrument integration
• Real-time traffic awareness for safer navigation
FOR FISHERMEN – Gain the edge
Turn ocean data into real fishing results:
• Identify productive zones using SST, chlorophyll, currents, altimetry (Elite plan)
• Spot fish-holding conditions faster
• BATHYVISION: high-resolution bathymetry with contour lines
• Target high-potential areas with precision
• EVENT & CATCH: log and analyze catches on nautical charts
WEATHER – Clearer and more useful
• Dedicated Weather screen
• Real-time forecasts and offline access
• Rain Radar with lightning data
• High-resolution models available in Premium plan
• Iridium GO! compatibility
CONNECTIVITY & PRECISION
• NMEA connectivity: manage and prioritize data sources
• Connect AIS, radar, autopilot, and instruments
• Latitude/longitude keyboard optimized for use at sea
• Easy coordinate entry with multiple formats
COMMUNITY & ECOSYSTEM
• COMMUNITY MAPS: share local knowledge (hazards, POIs, marinas)
• Contribute and improve charts
• Trusted by 500,000+ boaters worldwide
SUBSCRIPTION PLANS
Choose the plan that fits your needs:
• Essential: AIS Online, onboard instruments, autopilot integration via Wi-Fi NMEA
• Premium: Essential + high-resolution forecasts, Rain Radar, multiple models, comparison
• Elite: Premium + ocean layers (SST, Chlorophyll, SSH, Currents).
Monthly and annual plans available, with savings on yearly options. Core features remain available for free.
CHARTS AND DATA PLANS SUBSCRIPTIONS:

bluejetty:00014754:ios.description:
NEED ACCESS RIGHT NOW?
FORGOT SOMETHING ON YOUR COMPUTER?
Your computer, anywhere you are.
Access your Mac or PC securely from your phone or tablet – anytime, anywhere.
Whether you’re traveling, helping family, or need something urgently from your Mac or PC, Splashtop gives you fast, reliable remote access in seconds.
No complicated setup.
No lag.
Just control.
GET STARTED IN 3 STEPS
1. Install Splashtop on your phone or tablet
2. Install the free Splashtop Streamer on your computer
3. Log in and connect instantly. That’s it.
WHAT PEOPLE USE SPLASHTOP FOR
• Accessing full apps, files, and tools they left at home
• Working remotely when plans change
• Helping parents or friends fix computer issues
• Staying productive while traveling
• Getting peace of mind knowing their computer is always reachable
WHY SPLASHTOP
Splashtop is trusted by millions of users and IT teams worldwide for one reason:
it works when it matters.
• ULTRA-FAST
Smooth, high-resolution streaming with low latency.
• SIMPLE SETUP
Install, log in, and connect. No IT degree required.
• SECURE
Bank-grade encryption keeps your data and your screen private.
• RELIABLE
Works even on limited bandwidth or mobile data.
This is the same remote access technology used by professionals – made simple for personal use.
FREE VS ANYWHERE ACCESS
• FREE
Access your computer on the same local network
• ANYWHERE ACCESS (UPGRADE)
Securely connect from anywhere, on any network
When remote access becomes important – not just occasional – upgrading unlocks full freedom without changing tools.
KEY FEATURES
• Access your Mac or Windows computer anytime
• High-quality audio & video streaming
• Low-latency remote control
• Blank screen mode for privacy
• Remote webcam access
• Cross-platform support (Windows, Mac, iOS)
PERSONAL VS BUSINESS
Splashtop Personal is designed for non-commercial use.
For work or teams, try Splashtop Business for advanced features and management.
A REMOTE ACCESS TOOL YOU CAN TRUST
When your computer matters, access shouldn’t be complicated.
Splashtop gives you control, clarity, and confidence – wherever you are.
See our Terms of Service and Privacy policy at https://www.splashtop.com/terms/splashtop.

bluejetty:00063598:ios.description:

Plan and prepare for your day with KIRO 7 PinPoint Weather forecasts and alerts. Stay up to date with KIRO 7 RealTime Traffic alerts that help you plan your commute.

• KIRO 7 PinPoint Weather updates

• KIRO 7 RealTime Traffic alerts

• Access to exclusive KIRO 7 content 
The KIRO 7 News app alerts you to major local news in all areas of Western Washington, including Tacoma, Renton, Everett, Snohomish, Kirkland, Bellevue, Mercer Island, Shoreline, Redmond, Woodinville, Bremerton, Silverdale, Issaquah, Kent, Auburn, Lynnwood, Bothell, Edmonds, Lake Stevens, Marysville, Lakewood, Olympia and Puyallup.

Take complete control of your home’s comfort and energy efficiency. Download EcoNet today and transform the way you manage your home’s comfort and efficiency!

bluejetty:00154313:ios.description:
Build your very own warm and friendly intergalactic city in the cold vacuum of space!
Expect close encounters of the third, fourth, and maybe even fifth kind!
Aim to become the most desirable city in the galaxy by developing land so you can build shops and bases for your residents to live in comfort.
Build Convenience Stores and Parks to make daily life easier, or Takoyaki Stalls and Cinemas to bring in tourists and keep people entertained.
Find the perfect combination of facilities to astronomically boost the city's charm.
As you explore your new world, you'll encounter all kinds of monsters native to the planet.
Stay one step ahead of them by upgrading your Fighter Aircraft and training up your pilots.
And who knows, maybe you'll even make a few new friends along the way!
With the help of your newfound alien friends, hold outdoor events to bring in tourists from all over the galaxy!
Utilize a state-of-the-art autopilot system to help you fight through grueling space battles.
You can also give orders to your pilots to guide them to glorious victory.
So, do you think you have what it takes to build the best city in the entire galaxy?
Jump in the pilot's seat and begin your adventure into the unknown to find out!
--
Supports drag to scroll and pinch to zoom.
Search for "Kairosoft" to see all of our games, or visit us at http://kairopark.jp
Be sure to check out both our free-to-play and paid games!
Kairosoft's pixel art game series continues!
Follow us on X (Twitter) for the latest Kairosoft news and information.

bluejetty:00127702:ios.name: Song Infos - your music stats
bluejetty:00127702:ios.summary:
Your music library has been counting. Song Infos shows you the numbers.
See how often you played every song, album, artist and playlist, what you skip, and how many hours went into it. Top 10 lists, charts, a weekly recap and an AI assista
bluejetty:00127702:ios.description:
Your music library has been counting. Song Infos shows you the numbers.
See how often you played every song, album, artist and playlist, what you skip, and how many hours went into it. Top 10 lists, charts, a weekly recap and an AI assistant that answers from your own listening history. Made for the Music app and Apple Music.
WHAT YOU GET
- Play count, skip count, play time, rating, date added and last played for every song, album, artist and playlist
- Top 10 songs, albums, artists and playlists, ranked by plays or by time
- Charts by day, week, month or year, for any period you pick
- Up in the rankings: see what climbed this week
- Weekly recap: your week as a story with your top 5, as a card you can share
- Throwbacks: songs you added on this day in earlier years
- Never played: the songs, albums and artists still waiting to be heard
- Sort and filter by play count, skips, last played, date added and more
- Your home page your way: put the sections in order, hide the rest, choose the tab the app opens on
ASK YOUR LIBRARY
Ask the AI assistant "What are my most played songs?" or "Which songs do I skip the most?" and get the answer from your own library.
STAY ON TOP OF IT
- Notifications for milestones, a new number one and your weekly recap, at the time you choose
- Widgets for your home and lock screen
- Siri and Shortcuts, including an action that refreshes your library
- Share images of your stats
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. Your listening data is never sold or shared, and your history lives on your iPhone and in your own iCloud. The AI assistant answers without ever knowing who you are.
FREE AND PREMIUM
Song Infos is free to use. Premium unlocks the full statistics and more from the AI assistant, as a monthly or yearly subscription or a one time purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends. You manage them in your Apple ID settings.
Works with songs from Apple Music, the iTunes Store and your own collection. Song Infos is not affiliated with Apple.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://songinfos.de/privacy

bluejetty:00175523:ios.name: Traffic Escape!
bluejetty:00175523:ios.summary: Get ready for Traffic Escape – the ultimate mobile game where you take control of the chaotic city streets and free cars from traffic jams! Every second matters, and your decisions can make or break the game. Will you be able to get all the
bluejetty:00175523:ios.description:
Get ready for Traffic Escape – the ultimate mobile game where you take control of the chaotic city streets and free cars from traffic jams! Every second matters, and your decisions can make or break the game. Will you be able to get all the cars out of the jam?
In Traffic Escape, you’ll need to check the path for each car by looking at the arrows on top of them. Tap the cars and guide them in the right direction, making sure you avoid other vehicles along the way. Timing and strategy are everything, as even one wrong move could lead to a crash and block the way.
Each level presents a new challenge. You’ll have to think ahead and plan the order in which to move the cars. Can you figure out the best route to avoid pileups and keep everything running smoothly? The more you play, the sharper your skills will become as you navigate increasingly complex traffic jams.
The game is full of tricky situations – whether it’s a busy intersection or a narrow alley, you’ll need to stay focused and react quickly. As you progress through the levels, you’ll face bigger and more crowded jams that will test your problem-solving abilities. With a wide variety of vehicles – from small cars to large trucks – you’ll need to adapt your strategies to guide each one safely out of the mess.
Traffic Escape isn’t just about clearing the streets – it’s about mastering the art of smart maneuvering. Dodge oncoming traffic, weave through tight spaces, and avoid obstacles at every turn. With dozens of levels to conquer, the game offers a constant challenge that keeps the excitement going. Each level is more intense than the last, keeping you on your toes as you plan each move.
The game features sharp, vibrant graphics, realistic sound effects, and easy-to-use controls, making it enjoyable for both casual and experienced players. Whether you’re solving quick traffic puzzles or tackling more complex jam-packed streets, the game provides non-stop fun.
Ready to test your reflexes and strategic thinking? Take the driver’s seat in Traffic Escape, and see if you can clear the roads and guide every car to safety! With plenty of challenges, engaging gameplay, and heart-racing action, you’ll be hooked from the start. Jump in now and experience the thrill of escaping the traffic jams!

bluejetty:00022255:ios.name: AeroWeather Lite
bluejetty:00022255:ios.summary:
*** AeroWeather: for pilots, aviation enthusiasts, and everyone who is serious about the weather!
*** Current and precise weather conditions (METAR) and forecasts (TAF).
AeroWeather Lite provides quick and intuitive access to METAR and TAF
bluejetty:00022255:ios.description:
*** AeroWeather: for pilots, aviation enthusiasts, and everyone who is serious about the weather!
*** Current and precise weather conditions (METAR) and forecasts (TAF).
AeroWeather Lite provides quick and intuitive access to METAR and TAF for airports worldwide. Data can be shown in its original (raw) format or as fully decoded and easy understandable texts. AeroWeather Lite is helpful for weather preflight-briefings, but also to just get very precise weather. All weather data is cached for offline access. There are many settings for units and format of METAR/TAF available.
The app features a built-in airport database, which includes basic airport data like sunrise/sunset, twilight times, timezones etc. 
AeroWeather Lite offers built-in groups for nearby stations, today widget (pre iOS 14), and earthquakes. Depending on your needs, groups can be shown or hidden in the main list view.
METAR alert notifications** is an helpful feature to stay up-to-date. Define multiple alerts for each station with the following criteria: flight rule (US NOAA), wind speed, temperature, pressure, present weather, visibility, and ceiling (BKN and OVC). Notifications will be sent to your device if the criteria is met (e.g., when wind is greater/equal 10 kts, flight rule becomes IFR).
Dedicated METAR/TAF** access is optionally available. METAR/TAF data comes primarily from a certified ANSP (air navigation service provider) and is provided reliably and fast from our dedicated, redundant servers (indicated by blue checkmark underneath METAR/TAF).
Please consult our web-site for a full description of all features. In order to keep AeroWeather Lite free we added a small ad banner at the bottom of the screen. Consider getting AeroWeather Pro, subscribe the additional features**, or remove the ad banner through one-time unlock* to have an ad-free app.
* Additional functionality which needs to be unlocked (one-time purchase). These purchases are not transferable between Lite, Pro, and Mac.
** SUBSCRIPTIONS
Additional features which generate recurring operation costs for us will be offered within a subscription. The following features are enabled while 'First' subscription is active:
 - Dedicated METAR/TAF data source
 - Meteograms
 - Alert push notifications
 - D-ATIS (bigger US airports only)
 - Area Forecast Discussions (currently US only)
 - RVR data (US and Germany only)
 - Home Screen Widgets for METAR, Plot, Meteogram
 - Imagery and Charts (requires 'Captain' subscription)
 - SIGMETs (requires 'Captain' subscription)
 - METAR/TAF from ADS-B receiver thru GDL 90 protocol (requires 'Captain' subscription)
When using AeroWeather Lite also the following features are enabled:
 - Remove ad banner
The subscription varies in time periods (1 month, 12 months). The subscription is valid in both AeroWeather Lite and Pro. Cross app subscription support is only available if iCloud (with the same Apple ID) is enabled. Previously purchased unlock features are not affected and will work with or without subscription.
Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your account settings. A payment will be charged to your iTunes account at the end of the free trial period. Your iTunes account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. No commitment - you can cancel any time.
Pleas read the full “Subscription Terms of Use” at:
https://www.lakehorn.com/subscription-terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00159727:ios.name: Bass Pro Shops
bluejetty:00159727:ios.summary: Maybe it's your kid's first time holding a rod. Maybe deer season's coming and you can feel it. Maybe it's a camping weekend, or just a good excuse to be on the water. Wherever you're headed, the Bass Pro Shops app helps you get ready for i
bluejetty:00159727:ios.description:
Maybe it's your kid's first time holding a rod. Maybe deer season's coming and you can feel it. Maybe it's a camping weekend, or just a good excuse to be on the water. Wherever you're headed, the Bass Pro Shops app helps you get ready for it. Shop from wherever you are, see what's in stock at a store near you, and pick how you want it, delivery, pickup, or curbside at participating stores. Earn rewards on the gear you buy, catch offers made just for members, and stay a step ahead of whatever season's coming next.
FISHING  Start with a rod and reel that feel right in your hands, maybe a Johnny Morris or an Offshore Angler for the salt. Stock up on the tackle you go through most, a fresh spool of line, a new box of soft baits. Found a bait the fish couldn't leave alone last time? Reorder it in a couple taps. Want to find them a little faster? Add a fish finder from Humminbird, Garmin, or Lowrance. From your first bluegill off the dock to tournament morning, we've got you covered on bass, crappie, trout, walleye, and just about anything else with fins.
HUNTING, ARCHERY & OPTICS  Good hunts start with the boring stuff, weeks before you ever head out. Line up your RedHead camo, your boots, a pair of waders that'll keep you dry. Put a couple pairs of binoculars or rangefinders side by side, and see what other hunters had to say before you decide. When it's time, browse bows and crossbows from names you already trust, RedHead, Vortex, TenPoint. Still not sure it's right for your setup? The specs and Q&A are right there on the page.
CAMPING & THE OUTDOORS  The trip really starts the night you pack. Grab a tent and a sleeping bag that fit the whole crew, then round it out with a YETI cooler and a couple chairs for the fire. Come suppertime, a good grill or camp stove earns its keep. First family campout or deep in the backcountry, you'll find footwear, rain gear, and layers for everybody, the kids included.
BOATING & WATERSPORTS  Some of the best days start at the ramp. Keep the rig running with a Minn Kota or MotorGuide trolling motor, a fresh battery, or the marine electronics you've been eyeing from Garmin and Lowrance. Bringing the family? Grab life jackets, an Ascend kayak, or a paddleboard before the weekend gets away from you.
APPAREL & FOOTWEAR  The right layers make a long day a whole lot better. Pull on a Carhartt jacket that can take a beating, a Columbia shell when the weather turns, or an Under Armour base layer for the cold mornings. Find RedHead and The North Face for the trail, boots that hold up mile after mile, and clothing for the whole family, men, women, and kids. Dressing for the blind, the boat, or the backyard, there's something built for it.
FIND WHAT YOU NEED, FAST  Not sure what something's called? Scan a barcode in the store to pull it right up on your phone. Hands dirty? Use voice search. Filter for what's in stock, sort by ratings, and read real reviews with real photos before you spend a dime. Keep an eye out for Outfitter Picks, gear our folks stand behind, so you know it'll hold up to however hard you fish, hunt, or camp.
MAKE IT GO FURTHER  There's always something going on around here, Father's Day deals, the Spring Fishing Classic, the Fall Hunting Classic. Sign up for a CLUB card right in the app and you could start with up to $60 in points, then watch them stack up as you shop. Veterans and service members can verify through Legendary Salute for 10% off, every day. And at checkout, round up for conservation and drop in any promo codes before you pay.
THE HARD-TO-SHOP-FOR STUFF  Here's the funny thing about getting good at something. Nobody knows what to get you anymore, so they hand you a gift card and call it even. Check your balance right in the app, then finally put it toward that reel, that optic, that thing you've been circling for months.
SCAN THE CATALOG
Scan the catalog to pull up details and reviews, then tuck it into your wishlist where it'll be waiting for the right moment.

bluejetty:00015762:ios.description:
Challenge yourself and have fun with this online version of classic Sudoku. Sudoku Fever is specially designed for Sudoku lovers, different types of Sudoku puzzle (like 4x4, 6x6, Diagonal, irregular etc.), a wild range of logic and difficulty levels. Work your way up through four levels of difficulty: easy, medium, hard and expert Sudoku. Track your highest scores and best solve times over history with our statistics.
With our Daily Sudoku game you can come back each day to play a fresh new puzzle and have lots of fun. Complete the puzzle by filling every square with a number from 1 to 9 – without repeating a number across any row, column or 3x3 box.
========== Free Sudoku Puzzle Game Features ==========
• A beautiful, advanced, learnable and user-friendly Sudoku game
• Each puzzle only has one solution in our Sudoku
• Efficient, fast, and sensible game interface 
• 5 gorgeous theme packs
• 4 Difficulty Levels: Easy, Medium, Hard & Expert
• Make notes to keep track of possible numbers
• Highlight duplicates to avoid repeating numbers in a row, column and block
• Smart and unlimited hints
• Advanced game options and notes
• Improve your Sudoku skills by checking your statistics
• Fun and stunning winning animations
• Game state saved when interrupted
• Portrait or Landscape
• Left handed and Right handed option

bluejetty:00022090:ios.description:
A Eldorado, rádio dos melhores ouvintes, agora está integrada ao app do Estadão! Ouça a rádio ao vivo sem interromper sua leitura de notícias ou continue escutando em segundo plano enquanto navega pelo celular.
O aplicativo do Estadão traz as últimas notícias do Brasil e do mundo para o seu dia a dia, de forma ágil e com a credibilidade de um jornal com mais de 150 anos de história.
- Rádio Eldorado ao vivo: player de áudio integrado para você ouvir a rádio online enquanto lê as notícias do dia ou com o app em segundo plano.
- Notícias em tempo real: leia as principais notícias do Brasil e do mundo em tempo real, além de análises, artigos de especialistas e checagem de fatos.
- Todas as marcas do Estadão em um só app: navegue pelas reportagens de produtos especiais como TecMundo (tecnologia e tendências digitais), Pulsa (saúde e bem-estar), Paladar (gastronomia e receitas), Jornal do Carro (mobilidade e lançamentos) e E-Investidor (investimentos e mercado financeiro).
- Em Alta: um jeito ágil de ficar bem informado! Um feed vertical para assistir vídeos, escutar resumo de notícias e interagir com o que é destaque no Brasil e no mundo.
- Comentários: participe da conversa com outros leitores e comente nas notícias de hoje.
- Alertas de notícias: receba notificações dos acontecimentos mais importantes do dia para se manter informado onde estiver.
- Modo noturno: você escolhe se prefere sempre o modo claro, sempre o modo escuro ou seguir as configurações do seu aparelho.
- Colunistas do Estadão: siga os seus colunistas e jornalistas favoritos para não perder nenhuma análise.
- Salvar notícias: guarde as matérias e reportagens e leia na hora que quiser.
- Acessibilidade: ajuste o tamanho da fonte das notícias para uma leitura mais confortável.
- Menu Descubra: encontre conteúdos atualizados sobre notícias de política, economia, saúde, empreendedorismo, notícias internacionais, tecnologia, cultura, esportes, sustentabilidade, educação e bem-estar.
Assinantes Estadão têm acesso aos benefícios do Clube Estadão+ e podem aproveitar descontos exclusivos em produtos e serviços, cashback via Pix, sorteios de prêmios mensais e experiências exclusivas. Além disso, também podem enviar "notícias de presente" via link para quem não é assinante.
Para mais informações, leia nossos termos de uso (https://www.estadao.com.br/termo-de-uso) e política de privacidade (https://www.estadao.com.br/termo-de-uso#politica-privacidade).

bluejetty:00064855:ios.description:
Welcome to the banking that suits your lifestyle!
The upgraded Fidelity Online Banking App lets you stay in control of your finances. Manage your transactions, accounts and cards securely and easily anywhere. The App allows you perform transactions and manage your bank account(s) from your mobile device. It is secure and very simple to use.
Conduct your banking transactions while on the move with Fidelity Online Banking app and enjoy a world of convenient banking anytime, anywhere. Our redesigned app puts all the services you need at your fingertips, enabling you do the following:
• Transfer to accounts in any Bank in Nigeria
• Transfer to your other accounts in exactly one click, no token required
• Biometric/Fingerprint Authentication for easier login
• View all your accounts (Current, Savings, Fixed Deposit, Domiciliary and Card accounts)
• Personalise your profile, change your picture as desired with lovely selfies
• Maintain/Manage beneficiaries for Funds Transfer, Bills Payment and Airtime purchases
• Receive In-App messages on new features, quick tips and promotional offers.
• Top up your mobile phone or that of your family, friends and other loved ones
• Pay your bills, such as DSTV, GoTV, PHCN, mobile post-paid bills, SWIFT, Smile and more.
• Perform your Fidelity Credit Card repayments
• Generate account statement
• Search, book and pay for international and local flights
• More self-services
• Locate nearest Bank branches or ATM service points
HOW TO USE THE FIDELITY ONLINE BANKING APP
• Install the Fidelity Online Banking app
• Open the App and sign in with existing credentials
NEW? HOW TO REGISTER
If you’re 16 or above and you have your mobile number registered for our SMS alert services as well as any of our Debit Cards, click on “Sign Up Here”, and follow the onscreen instructions. A verification code will be sent to the mobile phone you have registered for your account number with us.
If you’ve got a verification, follow the onscreen steps to register. You will be required to use your Fidelity Debit Card OR visit the nearest Bank branch to activate your Online banking profile. Once done, you can start using your Online Banking account immediately.
To do much more, download the Fidelity Soft Token app on your phone and sign in with your Online banking credentials.
FOR BUSINESS ACCOUNTS
You can only use the app if you’re a sole-signatory account holder. You can’t register with your credit cards.
FIDELITY INSTANT BANKING
Fidelity also has an Instant Banking Service (*770#) which you can dial from any mobile phone linked to your account for SMS alert. The service doesn’t require internet connection.
Copyright © Fidelity Bank Plc. 2017. All rights reserved. Fidelity Online Banking is a trademark of Fidelity Bank Plc.
INFORMATION AND CUSTOMER SERVICE
For more information, please call our True Serve on +234 1 448 5252 or email True.Serve@fidelitybank.ng

- You can choose blackboard or whiteboard.
- You have various brush sizes and huge number of paint colors.
- You can draw various shapes such as line, arrow, circle, oval, square, rectangle, triangle, and polygon.
- You can type text with adjustable font size.
- You can load photo to the board.
- You can record video from your drawing screen with sound from your device microphone.
- You can save your drawing to your device.
- You can add or remove pages.
- You can set your favourite paint colors and color opacity.
- Your last drawing is always saved.
- The device screen never goes off while you are using the app.
The premium purchase removes all ads, enables adding text, loading photo, drawing shapes and grid, setting favorite paint colors, and paint color opacity.

bluejetty:00096248:ios.description:
Declutter your phone with a friendly, guided cleaner.
Cleaner Assistant helps you reclaim space and stay organized — with a simple, intuitive experience.
This lightweight app provides clear, step-by-step guidance to help you locate and remove unnecessary files and duplicate photos.
Say goodbye to storage anxiety. Let our assistant guide you through cleanup — clean convenient, not harder.
Whether you’re running low on storage or just want to tidy up, our assistant makes the process easy and effective.
FEATURES
• Photo Cleanup – Instantly find and delete duplicate or similar photos
• Video Cleanup – Identify large or redundant videos and remove them in one tap
• App Cache Clean Guide – Step-by-step instructions to manually clean app cache
USER-FRIENDLY INTERFACE
No confusing tools. No heavy features.
Just a helpful assistant making cleanup simple and stress-free.
No tech skills required. Whether you’re tech-savvy or a beginner, the guided cleanup makes everything simple.
SAFE AND SECURE
We respect your privacy — all actions are performed locally on your device with your explicit permission.
SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS

• Weekly Subscription: unlock all premium features
• Weekly Subscription with 3-day free trial: unlock all premium features
• Monthly Subscription: unlock all premium features
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00100110:ios.description:
Tired of juggling a million things? Overwhelmed by the mental load of managing family life? Mom Board is your calm command center, the central place for everything your family needs. Say goodbye to scattered notes and missed appointments, and hello to effortless organisation.
Please Note: Mom Board requires a subscription. We offer a 7-day free trial so you can experience all features before you commit.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE MOM BOARD:
SMART TO-DO & SHOPPING LISTS
Create shared grocery lists that sync instantly – no more forgotten milk on the weekly shop. Assign tasks to family members and get notified when chores are done. You can organise lists by category.
STREAMLINED MEAL BOARD
Plan your family's meals for the week in minutes. Keep all your favourite recipes in one place, from family classics to new ideas. Our AI assistant can even generate a shopping list directly from your meal plan.
ROOM FOR YOU, TOO
Mom Board isn't just about family logistics; it's also about you. Track your personal habits, log your daily mood, and set your own private goals. Because when you're taken care of, everyone benefits.
SUBSCRIPTION & TERMS
Mom Board is free to download. All new users receive a 7-day, no-obligation free trial to access all features.
After the 7-day trial, a paid subscription is required to continue using the app's features. We offer monthly and annual subscription options.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your App Store account settings after purchase.
Join the community of organised, empowered parents who are reclaiming their time and peace of mind.
Download Mom Board today and replace family chaos with organised calm.

Tired of juggling a million things? Overwhelmed by the mental load of managing family life? Mom Board is your calm command center, the central place for everything your family needs. Say goodbye to scattered notes and missed appointments, and hello to effortless organisation.

Please Note: Mom Board requires a subscription. We offer a 7-day free trial so you can experience all features before you commit.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE MOM BOARD:

SMART TO-DO & SHOPPING LISTS
Create shared grocery lists that sync instantly – no more forgotten milk on the weekly shop. Assign tasks to family members and get notified when chores are done. You can organise lists by category.

STREAMLINED MEAL BOARD
Plan your family's meals for the week in minutes. Keep all your favourite recipes in one place, from family classics to new ideas. Our AI assistant can even generate a shopping list directly from your meal plan.

ROOM FOR YOU, TOO
Mom Board isn't just about family logistics; it's also about you. Track your personal habits, log your daily mood, and set your own private goals. Because when you're taken care of, everyone benefits.

SUBSCRIPTION & TERMS

Mom Board is free to download. All new users receive a 7-day, no-obligation free trial to access all features.

After the 7-day trial, a paid subscription is required to continue using the app's features. We offer monthly and annual subscription options.

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your App Store account settings after purchase.

Join the community of organised, empowered parents who are reclaiming their time and peace of mind.

Download Mom Board today and replace family chaos with organised calm.

bluejetty:00185486:ios.description:
Designed by a Solitaire loving Mom and Daughter, Full Deck Solitaire is a beautiful card game with an easy to use user interface. Eight four uniquely different variations of Solitaire not seen in many other games keep even the most seasoned guru occupied. Statistics for each game let you know how many hours you have played, games you have won and your highest score for that game. A uniquely smart three level hint system lets you know if there are moves to play and will even shake the cards if you can’t quite see that elusive move. Smart badges on decks show you how many cards are left to be dealt from that deck. This latest update adds Daily Challenges, three guaranteed solvable games of solitaire for you to bend your mind over. Can you get all nine stars every day?
"Clearly the best solitaire game available." "Most excellent solitaire game ever!" "Excellent graphics. Realistic cards." "Love this app." "Excellent graphics and a huge selection of games makes the app feel fresh every time I play." "I love this app and all the games" "Wonderful game, great time waster!" "One of the best editions I've ever played! Excellent!" "This is a wonderful app." - Just some of the reviews for the current version! Thank you, we are really humbled by your love for the game!
The game has an option of a classic background, your own wallpaper, or a gorgeous moving video of the ocean under the Moon. 
Games include Klondike 3 Card, Klondike 1 Card, Vegas Solitaire, Freecell, Thieves Of Egypt, Forty Thieves, Red And Black, Royal Parade, Demon, Canfield, Canfield 1 Card Turn, Double Canfield, Spider 1 Suit, Spider 2 Suit, Spider 3 Suit, Spider 4 Suit, Pyramid, Tri Peaks Solitaire, Golf, Golf Around Corner, Gaps, Montana, Beleaguered Castle, Bisley, Mrs. Mop, Clock Patience, Grandfather's Clock, German Clock, Captive Queens, Scorpion, Scorpion 2, Wasp, Three Blind Mice, Osmosis, Yukon, Russian Solitaire, Chinese Solitaire, Australian Patience, Fortress, Pyramid Golf, Aces Up, Miss Milligan, Demons and Thieves, La Belle Lucie, Trefoil, The Fan, Super Flower Garden, Storehouse, Cruel Solitaire, Baker's Dozen, Spanish Patience, Castles in Spain, Portuguese Solitaire, Good Measure, Baker's Game, Eight Off, Penguin Solitaire, Seahaven Towers, Rank And File, Number Ten, Lady Jane, Zerline, Double Klondike, Double Klondike 1 Card, Osmosis By The Book, Eagle Wing, Texas Fury and Texas Patience. A few of these classic games are unique to Full Deck Solitaire! 
And now with daily challenges, unique solvable puzzles that will challenge you every day.
Please write or visit our support page if you are having any problems at all. We want you to love this game!

bluejetty:00163101:ios.name: Kubios HRV - Daily Readiness
bluejetty:00163101:ios.summary:
Heart rate variability (HRV) based daily readiness and custom HRV recordings.
Kubios HRV app uses scientifically validated heart rate variability (HRV) algorithms (used by scientists all over the world) to provide reliable information abou
bluejetty:00163101:ios.description:
Heart rate variability (HRV) based daily readiness and custom HRV recordings.
Kubios HRV app uses scientifically validated heart rate variability (HRV) algorithms (used by scientists all over the world) to provide reliable information about your wellbeing and daily readiness. To make HRV measurements with the app, you need a Bluetooth heart rate (HR) sensor, such as Polar H10. Kubios HRV app has two modes of operation:
1) Readiness Measurement Mode monitors changes in your daily readiness status. By doing short (1-5 min), controlled resting HRV measurements regularly, you will receive reliable information about your physiological recovery and/or stress, how it changes from day to day, and how your HRV values compare with normal population values. Readiness monitoring is used by professional athletes in training optimization but can also be used by sports enthusiasts or anyone interested in their wellbeing, as it provides objective information about overall bodily stress as well as cardiovascular health.
2) Custom Measurement Mode, designed for researchers, health and wellbeing professionals, and sport scientists, conducts various types of HRV recordings. This measurement mode supports test-subject management, short- and longer-term measurements, live data acquisition, as well as event markers. Since the app is built with Polar mobile SDK, it can read live data from Polar sensors, including electrocardiogram (ECG) and heart beat interval (RR) data from Polar H10 sensors and live photoplethysmogram (PPG) and inter-pulse interval (PPI) data from optical Polar OH1 and Verity Sense sensors. Thus, when used together with these Polar sensors, the custom measurement mode provides an easy-to-use, light-weight, affordable way to obtain ECG, PPG and RR/PPI recordings. Regarding RR recording, the app also supports other Bluetooth HR sensors available on the market. Kubios HRV software license, which supports this measurement mode is required to store measurement data.
HRV is a reliable measure of autonomic nervous system (ANS). It tracks the beat-to-beat changes in RR interval arising from the continuous regulation of heart rate by the sympathetic and parasympathetic branches of the ANS. Kubios HRV analysis algorithms have achieved gold-standard status in scientific research, and our software products are used at roughly 1200 universities in 128 countries. The main HRV parameters include the parasympathetic nervous system (PNS) and sympathetic nervous system (SNS) indexes, the computations of which have been optimized, using a large reservoir of scientific research results, to provide accurate interpretation of recovery and stress.

bluejetty:00015394:ios.description:
Learner Permit Test Victoria 2026 gets you ready for the Learners Practice Test in Victoria!
Top Features:
#1. Clear and Helpful Explanations
Practice more than 500 official questions from VicRoads, and practice the driver knowledge test with detailed explanations to get you ready for the learners practice test. Our questions cover all the topics of the Learners test such as General knowledge, Alcohol and Drugs, Fatigue and Defensive Driving, Intersections, Traffic Lines / Lanes, Negligent Driving, Pedestrians, Seat Belts and Restraints, Speed Limits, and Traffic Signs.
#2. Real questions and practice tests
Our app reproduces the same conditions as the real exam you will face at the VicRoads learner test centre. You will get 45 questions with 3 suggestions. You need at least 41 correct answers (with at least 12/15 on General Knowledge and 29/30 on Road Safety questions). Be confident that you will get your drivers license with our app.
#3. Suitable for everyone
Learners Practice Test 2026 is suitable for all VIC candidates. If you want to get your learner driver licence, you will have to attend the driver knowledge tests and take the DTK as well as the Hazard Perception Test (HPT) which is mandatory in most states in Australia.
Key Highlights:
• Practice more than 500 questions from the VicRoads Learners guide.
• All explanations and scored practice tests.
• An excellent addition to the official myLearners official learning app.
• Study with thousands of Australian drivers who want to get their Learners !
• 40 free practice test questions with 500 more to unlock.
• Get instant results after each exam question.
• A complete app to get your drivers license.
• Detailed dashboard to identify your strengths and weaknesses.
• Don’t need to use a random Australian driver knowledge test class C car app anymore!
• Dark mode to study for the Learners test at night!
Why choose Learners Practice Test 2026 app ? 
• We make the drivers test easy.
• We help you pass the driver knowledge test quickly and get your learner license !
• We help every VIC candidate to get their DKT.
• We complement the official myLearners official learning app.
• We give you the tools to get a perfect score to pass the learners test.
• We cover all topics of the DKT test such as negligent driving, pedestrians, seat belts and restraints.
Contact Us:
Visit Our Website: https://learner-permit-victoria.pineapplestudio.com.au
Email: support-mobile@pineapplestudio.com.au
Connect on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/pineapplecoding/
Subscription Options:
Learner Permit Test Victoria 2026 offers a single subscription to suit everyone's needs. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Accounts will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of your selected plan below:
- One-week plan: AUD 5.99
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings on the device. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy policy: https://learner-permit-victoria.pineapplestudio.com.au/learner-practice-test-privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://learner-permit-victoria.pineapplestudio.com.au/learner-practice-test-terms-conditions.html
Good luck with your learners practice test and getting your learner licence !
The Pineapple Studio Team

It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with CMEFCU Mobile:
-Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
-Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount.
-Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend.
-Transfer money between your accounts.
-Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back.
-Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it.
-View and save your monthly statements.
-Find branches and ATMs near you.
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices.

bluejetty:00017462:ios.description:
Word2Art brings word cloud creation, word frequency analysis and text cleanup together in one creative tool. Turn keywords, phrases or frequency tables into personalized word clouds for classroom presentations, work reports, reading notes and poster designs.
CREATE PERSONALIZED WORD CLOUDS
Enter words or phrases, or import a word frequency table. Combine fonts, colors, text angles, shapes and illustrations to create your own design. Emphasize important words with sizes based on input order or word frequency.
ANALYZE AND ORGANIZE TEXT
Analyze Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean text locally on your device. Use stopword filtering, custom word lists and editable frequencies to refine your keywords, then export the results as CSV.
CLEAN UP TEXT
Remove HTML tags, Markdown syntax, links, emoji and other content as needed. Tidy up whitespace, change English letter case and apply replacement rules to streamline text preparation.
SAVE, EXPORT AND KEEP EDITING
Save artwork to Mine and reopen it whenever you want to edit. Export as JPG, PNG, SVG or PDF. Use the dedicated .w2a project format to save settings and assets, then import the file to continue creating.
CREATE OFFLINE, SYNC ACROSS DEVICES
Text analysis, cleanup and word cloud generation all run on your device. Available on iPhone, iPad and Mac, with iCloud syncing for saved artwork.

bluejetty:00079674:ios.name: Patterning 3 : Drum Machine
bluejetty:00079674:ios.summary:
Circular beats, off the grid.
Nearly every drum machine and DAW starts you on the same 16-step grid, where the same patterns are always the easiest to reach. Patterning 3 starts you on a circle instead. New ideas come quickly, and you hear
bluejetty:00079674:ios.description:
Circular beats, off the grid.
Nearly every drum machine and DAW starts you on the same 16-step grid, where the same patterns are always the easiest to reach. Patterning 3 starts you on a circle instead. New ideas come quickly, and you hear rhythms the grid would never suggest. Sketch a simple beat in seconds, or go deep.
Every track is a loop on the circle:
• Give each loop its own length and hear polymeters drift in and out of phase.
• Rotate a loop to move its downbeat and find a new groove.
• Add trigger conditions, probability and modulation to build variation into the loop.
“Patterning beats any hardware drum machine for polyrhythms and evolving patterns.” — Sound On Sound
“10/10” — MusicTech
“A UI masterpiece.” — App Store review
Patterning has been in development since 2015, and the original was a runner-up for Apple's iPad App of the Year. It's designed by a composer who has taught experimental electronic music for twenty years.
CONNECT TO YOUR GEAR
• Load it as an AUv3 plugin in Logic, Ableton Live, AUM and more, or use it as a standalone app. Multichannel output and MIDI in supported hosts.
• Runs on iPad and Apple silicon Macs.
• Sync with Ableton Link, MIDI Clock or your host.
• Export audio, MIDI files or a complete Ableton Live Set, or drag MIDI straight into your DAW.
• Start a beat in Patterning on your iPhone and keep going here: your iPhone projects open in Patterning 3.
NEW IN 3.3
• Trigger conditions: play a step only on certain passes of the loop.
• Undo and redo, with a history of every change.
• Shift: move a loop's steps one step at a time.
• Pattern tiles: switch patterns in full screen from a row of mini previews.
GO DEEPER
• Loops up to 512 steps, with rotation, auto-rotate and playback modes.
• Parametric swing: from slightly off-kilter to wildly erratic, drunken grooves.
• Modulation: LFOs, randomization and velocity on most parameters.
• Fill patterns: switch to a fill version of any pattern for transitions.
• Multiple timelines: build full songs, loop sections and more.
• Automation layers: touch a parameter to see and edit its automation on the circle.
• FX track: automate and modulate effect parameters over time.
• Sampler: pitch, envelope, filter, sends and pan for every track.
• Effects: reverb, delay, EQ and a master compressor, plus distortion and ring modulation on every track.
• Record, quantize and nudge: record on the drum pads, keep your groove with the nudge layer, or quantize closer to the grid.
• 800+ drum kits from the Patterning community.
…and more.

bluejetty:00116266:android.description:
As the environment deteriorates and resources become scarce, creatures of all sizes are engaged in a fierce battle for survival. As a single-celled organism, you control a mysterious magical orb, hunt monsters, collect rare and potent biological components, and evolve into a mighty being destined to rule the island!
【Idle Gameplay, Easy Rewards 】
Dive into the world of idle clicker gaming, where automatic battles work for you. There's no need to grind for powerful components, just sit back and enjoy the excitement of evolution in action!
【Free Evolution, DIY Your Monsters】
Start as a basic organism and choose your evolution path freely and experience unique skills and styles. Grow and survive in the best way possible, and create your own one-of-a-kind being.
【Collect Exotic Resources, Build Your Home】
In an era of alien tribes, gather bizarre plants and seeds, and get into biotech by training fruit companions for combat, finding ancient relics, and building your very own home.
【Socialize and Co-op Boss Fights 】
Meet new friends, share adventure tips, and join a tribe to work together with other monsters to defeat powerful bosses.
Join us now and embark on this extraordinary survival adventure together!

 - Turn any material into quizzes for exam, homework, and GPA prep

 - Anyone preparing for the MCAT, SAT, NCLEX, bar, and more
 STUDY ANY SUBJECT
 Biology, chemistry, anatomy, history, geography, math, psychology, languages, medical terminology — if you can photograph it or paste it, Poki can turn it into flashcards.

bluejetty:00178141:ios.description:
Biblioteca en streaming especializada en obras clásicas en dominio público y obras contemporáneas autorizadas para la difusión sin fines de lucro. Libre de avisos publicitarios, con más de 50.000 títulos, música, arte, audiolibros, múltiples diccionarios, idiomas y versiones enfrentadas, comentarios de especialistas, entre otras opciones. Lector de libros offline en formato EPUB, PDF, AZW y MOBI.
- Lee libros offline en formato EPUB, PDF, AZW y MOBI.
- Escucha los libros en voces naturales y profesionales.
- Lee diferentes versiones e idiomas del libro, comparándolos página a página.
- Observa miles de imágenes, comentarios y notas relacionadas a las páginas.
- Escucha la Música compuesta alrededor de obras literarias.
- Encuentra el significado de todas las palabras en más de 70 diccionarios haciendo click sobre ellas.
- Selecciona el tamaño de letra y asigna el modo nocturno, para una mejor experiencia de lectura.
- Investiga y realiza búsquedas especializadas por temas, autores, países, géneros y al interior de cada uno de los libros.
- Crea una biblioteca personalizada con obras favoritas, escritos propios y últimas lecturas.
- Recibe recomendaciones de diversos personajes que incitan a leer y escuchar.
- Analiza el uso del vocabulario en cada una de las obras.
- Comparte con amigos cualquier elemento, personalizando sus mensajes.
- Accede a la versión para computadores de escritorio (https://www.ellibrototal.com), en ella podrás ver todos los servicios de la biblioteca, tus lecturas recientes, notas y favoritos estarán sincronizados en todos los dispositivos.

bluejetty:00070859:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00070859:ios.description:
In an age of dark fantasy, Heroes from the three great factions face off in an endless struggle for power and survival. Whose power will you embrace: the mystic Vampires, the brutal Werewolves, or the cunning Humans?
Heroes of the Dark (HotD) is an RPG game set in a grim Victorian world full of forsaken lands, arcane mysteries, and vile monsters. To survive, you must recruit, equip, and train Heroes from each faction, for only one who can master their combined might will prevail in 5v5 RPG battles and prevent the rise of a grim fate from befalling the land of Tenebris.
**A DARK TALE TO CHALLENGE YOUR HEROES**
Long ago, a great war ended with the moon shattering in the heavens. Its shards rained upon the world, granting the Werewolves untold strength. Thus empowered, the Werewolves drove the Vampires from the land and across the sea to Tenebris. In time, the outcast Vampires rebuilt their society by subjugating the local Humans to their will. But over the years, the Humans forged secret technologies to overthrow their undead masters… and just as the first uprisings began, the Werewolves arrived once more on the Vampires’ doorstep.
Now, as the carnage has reached its peak, a different threat has emerged, one capable of obliterating all three factions from the world. The only hope for any of them is to somehow unite the factions and destroy a legendary weapon hidden within an ancient tower.
**TACTICAL 5V5 COMBAT WITH IMMORTAL HEROES**
As you journey across Tenebris, dozens of immortal Heroes from all three factions will join your cause. Each has their own unique combat style and skills, like Kha’alil the Werewolf Tank, Lucretia the Vampire Assassin, or Altinay the Human Support.
Assembling an effective role-playing team takes more than throwing your strongest Heroes together. You must make the most of their physical, magical, and support skills, discover powerful synergies, and devise a battle plan that can unleash unspeakable devastation upon any foe!
**A REAL-TIME RPG ADVENTURE**
The action never stops in HotD! Day and night, your might grows as Heroes train to level up and explore dungeons to find mighty relics. You can send them on a quest now and check back later to see what weapons, armor, and treasures they’ve unearthed.
And when the going gets tough, the tough call on friends and allies to help defeat even the most massive foe.
**EXPLORE YOUR EPIC MAGIC MANSION**
Your epic adventure begins from within a gothic mansion filled with dark magic waiting to be unlocked. As your power grows, you will unlock rooms, allowing you to unite more Heroes of darkness to your cause and granting you additional powers to bestow upon your champions.
**FIND FRIENDS AND CHALLENGE RIVALS IN A MULTIPLAYER ADVENTURE**
As you team up with other HotD players, you can challenge rival teams to 5v5 showdowns where only the most skilled and well equipped players can win! Great rewards await those who claim victory, but only one can claim the ultimate power: “The Heart of Tenebris.”
Heroes of the Dark is available in 12 different languages: English, Русский, Español, Deutsch, Français, Português, Italiano, العربية , 한국어, 简体中文, 繁體中文 and 日本語.

* Complete bible study app, besides bible translations, also includes commentaries, Strong Number c
bluejetty:00014183:ios.description:
In addition to all features of "Handy Bible"(Search "Handy Bible"), "Handy Bible Pro" also adds: 
----------------------------------------- 
* Complete bible study app, besides bible translations, also includes commentaries, Strong Number concordance and definition, dictionaries, maps, devotions and books. Can use iOS built-in speech synthesizer to read all bible translations.(optional purchase, includes English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew, Greek, etc. 37 languages).
* Universal app (support both iPhone and iPad); it also supports both the portrait and the landscape mode; no internet connection needed
* Add Apple Watch Support
* As user's review-"No other Bible app allows you to do so much on one page" - Unlike other bible apps on the market, can only read bible, commentary or dictionary - one at a time, "Handy Bible" provides very unique feature - "floating", "Movable" and "half-transparent" bibe/commentary/Dictionary/Personal Note reading window on top of bible text, so that you can read all these texts at the same time. 
* The only app to open up to 4 bible windows(others can only have up to 2) - each bible window can adjust its own size and assign its own bible translation text. And moreover, you can assign "Bible Parallel" to one of these 4 bible windows. These features allow to have all bible translations viewable on the same screen without flipping back and forth. Plus the above "float" commentary, dictionary, personal note and bible search popup window, you can have all kinds of bible study contents shown and viewable on the same screen. 
* Powerful note(have both scripture and topical "Tag" notes) editing - the only app to allow "rich text editing" and add links to any bible study content within the app - supports "rich text editing" including "Bold", "Italic", "Underline", "Strike Through", "Font color/highlight/size", "Ordered or unordered list", etc. In addition, you can insert "Tag" shortcut that links any bible study content to your note. Also, you can copy web page link and paste into your note. Video demo: http://facebook.com/handybible
* Powerful and rich SQL db search features: search for any text within seconds inside the Bible or any text in your own personal notes; it can also filter OT and NT books. Can also use "AND" or "OR" (words separated by space, or use begin-end double quotes to search as a whole phrase) to narrow down the search. Also support Regular Expression for more complex and specific search.
* Unlike other apps, can only show search result page by page, Search Result will be presented with all scriptures found in order by a Book with Book Index for easy access and the frequency of that serach strings within each Book. 
* Commentaries: MHCC,JFB,Clarke,Barnes,Gill,TSK free domain commentaries included. A icon will be shown if available for that bible verse. Like NOTE window, this Commentary Window is also floating, hafl-transparent and movable so can have it on all the time while reading bible text. Eaily switch to next available Commentary with Next/Previous button. 
* Compare Translations: show all available bible translations within one single window
* Dictionary: includes AmTrac,Easton,Fausset,ISBE,Morrish,Nave,SC,Smiths,TCR. Search any exact or partial of keyword. 
* Strong Number Concordance: includes Hebrew/Greek Definitions and References. Search and look up each Strong Number. 
* Bible with Strong Number: includes KJV with Strong Number text. For each Strong Number, can have a floating window to show its definition. 
* Bible Maps/Art.
* Reading Plan: create personal daily bible reading plan based on your choices of bible books and duration. Includes 4 examples of bible reading plans.
* All the above can be exported from Copy/Email. 
* Include: ASV,BBE,DARBY,ISV,KJV,NHEB,WEB,YLT bible text. Also can purchase ESV, Message, NASB, NET bible/notes, NKJV, etc.
* Useful Tips/FAQ: http://vincentchiu.com/iphone_apps
* Great user rating/review(4.8/5.0)

bluejetty:00047013:ios.description:
TPNB Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with TPNB Bank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the TPNB Bank app, you must be enrolled as a TPNB Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00061444:ios.description:
SQLPro for MySQL is a lightweight but powerful MySQL and MariaDB database client, which allows quick and simple access to MySQL/MariaDB Servers including cloud services such as Amazon RDS, Microsoft Azure and Digital Ocean.
Some of the great features include:
+ Intellisense/SQL autocompletion.
+ Syntax highlighting. 
+ Tabbed based interface for an optimal user experience (iPad).
+ Support for executing multiple queries at once. 
+ Quick access to tables, columns and more. 
+ Dark & Light themes which can be switched manually or automatically adjusted by your devices brightness.
+ Netbios support.
+ Export options including CSV, XML and JSON.
+ SSH Tunnelling (password authentication & private key auth).
SQLPro for MySQL works with MySQL & MariaDB. It will not work with other database servers such as MSSQL, PostgresSQL or Oracle.

bluejetty:00015693:ios.summary:
Turn your iPad into your personal interactive whiteboard!
ShowMe allows you to record voice-over whiteboard tutorials and share them online. It’s an amazingly simple app that anyone can use, no matter how young or old!
INTUITIVE AND POWE
bluejetty:00015693:ios.description:
Turn your iPad into your personal interactive whiteboard!
ShowMe allows you to record voice-over whiteboard tutorials and share them online. It’s an amazingly simple app that anyone can use, no matter how young or old!
INTUITIVE AND POWERFUL
- Record your ShowMe tutorial right away — no manuals or complicated menus needed
- Drop in images onto the whiteboard
- Easily switch between drawing and erasing (as well as pausing and playing) to make your ShowMe flow from concept to concept
- You can make your ShowMe as long or as short as it needs to be, and record as many ShowMe’s as you want. Go nuts!
- Once you’re finished recording, upload your ShowMe to share with the community (or keep it private if you prefer)
- Discover awesome tutorials created by other members of the ShowMe community
A VARIETY OF USES
- Easily explain a range of topics from math to chemistry to music theory to basket weaving.
- Add ShowMe’s to your Do-It-Yourself blog
- Attach a personal message to any travel photos you want to share
- Diagram offensive and defensive strategies for sports
- Grade student work with commentary explaining the reasoning behind their performance
- Use ShowMe as an interactive whiteboard substitute
Implement a “flipped classroom”
- Showcase your ShowMes online and share your knowledge with your students, friends, family, or the world!
FEATURES
- Voice-record
- Multiple brush colors
- Enter text
- Pause and erase
- Import pictures from your photo library, built-in camera, or web image search
- Import documents as pictures from Dropbox, or Google drive
- Create video from any document
- Unlimited lesson length
- Free to upload and share your recordings with friends
- Easy embedding for sharing anywhere
- Manage students with Groups
USING GROUPS
"Groups" allows teachers to share their ShowMes and interact with students privately. A teacher with ShowMe Premium subscription can create an unlimited amount of groups and invite their students. Students can join groups for free!
SHOWME PREMIUM
ShowMe Premium is an auto-renewing monthly or yearly subscription which unlocks all ShowMe features. For just $9.99 a month or $89.99 a year:
- Upload up to 300 hours of ShowMes
- Post privately
- Create study groups
- Markup and share any documents in groups
- Import documents into ShowMe
- Search and import images from the web
- Download your video files
- Create student accounts
- Create courses
COURSES
With "Courses" ShowMe creators can organize multiple ShowMe lessons and tutorials into one comprehensive lesson plan.
PAID COURSES
The ShowMe Marketplace allows premium users to earn extra income by posting paid premium courses for other educators or students within the ShowMe community.
AS SEEN ON
- TechCrunch
- Business Insider
- Numerous teacher blogs and educational blogs
WE’RE HERE FOR YOU
The ShowMe team is small, nimble, and quick to respond to suggestions/requests. Follow us on twitter at @showmeapp. Or feel free to drop us a line at support@showme.com with any questions, concerns, or stories about how you’re using ShowMe.
LEGAL

Terms & Conditions: http://www.showme.com/termsofuse
