bluejetty:00145986:ios.description:
Welcome to 99subs - the simple way to stop surprise renewals and take back control of your money. Think of it as your personal subscription tracker and manager in one clean, easy-to-use app. Add every recurring payment you have - Netflix, gym, phone bill, cloud storage, public transport pass, meal kits - and let 99subs handle the rest.
How it works is simple:
• Enter the start date, renewal period, and price for each service.
• Pick from hundreds of premade services, or create a custom one in seconds.
• Get smart notifications before a charge hits so you have time to act.
• See your total subscription spend for the current month at a glance.
Why people love 99subs:
• Track subscriptions without spreadsheets or guesswork. Clear timelines show what renews next and what it costs.
• Manage subscriptions confidently. Pause, switch, or cancel with intention instead of reacting after the bill arrives.
• Never forget free trials again. We remind you ahead of time so you can decide to keep it or end it.
• Find hidden drains. Be mindful about long-forgotten subscriptions and stop small charges from snowballing.
• Build your own. If it isn’t in our catalog, add a custom subscription with the details you need.
• Budget better. Real-time totals reveal how much you’ll spend this month, helping you plan and save.
Designed for everyday life.
Student, family, freelancer - 99subs gives you clarity. All renewing costs in one place, so you always know where money goes - and when.
Stay ahead of renewals.
Timely reminders arrive before each renewal. That means no more “I forgot to cancel” moments. If you choose to end a service, use the handy subscription cancel note and keep a record of your decisions.
Your data, your choice.
We focus on the essentials so you can organize subscriptions quickly without getting technical. Add only the details that matter and update them anytime. No ads - just a focused experience to help you save.
Get more from the subscriptions you keep.
Plan upgrades, downgrades, or seasonal pauses. Compare prices, track trial end dates, and actually use what you pay for. Keep what brings value, drop what doesn’t, and watch your monthly total come down.
Key highlights
• Subscription tracker with a clear timeline
• Fast setup with hundreds of popular services
• Custom subscriptions for anything else
• Smart alerts before renewals and free trials end
• Monthly total for all subscription spending
• Notes, categories, and flexible renewal periods
• Clean, friendly design with zero clutter
Take charge today.
Download 99subs and track subscriptions the easy way. See everything in one place, avoid surprise charges, and keep more of your money. Manage subscriptions with confidence, stay on top of free trials, and decide what deserves a place in your budget. 99subs makes it simple to manage subscriptions your way - and it feels great to be in control.

bluejetty:00031001:ios.summary:

Our app guides your breathing with calming sounds and animations to guide your inhal
bluejetty:00031001:ios.description:
Pocket Breath Coach is your personal tool for reducing anxiety, backed by real science. We make it easy to practice deep breathing exercises for anxiety. 
Our app guides your breathing with calming sounds and animations to guide your inhales and exhales, making it easy to breathe slowly and deeply.
You can select from many breathing patterns, such as "Box Breathing" and "4-7-8 Breathing", each one proven to relieve anxiety, but you can also customize the exercises to your liking. For example, if you find that a certain pattern is too slow or too fast, you can adjust it to suit your needs. You can also customize the sounds and animations to ones that help you feel the most relaxed.
By leveraging the power of deep breathing exercises, Pocket Breath Coach allows you to reclaim control from anxiety and stress. It will help calm you in those moments when panic sets in, and also as a daily tool to gradually lower your overall stress levels.
POCKET BREATH COACH FEATURES
CUSTOMIZABLE BREATHING EXERCISES
- Experience a wide array of guided breathing exercises like Box Breathing, 4-7-8, 4-6 breathing and many more
- Customize the rhythm of your breathing exercises to your comfort
- Control the inhale, exhale, and holds to .1s precision
- Save your favorites and recently played
USE SOUNDS AND ANIMATIONS TO GUIDE YOUR BREATHING
- Easily following the breathing exercises with calming sounds and animations
- Close your eyes and allow the calming sounds to guide your breathing 
- Sound continues playing in the background, so you can lock your phone or use other apps while following the slow, rhythmic breathing exercises
- Choose from a variety of relaxing nature sounds, instruments, and bells
- Use the animations to easily stay on the right pace
SLEEP TIMER
- Fall asleep while maintaining the breathing patterns
- Start the sleep timer, and at the end the sound will gradually fade out
SCHEDULE DAILY REMINDERS
- Set up push notifications to remind you to do your favorite breathing exercises
- Schedule notifications at your preferred day and time
By adopting a regular practice of breathing exercises for anxiety, you can cultivate a stronger sense of inner calm, better manage your stress levels, and enhance your overall wellbeing. The moment to reclaim your peace is now. Download Pocket Breath Coach today and embark on your journey towards a life with less anxiety and more calmness.

bluejetty:00186405:ios.description:
My Institute is a one stop institute management technology platform for tutors, students and parents to manage their day-to-day classroom related activities efficiently. My Institute app aims to make the lives of tutors easier by helping them in managing their institute so that they can focus entirely on the teaching methodology.
Using the My Institute app, tutors can create unlimited batches and add unlimited students to the same. Tutors can keep a regular track of students’ attendance and allot assignments . The app comes with a complete management system, using which a tutor can send auto reminders to students and their parents. Tutors can also manage all the enquires the institute get within the same app using the Enquiry Management tool.
Students can request batch access, ask doubts with their tutors on one-on-one chat or with their peers on group chat, submit assignments, and attempt online tests.
Unbox the complete institute management solution with My Institute!

bluejetty:00085654:ios.description:
Love unique art and ready to create?
Generate and transform images with ease using our AI-powered app that brings your creative visions to life. Whether you want to add new details to a simple picture, create a personalized piece from scratch, or apply a variety of artistic styles, this app has everything you need. 
Main Features:
- Image generation with prompts
- Large collection of art styles 
- AI picture reworking 
- Easy-to-use photo editor mode
- Saving images to the library
Bring Your Ideas to Life
Discover your creativity by generating images directly from your own prompts. Simply describe what you want to see, and let the AI work its magic. No matter if you’re looking for an abstract piece or a photorealistic portrait, the app can generate images as you ask.
Explore the Styles Variety
Choose from an extensive collection of pre-designed styles to create a new piece of AI art. Be it a cartoon-like design, watercolor-inspired visuals, or a photorealistic rendering, there’s a style for every need. Plus, the ability to combine multiple styles together gives you even more freedom to create something truly unique.
Transform Your Photos
Take your existing photos to the next level with the app's AI-powered reworking capabilities. Want to add new elements, change the style, or simply enhance your image with a fresh look? Our app provides a way to give your images a personalized touch. 
Give Your Images a Polished Look
Refine your images with a full suite of editing tools. Crop your photos, adjust the blur, or apply filters, while the app provides everything you need to perfect your visuals. Fine-tune elements like brightness, contrast, saturation, and temperature to suit your style.
With its diverse features and creative potential, our app opens up a world of possibilities for anyone looking to create unique pieces. Whatever task you have in mind — enhancing an existing photo or generating something entirely new — the app offers the tools you need to make your vision a reality.
SUBSCRIPTION
Subscribe and get right now: 
1. Unlimited generating
2. Advanced editing tools
3. Exclusive art styles
4. Regular content updates
Make your life easier with premium access: 
- Paid subscription is divided into 3 types: weekly, monthly and annual. 
- The cost of a weekly paid subscription is $9.99. Monthly - $16.99. Annual - $49.99. 
- The amount will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. 
- You can cancel a subscription or trial period at any time, but no later than 24 hours before the end of the current period. OTHERWISE it will be automatically renewed. 
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. 
- After payment, you can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings. 
- Any unused portion of the free period will be forfeited upon purchase of the subscription. 
- Please read our privacy policy and EULA 
https://appenvisions.com/privacy.html 
https://appenvisions.com/eula.html

bluejetty:00015348:ios.name: Kids Car, Trucks - Puzzles
bluejetty:00015348:ios.summary: A fun puzzle game for toddlers and kids from ages 1 to 6 featuring 16 cartoon cars and construction vehicles such as race car, police car, school bus, tractor, fire engine, ambulance, garbage truck, excavator, transmixer, bulldozer and more
bluejetty:00015348:ios.description:
A fun puzzle game for toddlers and kids from ages 1 to 6 featuring 16 cartoon cars and construction vehicles such as race car, police car, school bus, tractor, fire engine, ambulance, garbage truck, excavator, transmixer, bulldozer and more in 20 shape & tangram puzzles!
When a puzzle is completed children are rewarded with a variety of fun celebrations and interactions such as balloon popping.
The fun matching activities help improve visual perception, knowledge of shapes & develop fine motor skills by dragging and dropping puzzle pieces to match their holes. Perfect for preschoolers.
Features
• Kids Safe, please see our Privacy Policy
• Original high quality cartoon art drawn by professional children's book illustrator
• Four different vehicle groups: Cars, Trucks, Construction & Community Vehicles
• Automatic advance to the next puzzle
• Three different puzzle styles with increasing difficulty levels
• Interface & touch controls designed for toddlers
• Press & hold button to limit menu access to parents
• Option to hide/show locked puzzles to prevent accidental purchases
The first 4 puzzles are free, all of the remaining ones can be unlocked easily via single in-app purchase. Once unlocked, there are no further in-app purchases or other dialogs.
If you have previously purchased simply tap on "Restore Unlock Purchase" button in settings menu (gear icon on the top right corner) to unlock puzzles on all of your iOS devices.
PRIVACY POLICY
We take privacy very seriously, this app:
Does not contain ads
Does not contain integration with social networks
Does not contain web links
Does not use analytics / data collection tools
Does contain a single in-app purchase to unlock full version
ATTENTION 
If you don't want your child to accidentally upgrade to the full version, make sure to disable in-app purchases via the settings menu of your device.
If you are representing an Educational Institution or simply prefer to purchase full version without in-app purchases, "Educational Edition" of this app is also available.
WE VALUE YOUR FEEDBACK
If you like our app, please take a minute to rate and review it.
If you have any questions or need help, please reach us at http://www.pixelenvision.com/support/ or by sending an e-mail to support@pixelenvision.com

bluejetty:00157333:ios.description:
This is a casual game that perfectly combines classic match-3 gameplay with rich card collection and other merge elements. Whether you are a strategy enthusiast who likes to challenge yourself or a creative player who is keen on collecting, it can bring you endless fun and surprises.
[Core gameplay: puzzle matching challenge]
1. Classic match-3: Complete the level goal by matching three or more identical elements and enjoy a relaxing and pleasant gaming experience.
2. Multiple modes: Provide multiple modes such as time-limited challenges and moving obstacles, allowing you to exercise your reaction speed and thinking ability in different situations.
[Card collection: create exclusive illustrations]
1. Massive cards: There are more than hundreds of unique cards in the game.
2. Rarity unlocking: Continuously explore and collect rare cards to gradually enrich your collection illustrations.
[Guild system: meet like-minded friends]
1. Join a guild: Form a powerful guild with global players and exchange experiences here.
2. Guild activities: Regularly held team missions and other activities can not only enhance the friendship between members, but also win generous rewards.
[Ranking function: competition and honor]
1. Personal ranking: According to your performance at each level, the personal record ranking is updated in real time to encourage you to constantly break through yourself.
2. Season rewards: After each season, precious props and titles are issued according to the ranking to show your strength.
Start a wonderful journey that combines puzzle matching challenges, card collection, and social interaction! More exciting content is waiting for you to discover, come and join our vibrant game world!

bluejetty:00136602:ios.description:
Discover AI Character from around the globe and speak with them to discover their capabilities.
From your morning cup of tea to brushing your teeth at night, AI Character has the conversations to make your day. Whether you’re a chatterbox, a tech fanatic or simply looking for a laugh, there’s something for everyone. Enjoy a never-ending stream of AIs you’ll love to chat with.
With the official mobile app for AI Character you can:
- Chat with ultra-realistic AI personalities
- Enjoy unlimited free messaging (and no ads!)
- Discover millions of user-created Characters
- Use advanced creation tools to create anything you need
【Real-Time AI Character Interaction for Immersive Experiences】
Powered by the most capable AI models, AI Character provides an immersive and interactive experience, allowing users to converse with diverse AI personalities. Each interaction is tailored to be engaging, making every conversation with AI characters a unique and captivating journey.
【Effortless Creation of Unique AI Characters】
Users can craft characters that truly represent their vision, adding a personalized touch to their digital interactions. Whether for fun, storytelling, or unique digital presence, Rochat provides the tools to bring distinctive virtual personas to life effortlessly.
【Unlock the Power of AI, Easy and Efficient】
AI Character offers a suite of creator tools, designed to not only inspire your creativity but also assist in your creative process. These tools can help you brainstorm ideas, generate written content, and even create visual artwork. Whether you're working on a writing project, developing graphic designs, or exploring artistic concepts, AI Character provides a versatile and innovative approach to creativity, blending cutting-edge AI technologies to support and enhance your artistic endeavors.
Immerse yourself in captivating stories, get homework help from your favorite anime personas, learn a new language, and even write a novel… all with the help of the most advanced AI assistant that YOU design! The only limit is your imagination and we encourage you to push the frontier of what’s possible with this innovative technology. Welcome to the AI Character community We’re excited to see what you bring to life!
【About PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION】
You can subscribe to get unlimited access to premium bots. The subscription will automatically renew unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period unless you change your subscription preferences in your account settings. Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed or canceled via your iTunes Account settings: Setting > iTunes & App Store > Apple ID > manage subscription after purchase.

bluejetty:00127045:ios.name: Pill Reminder - All in One
bluejetty:00127045:ios.summary: Pill Reminder is an easy-to-use and reliable app that helps you remember to take your medications at the right time. It allows you to create any type of recurring reminders (every X hours, at specific times, daily, weekly, monthly, every X
bluejetty:00127045:ios.description:
Pill Reminder is an easy-to-use and reliable app that helps you remember to take your medications at the right time. It allows you to create any type of recurring reminders (every X hours, at specific times, daily, weekly, monthly, every X days, etc). It also tracks the remaining quantity of each medication and shows a refill alert when supplies are running low.
It has everything you need:
• Mark Medications as Taken or Missed
• Reschedule Medications
• Refill Reminders
• Add PRN (as needed) Medications
• Calendar
• Reminders for Medical Appointments
• Send Reports to your Doctor
• Multiple User Support
• Critical Alerts Support
You can also create custom images with AI for your medications and user profiles (Available on iOS 26 and later).
By remembering to take all your medications at the right time, you are taking control of your own health.
With this Pill Reminder app, you'll never forget to take your medications.
RECURRING REMINDERS
• Repeat every X hours (e.g. From 8 AM to 8 PM, every 4 hours)
• Repeat at specific times (e.g. 9:15 AM, 1:30 PM, 8:50 PM)
• Repeat every half hour (e.g. From 10 AM to 2 PM, every 30 minutes)
• Repeat on selected days of the week (e.g. Every week only on Mondays and Fridays)
• Repeat every X days, weeks or months (e.g. Every 3 days, Every 2 weeks)
• Repeat daily for 21 days and then take 7 days off (Birth Control)
MAIN FEATURES
• User friendly interface
• If you took your medication early or late, you can reschedule the next doses for that day
• Get alerts to refill your prescriptions before they run out
• Can be used with any medication, supplement, vitamin, pill or birth control that follows a regular schedule
• Mark a medication as "Taken" directly from the lock screen or notification banner
• Ability to add PRN (as needed) medications
• Keep track of the medications you have to take throughout the day 
• Pre-Alarms: Be notified prior to the actual time
• Auto-Snooze: Automatically repeat the alarm up to 5 times at regular intervals (e.g. 1 min, 10 mins, 30 mins) until you take action
• Add notes for reference
• Mark medications as Taken or Missed to avoid double doses
• Get alerts when medications are about to expire
• Email your medication list or administration history to your doctor
• Add reminders for medical appointments
• Add photos to each medication for easy identification, or create custom images with AI (Available on iOS 26 and later)
• Multiple user support. Add medications for yourself, family members, or others you care for
• Ability to search the FDA Drug Database for your medications (Available in the US only)
• Has a calendar to view all reminders by month
• Backup and restore all data on the same device or multiple devices
• 33 built-in alarm sounds
GENERAL
• Critical Alerts support
• VoiceOver accessibility support
• Dark Mode
• Automatically adjusts to the font size selected on the device
• Notifications are local. No internet connection required
• App doesn't need to be open to receive notifications
• Universal App, full native support for iPhone and iPad
FREE VERSION
• In the free version, you can add unlimited medications but only 2 reminders
• Full version with unlimited reminders is available as an In-App Purchase
• One-Time payment. No monthly or annual fees

bluejetty:00143706:ios.description:
Your Story Starts Here.
zeta is your home for endless stories. Connect with countless characters across vast worlds. From sweet romance to fantasy to drama and comedy, become the main character and shape your story your way.
"Predictable plots are so bleh. With zeta, I make the wildest plot twists how I want, when I want."
"Once I open the app, I'm the one calling the shots!"
■ Features
• Free AI character chats
Pay per message? Not here. Enjoy truly free, unlimited chats. Get lost in long, uninterrupted moments with your favorite characters.
• Characters for every mood
From mysterious bosses and billionaire CEOs to rivals—if you want it, you get it. Find a character that matches your mood and start a new story anytime.
• Create your own AI character in 1 Minute
Bring your ideas to life in seconds. Add a name, personality, and a simple description, then start chatting with a character made by you. Keep your creation private or share it with others.
• Shape every twist through chat
Slow burns, second chances—you control the way your story unfolds. Stuck on what to say? Tap 'Smart Reply' to stay in the flow without interruption.
• Turn chats into AI-generated images
Turn your favorite chat moments into illustrated snapshots. In just 15 seconds, your conversation becomes an image. Save the scenes you imagined and bring your story to life.
• Your Own Creative Space
Show off your characters with others or keep them private. Build your own settings, continue your stories, and enjoy character chats in your own space.
■ Recommended For
• Anyone who wants to create their own characters and evolve their worlds
• Anyone who wants to enjoy free AI character chat without worrying about costs
• Anyone who wants to become the main character in an interactive story
• Anyone who loves unexpected plot twists and immersive stories
■ Privacy & Security
We care about your privacy and your chat experience. Personal information and conversation data are securely managed, and we continue improving zeta so users can enjoy the service with confidence.
• Customer Center: https://support.zeta-ai.io
• Customer Service Email: contact@zeta-ai.io

bluejetty:00194060:android.description:
FANTASTIC HIDDEN OBJECT PUZZLE ADVENTURE GAME FROM THE CREATORS OF ENIGMATIS AND GRIM LEGENDS!
It is the year 1830, and a beautiful young governess named Esther has just received a letter that will lead her to embark on the adventure of a lifetime and learn all the mysteries of her family’s story.
TRY IT FREE, THEN UNLOCK THE FULL ADVENTURE FROM WITHIN THE GAME!
An immersive story with mini games and HOs! 
The message has been sent by Esther’s aunt to tell her that her parents, whom she never met, have left her an inheritance – a mansion in London. But when she goes there, it turns out that the beautiful residence is abandoned, run-down, and home to many mysteries.
52 beautiful, hand painted locations! 
When she explores the mansion, going through puzzles, mini games, and slowly learning her family’s mysteries, she discovers that for many centuries members of her family have been investigating the captivating phenomenon of time travel.
Immersive time manipulation puzzles and mini games! 
Esther’s exciting adventure, which will lead her to captivating, hand drawn places – and moments in history – begins when she finds the strange legacy of the Ambrose family. During her adventure across time and space, beautifully depicted in hand drawn locations, she will solve extraordinary puzzles and mini games and experience supernatural events, all while trying to unravel the mysteries of her heritage and learn the story of a struggle between the wizard Merlin and his rival, Viviana.
Save Esther in the Collector’s Edition! 
The additional content includes a bonus chapter and plenty of hidden objects in extra HO scenes, as well as an immersive, beautifully composed soundtrack and hand drawn concept art.
Play with your family! 
A simple but beautiful game that’s easy to enjoy with your kids!
Take the adventure on the bus! 
Optimized for phones and tablets, filled with hidden objects, perfect for playing while traveling. No internet connection required, so you can play offline!
Sign up to our newsletter and get adventure games on sale! 
Captivating adventures, beautiful stories, and scary mysteries await in our selection of immersive hidden object puzzle games!
• A portable time machine – change the history according to your will!
• 21 diverse mini-games and 16 hidden-object scenes
• 52 beautiful, hand-painted locations
• Time manipulation puzzles
• 7 intriguing heroes, each with their own secrets
• Possibility to re-play 9 mini-games and 16 hidden-object scenes
• Additional second adventure
• Game world encyclopedia
• High-end, immersive gameplay, optimized for tablets and phones!

bluejetty:00145327:ios.description:
This app can read and verify the embedded chip in passports and ID cards.
To read a passport or ID:
1) Use the camera to scan the machine readable zone on the data page of your passport or the back of your ID
2) Hold the passport or ID against your device to read the biometric chip
3) The chip information is displayed in the app
The app does not require network connection and can be used offline.
What is the app used for? For businesses this app is useful for remote onboarding of users and customers, identity verification, and to meet KYC and AML requirements. For compliance and security, nothing beats reading the biometric chip.

listings.description:
This app can read and verify the embedded chip in passports and ID cards.

To read a passport or ID:
1) Use the camera to scan the machine readable zone on the data page of your passport or the back of your ID
2) Hold the passport or ID against your device to read the biometric chip
3) The chip information is displayed in the app

The app does not require network connection and can be used offline.

What is the app used for? For businesses this app is useful for remote onboarding of users and customers, identity verification, and to meet KYC and AML requirements. For compliance and security, nothing beats reading the biometric chip.

bluejetty:00062428:ios.description:
Playing games can be meaningful! At SKIDOS, we know that learning comes naturally to kids through play. That is why we gathered a collection of 40+ unique apps to ensure joyful playtime and engaging learning for 2-11-year-old kids. With SKIDOS apps, kids improve math skills and logical thinking, learn to trace letters and numbers, prompt their curiosity through videos and strengthen 21st-century skills!
40+ APPS WITH SKIDOS PASS
With a single Pass, you access all SKIDOS apps where children of different ages will find games to every taste. You can create up to 6 player profiles within one account and log in from multiple devices. Go ahead and customize the app experience for your kids according to their interests and learning level. Stay on top of how your kids learn - check the progress report in the app or via email.
STREET SOCCER
Do you love football? If you do, this is the BEST street soccer game for you!
Get ready to run, feint and score on the streets of some of the world’s most iconic locations! Street Soccer is not only exciting to play, but it’s also great fun. The gameplay is easy to pickup and will give you hours of endless entertainment.
Don't hesitate Aim, Kick and Score!
SKIDOS LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our unique approach is to engage kids in learning while they play games they love. We gathered a collection of 40+ fun games and incorporated interactive learning content into them. 4 million kids around the globe play & learn with SKIDOS!
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, etc. Tasks evolve as a child progresses. Interactive design and animation support learning - three cute little SKIDOS mascots help and encourage kids when they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybug will show a little learner how to trace with their finger while visuals and a voice-over will teach new words and counting.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Video content prompts children's curiosity in a fun and easy way. We created the right mix of entertainment & learning with our video catalog.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS apps do not show ads to kids, are COPPA & GDPR compliant, and ensure a safe online learning environment for kids.
Get your SKIDOS Pass today!

- Cancellation will not go into effect until the end of the billing cycle

bluejetty:00093274:ios.description:
Calvim (formerly ShamsiPlus) is a free Persian calendar for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch: Shamsi (Jalali) dates, Iranian holidays, tasks, notes, work shifts and widgets. No ads, no account, works offline.
کالویم (شمسی پلاس سابق): تقویم شمسی ۱۴۰۵ با تعطیلات رسمی، کارها، یادداشتها، شیفت کاری و ویجت. رایگان و بدون تبلیغات.
IRANIAN CALENDAR & HOLIDAYS
• Official Iranian holidays, including the 1406 holidays.
• 1,000+ occasions: national and religious days, Hijri (lunar) dates, world days and Persian celebrations like Nowruz, Mehregan and Yalda. Turn any category on or off.
• Nowruz countdown with reminders.
• Choose your first day of the week and your weekend days.
TODAY ON ONE SCREEN
• Home shows today's occasions, tasks and notes, your week and the year's progress. Move overdue tasks to today in one tap.
TASKS, NOTES & REMINDERS
• Tasks with dates, times and reminders, grouped into Overdue, Today and Upcoming. Pin important notes.
• Personal events on Shamsi or Gregorian dates: all-day or timed, colors, repeats, multiple reminders and custom holidays.
• One search for events, tasks and notes.
WORK SHIFT CALENDAR
• For nurses, doctors and anyone on shifts: set shift types and a repeating rotation, paint days on the month, see a monthly summary and get reminders for each shift.
DATE CONVERTER
• Shamsi to Gregorian and back, with the exact number of days from today.
WIDGETS & APPLE WATCH
• 7 Home Screen widgets, including Month and Week. Tick off tasks right from the widget.
• 8 Lock Screen widgets in Persian or English: date, next holiday countdown, tasks left, next task and more.
• Apple Watch app with complications and a Smart Stack widget. Events and shifts sync from iPhone.
WORKS WITH YOUR APPS
• Import .ics files from Google Calendar, Outlook and others, and review before saving.
• Siri and Shortcuts: open a date or add an event, task or note.
• Share any day with its holidays and events.
DESIGN & PRIVACY
• 10 accent colors, Light and Dark mode, iPhone and iPad layouts, VoiceOver and large text support.
• Your events, tasks and notes stay on your device. Usage stats only if you opt in.
Download Calvim free, the Persian calendar for your whole year.
تقویم فارسی کالویم
تقویم شمسی (جلالی) برای آیفون، آیپد و اپل واچ. رایگان، بدون تبلیغات، بدون حساب کاربری و بدون نیاز به اینترنت.
تقویم و تعطیلات
• تعطیلات رسمی ایران، همراه با تعطیلات ۱۴۰۶.
• بیش از ۱۰۰۰ مناسبت: ملی و مذهبی، تاریخ قمری، روزهای جهانی و جشنهایی مثل نوروز، مهرگان و یلدا. هر دسته را روشن یا خاموش کنید.
• شمارش معکوس نوروز با یادآور.
• شروع هفته و روزهای تعطیل به انتخاب شما.
امروز در یک نگاه
• صفحه خانه: مناسبتها، کارها و یادداشتهای امروز، هفته شما و پیشرفت سال. کارهای عقبافتاده را با یک لمس به امروز بیاورید.
کارها، یادداشتها و یادآور
• کار با تاریخ، ساعت و یادآور؛ دستهبندی عقبافتاده، امروز و پیشرو. یادداشتهای مهم را سنجاق کنید.
• رویداد شخصی شمسی یا میلادی: تمامروز یا ساعتدار، رنگ، تکرار، چند یادآور و تعطیلات شخصی.
• جستجو در رویدادها، کارها و یادداشتها.
تقویم شیفت کاری
• برای پرستاران، پزشکان و همه شیفتکارها: نوع شیفت، چرخه کاری، رنگ کردن روزها، خلاصه ماهانه و یادآور هر شیفت.
تبدیل تاریخ
• شمسی به میلادی و برعکس، با فاصله دقیق تا امروز.
ویجت و اپل واچ
• ۷ ویجت صفحه اصلی، از جمله ماه و هفته، با تیک زدن کارها از روی ویجت.
• ۸ ویجت صفحه قفل به فارسی یا انگلیسی: تاریخ امروز، روزهای مانده تا تعطیلی بعدی، کارهای باقیمانده و کار بعدی.
• اپل واچ با کامپلیکیشن و ویجت Smart Stack؛ رویدادها و شیفتها از آیفون همگام میشوند.
کنار بقیه برنامهها
• وارد کردن فایل ‎.ics از گوگل کلندر، اوتلوک و بقیه، با بررسی قبل از ذخیره.
• Siri و Shortcuts و اشتراکگذاری هر روز.
طراحی و حریم خصوصی
• ۱۰ رنگ، حالت روشن و تیره، چیدمان آیپد و پشتیبانی از VoiceOver.
• اطلاعات شما روی دستگاه خودتان میماند؛ آمار استفاده فقط با اجازه شما.
کالویم را رایگان نصب کنید؛ تقویم فارسی شما برای ۱۴۰۵ و ۱۴۰۶.

bluejetty:00063901:ios.description:
PlayerFM is a top independent podcast player and podcast library, empowering listeners around the world to search, discover, save and listen to more than 20+ million free podcasts. 
Find your favorite shows and discover new shows focused on education, news, business, technology, sports, comedy, and more! Our podcast library is updated multiple times per day, ensuring we always have the latest shows and episodes. Plus, discover free audiobooks, documentaries, video podcasts and interviews with our human-powered catalog and advanced episode-level search. 
KEY FEATURES
• Offline listening - When you're commuting and relaxing, your podcast player is still there for you, even with no wifi.
• Seamless cloud sync - Follow it on your phone and you'll see it on your tablet too.
• Social - Like and share favorite episodes.
• Discover - See what's hot and trending.
• Colors & dark theme - Match your style.
• Podcast categories - Organize your shows into genres and moods.
• Sleep timer - Let the podcasts sleep when you do.
• Picture in Picture - Watch video podcasts and use your device at the same time
PREMIUM FEATURES
PlayerFM Premium:
• NEW Space Saver - Compress downloaded episodes, while maintaining audio quality. A 100MB MP3 could compress to 30MB!
• NEW Relax & Sleep - Discover and listen to relaxing sleep sounds hand-picked by our editors.
• NEW Custom App Icons - Choose from 9 unique app icons to match your home screen.
• NEW iPad support - Explore the app in Portrait and Landscape views.
• NEW Apple Watch support - Access playback controls and more, now from your wrist!
• Ad-Free experience - Focus on the content of your favorite podcast episodes without the distraction of ads.
• Play on multiple devices - Easily sync playlists, full play history, and resume playback across devices.
• Playlists & bookmarks - Organize with playlists and timestamped bookmarks tied to your cloud account.
• Theme editor - Full control on themes, cloud-sync all your themes, unlock all premium themes.
• Turbo Fetch - Get updates early & often. Be the first to know!
• Personal search - Locate any episode with ease from your subscriptions and playlists.
WHAT THE EXPERTS SAY
LifeHacker: "Guides you to smart, interesting podcasts"
Tested: "Right from the start, I found the experience of using PlayerFM enjoyable"
GigaOm: "Makes podcasts look cool again"
Support:
support@player.fm 
LEGAL
Terms of Service: https://player.fm/legal
Privacy Policy: https://player.fm/privacy
support@player.fm Subscription Terms: Payment for subscriptions will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. bluejetty:00127051:ios.description:
Raise a cute axolotl and build your own aquarium
apps you can create.
●You can keep up to 5 Axolotls. Each grows separately. You can also name and reset the size individually.
●Aquatic plants, decorative stones, driftwood, shelters, flooring materials, wallpaper, etc. can be customized to your liking. The position and angle of each aquatic plant can be determined, and the position and angle of shelters, driftwood, decorative stones, etc. can be freely determined, and the layout can be customized quite finely. Some shelters and wallpaper can be colored freely.
Layout materials can be exchanged for points at the shop.
Create your own aquarium.
●You have to feed once every 3 days, but the axolotl will not die even if it exceeds 3 days, but it will be the same size as when you started it before.
Become.
●There are two ways to feed the fish, one is to sprinkle food directly on the aquarium, and the other is to use tweezers to feed the shrimp. When you give shrimp with tweezers, the axolotl will follow the food.
Feeding will give you tons of points that can be redeemed for layouts.
●When you run out of food, play a mini-game to procure food.
Shrimp and bait will pop out of the bait box if you tap continuously.
When you tap more than a certain amount, the timing game starts and you can set the timing.
If you tap them together, you will receive a medal with high points according to your evaluation.
If you exceed the limit amount of food you can have, it will be converted to points.
It is convenient when you want to accumulate points quickly.

bluejetty:00136102:ios.description:
Navigate coastal adventures with precision using real-time tidal current data from PredictWind.
PredictCurrent delivers ultra-high-resolution 100m tidal current maps, plus 400m and 4km maps covering 90% of global coastlines. It also includes full ocean current coverage, empowering fishermen, sailors, and coastal explorers with essential tools for current tracking, tide planning, and marine navigation.
Developed by PredictWind’s expert oceanographers, trusted globally for industry-leading forecasting, PredictCurrent supports confident and safe coastal navigation for boating, fishing, sailing, and kayaking.
Why PredictCurrent 
- Unrivalled Precision: Ultra-high-resolution 100m tidal current maps provide unmatched detail for coastal tide planning, ideal for fishing, sailing, or paddle sports. Also includes 400m and 4km resolution maps.
- Trusted Expertise: Built by PredictWind, pioneers in marine and ocean current forecasting, delivering professional-grade data.
- Comprehensive Tracking: Monitor tidal currents, ocean currents, winds, waves, and sea temperatures with animated maps and hourly tide chart data for 10 days.
- Coastal Navigation: Join fishermen, sailors, kayakers, and coastal explorers worldwide who rely on PredictWind’s marine weather and current data for informed navigation.
Key Features
- Ultra-High-Resolution 100m Tidal Current Maps: Visualise intricate nearshore water current movements with clarity, ideal for coastal navigation, route planning, and safety.
- High-Resolution 400m & 4km Maps: Access tide and ocean current coverage for 90% of global coastlines, seamlessly integrated with live ocean current data.
- Advanced Dashboard: Analyse wind-against-current interactions, wave heights, tide cycles, and directions using accurate ECMWF wind forecasts.
- Animated 10-Day Forecasts: View dynamic tidal currents, ocean currents, wind, waves, and sea temperature forecasts on interactive marine maps.
- Detailed Data Tables: Access hourly data on current speed and direction, plus alerts for wind-against-current situations.
Tailored for fisherman, sailors, kayakers, and coastal adventurers, PredictCurrent offers essential tools for safe marine planning—backed by PredictWind’s proven ocean data and current tracking accuracy.
Start with a 14-day free trial. Access ultra-high-resolution tidal current data, tide charts, ocean current forecasts, wind, waves, and sea temperature tools for your next coastal journey.

bluejetty:00061699:ios.description:
The Southwest® app makes travel easy. 
- Book flights, cars, hotels, cruises, and vacations all in one place
- Use the app for easy booking, check-ins, flight status updates, seat upgrade options, and boarding passes.
- Rapid Rewards® Members can also earn points1 on qualifying Southwest purchases, including flights, car rentals, hotel bookings, and vacations
- Plan your next trip to Las Vegas, Orlando, Cancun, and more with the Southwest travel booking app
Southwest app features:
Flight booking and day-of travel 
- Compare available fares for your flight
- Manage your travel details in the “My Trips” tab, including seat upgrade options, gate information, boarding position, flight status, and more
Book hotels with Southwest 
- Explore more travel experiences with each hotel booking
- View and manage your reservation and find hotel deals
Flight status and boarding passes on the go
- Mobile boarding passes for all Passengers on your trip 24 hours in advance
- Flight status, flight number, confirmation number, boarding time, and TSA PreCheck® details found in one place
- Save your mobile boarding passes to Wallet for convenience

- Book your entire vacation package—flight, hotel and rental car booking—all in one place. It’s our most flexible way to vacation
- It’s never been easier to get away for a vacation. Cancel or make changes to your package up to 10 minutes prior to your first departure2
- Use the in-app booking widget to search 30+ popular vacation packages and book flights to Cancun, Orlando, Las Vegas, Hawaii, and more
Access inflight entertainment
- Use the app to take you to our Inflight Entertainment Portal, where you can watch free live TV, access free on-demand TV episodes, and view free movies3
Earn Rapid Rewards points when you travel
- Sign up for Rapid Rewards and earn points on your flights. Forget to add your Rapid Rewards number during booking? No worries, add it after booking your flight and earn points1
Purchase seats for your flight, check flight status, find a seat upgrade, schedule pickups and drop-offs, enjoy fast and easy hotel booking, reserve car rentals, and embrace last-minute flights for your next spontaneous vacation—all with Southwest.
Disclaimers:
1 All Rapid Rewards® rules and regulations apply and can be found at https://www.southwest.com/rrterms.

Bookings must be canceled or changed at least 10 minutes before your first flight’s scheduled departure time or funds will be forfeited. Any eligible credits will be less nonrefundable air travel charges and travel insurance. Subject to Getaways by Southwest® Terms & Conditions: https://www.southwest.com/vacations/terms-and-conditions/.
3 Where available. Available only on WiFi-enabled, designated aircraft. Due to licensing and other restrictions on select WiFi-enabled flights, free movies, TV series, and live TV may not be available. Customers will need to access content downloaded to their devices prior to such flights or connect to Free WiFi to access their own entertainment options.

bluejetty:00179192:ios.description:
下一班公車(nextBus) -- 台灣公車時刻表 App
您是不是有時候覺得只是要查詢公車(捷運)到站資訊，總是很麻煩？這個 app 只要開啟後，就根據定位幫你過濾出附近站牌，以及提供相關公車預計到站的時間，方便您在很快時間內確定要坐的哪一班公車；也可以限定欲前往的站牌附近區域，過濾剩下有經過特定站牌附近的車班。
目前支援台灣的公車(捷運)資料
 - 台北市、新北市、桃園市、台中市、台南市、高雄市、基隆市、新竹市、新竹縣、苗栗縣、彰化縣
 - 南投縣、雲林縣、嘉義縣、嘉義市、屏東縣、宜蘭縣、花蓮縣、台東縣、金門縣、澎湖縣、連江縣
 - 大台北捷運、高雄市捷運
 - 公路客運
目前主要功能，包括：
 - 頁面包括「附近站牌」、「常用站牌」兩種呈現模式，皆會依目前座標排序列表
 - 可自訂常用站牌群組，可自訂「上班」、「下班」、「旅遊」等群組
 - 支援 Widget，拉下通知中心不用解鎖，即可看到常用站牌到站時間
 - 一支 App 就包含台灣所有縣市車班，不用一個一個縣市分別去安裝
 - 打開手機即定位最近公車站牌(捷運車站)列表及到站時間，不用多餘設定使用哪些地區
 - 可設定多組「到站提醒」，不用擔心睡過頭。若事後不需要提醒的話，可取消提醒設定。
 - 起點以及目的地設定，可以限定特定站牌或者地點，進行車班的過濾。
 - 提供公車預計到站時間、車牌號碼資訊
 - 提供到達目的車站之車程時間
 - 無直達車到達目的車站時，提供參考路線規劃
 - 可以在地圖上呈現經過的站牌
 - 可以打開 Map 導航到站牌
 - 可以設定常用等車站牌
 - 可以設定喜愛車班
 - iCloud 同步備份常用站牌等設定，重新安裝時，會恢復相關設定
 - 提供車班回報機制
 - 支援按鈕的旁白說明功能
 - 預估到站時間若超過 60 分鐘以上，改用預估到站時刻呈現 (比如 14:50) 
 - 目前仍有部份都市公車沒有提供發車時刻表，比如桃園、高雄、基隆、台中等，目前台中、桃園、高雄依據首站到站時間資料建立「參考」發車時刻表，可能會有漏班的可能。
Widget 功能包括
 - 打開 Widget 即呈現「常用站牌」的到站時間.
 - 每分鐘會更新乙次到站時間
 - 會依目前座標排序常用站牌
手錶功能包括
 - 打開手錶即定位最近公車站牌(捷運車站)列表及到站時間
 - 當手機有設定常用站牌時，手錶可切換「附近站牌」、「常用站牌」兩模式
 - 列表優先列出手機上設定的喜愛車班
 - 如果定位不精確時，可切換附近的站牌
 - 五分鐘內重新開啟手錶，不再重新定位.
若有其他功能需求，或者使用上有問題，可以利用 App 設定內回報給我們。
若遇到到站不準確的問題，還煩請利用設定內的回報功能，提供您遇到有問題的縣市班車，我們會努力讓資料準確。 因為各縣市的車機實作精準度不一，加上若沒有依程序來操作等等問題，極可能資料來源就造成特定車班常常不是很準確了。 所以，還煩請提供車班資料，我們會追踪問題，並向相關單位反應。 謝謝。
特別感謝：本服務的資料來源主要來自「交通部 PTX 平臺」提供。

bluejetty:00178892:ios.summary: تحكم بمجرى التاريخ وافرض سيطرتك على العالم في لعبة الجنرال، لعبة حرب عالمية استراتيجية مليئة بالتحدي والإثارة، حيث تبدأ أعظم معركة عسكرية تحدد مصير العالم. كن أنت الجنرال الأقوى والقائد الذي يسجل اسمه في كتب التاريخ ويقود جيوشه نحو النصر في
bluejetty:00178892:ios.description:
تحكم بمجرى التاريخ وافرض سيطرتك على العالم في لعبة الجنرال، لعبة حرب عالمية استراتيجية مليئة بالتحدي والإثارة، حيث تبدأ أعظم معركة عسكرية تحدد مصير العالم. كن أنت الجنرال الأقوى والقائد الذي يسجل اسمه في كتب التاريخ ويقود جيوشه نحو النصر في ساحات الحرب العالمية.
تولى قيادة حملات عسكرية عملاقة، ودرب أقوى الوحدات العسكرية والدبابات القتالية الحديثة، وخض معركة شرسة ضد غواصات تجوب المحيطات وطائرات نفاثة تكتسح السماء. في هذه اللعبة الاستراتيجية، ستعيش أجواء الحرب العالمية بكل تفاصيلها، حيث القرار العسكري الذكي قد يغير مصير العالم بأكمله.
ابنِ إمبراطوريتك العسكرية وافرض سيطرتك على أعظم الأمم في العالم، واستعد لخوض حرب عالمية ثالثة مليئة بالمفاجآت والتحديات. اجمع الموارد، طور قواتك العسكرية، وكوّن أقوى تحالف مع أصدقائك لتقوية اقتصادك وإضعاف خصومك. فالتحالف القوي هو مفتاح الانتصار في كل معركة داخل لعبة الجنرال.
انضم إلى مجلس الأمن للحصول على مميزات متقدمة تمنحك تفوقًا في السيطرة الاستراتيجية، من إدارة الجيش بدقة إلى تنفيذ خطط عسكرية تكتيكية تعزز فرصك في ردع العدوان وتحقيق النصر. كما يمكنك خوض أعنف المعارك والسيناريوهات الواقعية مثل نزاع الشرق الأوسط، حيث تتصارع الدول على النفوذ والسيطرة ضمن خرائط مستوحاة من العالم الحقيقي.
حرّر الأراضي، وقد مملكتك العسكرية نحو الهيمنة لتحاكي واقع الحرب العالمية، حيث التهديد النووي والقرارات المصيرية تصنع الفارق في ساحة المعركة. في كل معركة ستحتاج إلى قائد ذكي يمتلك رؤية استراتيجية وقدرة على اتخاذ القرار في أصعب الظروف.
اختر الاستراتيجية التي تناسبك واتبعها للوصول إلى السلطة. قم بتشكيل أقوى التحالفات، وابدأ حربًا خفية تناور بها الأعداء، أو استخدم أسلحة الدمار الشامل لفرض هيمنتك على العالم. الخيارات كثيرة، لكن الهدف واحد: أن تصبح الجنرال والقائد الأقوى في لعبة الحرب الاستراتيجية الأشهر.
توفر لعبة الجنرال مساحة لعب ضخمة، ووحدات عسكرية متنوعة، وأساليب لا حصر لها لتحقيق هدفك المنشود بالسيطرة على العالم. انضم إلى ملايين اللاعبين العرب وخض أكبر معركة استراتيجية جماعية، وضع خطتك العسكرية المحكمة وقُد قواتك نحو المجد. ارتقِ في التصنيفات، واحتل مركزًا مرموقًا بين أفضل القادة والجنرالات في العالم.
مميزات اللعبة:
• أكثر من 120 لاعب ضمن الجولة الواحدة
• وقت فعلي وحقيقي لتحرك الوحدات في ساحة المعركة
• خرائط كثيرة وسيناريوهات متنوعة مستوحاة من الحروب العالمية
• تكنولوجيا ومعدات عسكرية حقيقية
• تنظيم بحوث متنوع يضم أكثر من 350 نوعًا مختلفًا
• 3 مناهج عسكرية مميزة: الغربية والأوروبية والشرقية
• مواجهات حسب التضاريس المختلفة بالصواريخ والرادارات والوحدات الشبح
• أسلحة دمار شامل نووية وكيميائية وتقليدية
• محتوى متجدد وتحديثات مستمرة ومواسم وفعاليات متنوعة
• لعبة مخصصة لأنظمة التحالف ضمن مجتمع ضخم من اللاعبين
انضم الآن إلى سباق أفضل لاعبي الخطط الاستراتيجية وأكثرهم حنكة، واقتحم عالم الحروب واستعد لخوض أكبر حرب عالمية في لعبة الجنرال. اختبر قوتك ومهارتك ضد لاعبين حقيقيين على خرائط جيوسياسية للعالم الحديث، وأثبت أنك القائد العسكري الذي لا يُقهر.
هل أنت مستعد لخوض أكبر معركة استراتيجية؟
كوّن جيشك، ابنِ تحالفك، سيطر على العالم، وأثبت أنك الجنرال والقائد المسيطر في أقوى لعبة حرب عسكرية استراتيجية!

-Welcome call to introduce you to our services and make sure you get the most out of our products

bluejetty:00074001:ios.name: Relief Central

bluejetty:00074001:ios.description:
Relief Central is a free mobile and web resource developed by staff and friends of Unbound Medicine. It includes the latest versions of The World Factbook from the CIA, CDC Health Information for International Travel (The Yellow Book), the Field Operations Guide from USAID, Prime PubMed Search, and Relief News from the Red Cross, United Nations, US Centers for Disease Control, CDC, FEMA, and more.
THE WORLD FACTBOOK
The World Factbook from the US Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) contains detailed information on the history, people, government, economy, geography, communications, transportation, military, and transnational issues for 266 world countries and territories.
CDC YELLOW BOOK (Health Information for International Travel)
The Yellow Book presents advice on any travel health issue including vaccinations, essential trip planning and safety tips, prevention of an expanded list of travel-related infectious diseases, altitude illness, motion sickness, sunburn, medical tourism, and much more. 
USAID FIELD OPERATIONS GUIDE
The Field Operations Guide from USAID delivers disaster assessment and response information and includes chapters and appendices ranging from information on populations at risk to commonly used acronyms, all arranged in an outline format.
RELIEF NEWS
Relief News puts the latest news at your fingertips with a collection of RSS feeds from trusted non-profit groups, international organizations, and government agencies. Feeds are from the Red Cross, United Nations, US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), US Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA), ReliefWeb, and more.
Prime PubMed Search
Prime provides citations and abstracts from the latest issues of trusted disaster relief journals. Link to the fully-integrated Prime service where you can find related articles and view full-text articles provided by the journal publisher.
FEATURES: 
• Cross Links for fast navigation between resources
• Personalized favorites
• Highlight and note-taking
• Citations and abstracts from disaster journals
• Advanced Search helps to find topics fast 
• Recently Viewed 
Unbound Privacy Policy: www.unboundmedicine.com/privacy
Unbound Terms of Use: https://www.unboundmedicine.com/end_user_license_agreement

Many of our Beacon Medical Group doctors offer video visits, so you can see your doctor from the comfort of home using your smartphone or computer. Many of our patients are now choosing this convenient option. First, call and ask your provider to schedule a telehealth visit.
For urgent care, Beacon also extends our provider and urgent care network by partnering with the Online Care Group, the nation’s first and largest primary care group devoted to telehealth. The physicians are U.S. board-certified doctors with an average of 15 years of experience and are licensed to practice medicine in Indiana and Michigan (and most other states). You can read each doctor’s profile to learn about his or her education and experience before beginning a virtual visit. All of our providers are certified and credentialed according to the National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) standards.
Services available include:
Scheduled Visits - online visits with your Beacon provider.
Online Urgent Care 24/7 - board-certified doctors, anytime, anywhere
Nutrition Counseling - scheduled visits with registered dietitians
Behavioral Health Counseling- scheduled visits with licensed counselors and psychologists
The app features include:
• No sign up or subscription fees
• Live video visits, with secure messaging features
• Beacon providers, U.S. board-certified physicians, licensed physician assistants and nurse practitioners, registered dietitians, and licensed counselors and psychologists
• Prescriptions as appropriate
• Online credit card payment
If you use Apple Health, you can choose to share your health information with the doctor during your video visit, such as heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, blood glucose levels, weight, nutritional information, and respiratory rate.

bluejetty:00163884:ios.description:
POPLY: THE PARTY INVITATION MAKER.
Poply is the easy way to create modern invitations that stand out. In minutes you can design full-screen, interactive digital invitations for birthdays, weddings, and more, then send them instantly by text, email, link, or QR code.
Why Poply
● Create invitations quickly for birthdays, weddings, holidays, or business events
● Personalize with photos and videos by uploading your own media or choosing from included galleries
● Track RSVPs and manage guest lists with reminders and plus-one options
● Share invitations instantly by text message, email, link, or QR code so your guests never miss a message
● Apply premium features including custom color themes, personal photos and videos, invite larger guest lists, and share instantly with a link or QR code
Events You Can Celebrate with Poply
Poply works for every occasion. Whether you are hosting a birthday party, planning a wedding, organizing a holiday dinner, or celebrating a graduation, Poply has a template to help you get started. Baby showers, anniversaries, cocktail parties, and business events can all be managed in one place. Each invitation can be customized to fit the tone of your event, from casual get-togethers to formal galas.
How to Send Invitations by Text or Email
Sending invitations by text or email is easy with Poply. Every invitation is created online and can be shared instantly. Guests simply tap the link to view the details, RSVP, and add the event to their calendar. Poply also provides a share link and QR code for flexible sharing across social media, messaging apps, or printed materials.
Host Features
● Invitation templates for birthdays, weddings, holidays, baby showers, graduations, and more
● Customizable details including event information and a library of included photos and videos
● Flexible event options for any location, whether in-person addresses or online events
● Event summary gives you a quick view of attendees and makes sending updates simple
Guest Features
● One-tap RSVP and calendar integration
● Built-in maps and location details
● Push notifications so you never miss updates
● Private in-app messaging with the host
Why Choose Poply Over Paper or Email Invites
Traditional invitations are easy to lose, and plain emails often get ignored. Poply invitations stand out because they are designed to be interactive,

bluejetty:00175005:ios.summary: Authenticator App is a secure application for two-factor authentication (2FA) that stores and generates time-based codes (OTP) to protect your online accounts by adding an additional layer of security when signing in. Our universal authenti
bluejetty:00175005:ios.description:
Authenticator App is a secure application for two-factor authentication (2FA) that stores and generates time-based codes (OTP) to protect your online accounts by adding an additional layer of security when signing in. Our universal authenticator app is compatible with more than 2.500 websites and services.
Create your secure MFA token in seconds, just scan the QR code for a quick & easy setup. Enter your unique one-time password (OTP software token) generated by our app on the website and voila!  It is that easy to 2FA verify your online identity.

THE ULTIMATE AI-DRIVEN WORKOUT APP FOR FASTER, SMARTER RESULTS
Muscle Monster Workout Planner is an efficient, scientific, and personalized fitness and wellness application. It can be used as your pocket personal fitness trainer to tailor a training plan for you, whether it is fat loss, muscle gain, body shaping, maintaining health, improving immunity, and improving physical and mental health and happiness. You only need to download the app, follow the daily training requirements and detailed analysis, and you can learn the power points in fitness and the anatomy of fitness muscles. Whether you are training in the gym or at home, whether it is weightlifting training or dumbbell, kettlebell training, or bodyweight training and calisthenics, Muscle Monster Workout Planner can meet your fitness needs and maximize your fitness efficiency.
TONS OF FITNESS PLANS AND WORKOUTS
With over 1200 fitness movements and detailed explanations, more than 500 workouts, and unlimited smart fitness plans tailored to individual training preferences, including weightlifting routines, fitness warm-up and stretching plans, core strength training programs, 21-day fitness plans, and weekly 7-minute workout plans. Whether you are a fitness beginner or a fitness expert, male or female, young or elderly trainer, you can find the most suitable personalized exercise plan here and develop your own fitness habits and routine.
COMPREHENSIVE COVERAGE OF VARIOUS FITNESS EQUIPMENT TYPES
Muscle Monster offers a variety of equipment-guided workouts, including both equipment-based and bodyweight exercises, to help you efficiently achieve your goals of fat loss, muscle gain, and toning. From calisthenics and bodyweight training to dumbbells, kettlebells, barbells, resistance bands, and gym equipment like power racks and cable machines, Muscle Monster provides scientifically effective fitness plans tailored to the equipment you use.
EXERCISE DATA TRACKING
Tracking your exercise data has never been easier. Muscle Monster keeps a record of every fitness activity you engage in, whether at home, in the gym, or outdoors. Your workout duration, calories burned, and weights lifted are all logged and used to generate training reports for you. Detailed reports are available for your weekly and monthly workouts. Moreover, based on your specific fitness history, Muscle Monster can create more personalized fitness plans to guide your physical and mental well-being.
APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION AND APPLE WATCH
Supporting integration with Apple Health for comprehensive activity tracking, witnessing every step of your healthy lifestyle progress. If you own an Apple Watch, you can use the watch version simultaneously to monitor your performance in real-time, refining personalized recommendations within the app. As you continue to use Muscle Monster during your workouts, it will progressively understand your training foundation and preferences to design the most suitable fitness plan for you.
Furthermore, the Muscle Monster Workout Planner offers a free weight tracking feature, a free training calendar with planning capabilities, and various types of workouts. Subscribing members can utilize all app features without limitations to efficiently maintain a healthy lifestyle. Join now! Achieve your fat loss and muscle gain goals, sculpt six-pack abs, develop attractive shoulders and back, improve posture, transform your physique, and experience a vibrant and fulfilling life.
Free Download, 7-Day Free Trial of All Membership Benefits, Emphasize Weight Training, Bodyweight Exercises, Warm-ups, Stretching, Witness Growth and Transformation in 30 Days. Join the Muscle Monster Workout Planner today and unlock the power of persistence. Your health, wellness, and fitness goals are just a click away.

bluejetty:00144534:ios.description:
O Growth Dieta e Treino é um APP que possibilita aos usuários traçar metas de exercícios físicos e inserir informações sobre sua alimentação, o que gera um feedback do aplicativo incluindo dados que auxiliam no cumprimento da meta, além de avaliações sobre a alimentação do usuário.
No Aplicativo Móvel Growth Dieta e Treino, você vai encontrar as melhores ferramentas para otimizar seus treinos e montar cardápios personalizados de acordo com o seu objetivo, seja ele a perda de gordura, manutenção ou ganho de massa magra:
Calcule sua taxa metabólica basal (TMB) para saber o número de calorias de ingestão diária que seu corpo precisa de acordo com o seu objetivo.
Monte refeições e cardápios exclusivos com uma base composta por milhares de alimentos.
Seja lembrado de beber água fazendo um pequeno ajuste no alarme do aplicativo!
Monitore de forma inteligente e eficaz seus macronutrientes: carboidratos, proteínas e gorduras.
Crie sua rotina de treinos como quiser de acordo com o seu nível!
Conecte-se de forma fácil à loja da Growth Supplements para fazer seus pedidos.
Adicione alimentos facilmente à sua dieta por meio do código de barras: ao abrir o cadastro de novos alimentos no app, você pode liberar o acesso à câmera do seu celular e apontá-la ao código de barras do produto.
Para um alimento que já exista e corresponda ao código de barras, as informações serão automaticamente carregadas.
Para novos cadastros, o app irá exibir o nome e o usuário poderá completar as demais informações nutricionais. Estes alimentos cadastrados por usuários poderão ser vistos, consultados e editados (caso necessário) por outros usuários do App.
Na nova versão do APP Dieta e Treino Growth é possível definir sua meta de peso e acompanhar sua evolução com um gráfico que indica quão próximo você está do seu objetivo.
E por fim, compartilhe uma foto da sua refeição nas redes sociais com a indicação de quantas calorias, proteínas, carboidratos e gorduras você ingeriu.
Esperamos que curta as atualizações. Tmj! #SomosTodosAtletas

bluejetty:00095454:ios.description:
Something in the water is watching… waiting. The "Hunter’s Journey: Tears of the Lake" hides a chilling secret—and only you can uncover the truth. In these gripping hidden object games, follow Velimir, an outcast hunter desperate to find hidden objects and prove himself. With his mentor Rodrik, he must solve mystery games and unlock the legend of mermaids with lifeless eyes. The atmospheric search and find games will plunge you into a haunting story where the line between hunter and prey blurs. Are you ready to descend into darkness and solve item search games that test your wits and courage?
Velimir has spent his life chasing the shadow of his father, desperate to prove himself. But without an Animorph by his side, he's an outcast among hunters. Until the chance to prove himself worthy arrives. Rodrik, his mentor and guardian, delivers his first real assignment - a mission that will test more than just his combat skills. A girl named Malena has disappeared from the village of Stillwater, nestled on the misty shores of the ominous Lake of Tears. The villagers whisper of mermaids with cold, dead eyes, dragging their victims into the abyss... Velimir and Rodrik begin their hunt, determined to solve the mystery and find Malena. But beneath the lake’s surface, something far more ancient - and far more dangerous - awaits.
· Hidden Object Gameplay!
From dusty cottages to deep-sea caverns, you’ll encounter hidden object games as you find hidden objects that unlock new storylines, tools, and revelations. No two areas are the same, with visuals designed to enhance the depth of item search games!
· Solve Twisted Puzzles!
Your hidden journey is packed with riddles, cursed mechanisms, and ancient magic. Will you outwit the Lord of the Lake? For fans of puzzle mystery games, this adventure weaves puzzles directly into the narrative of mystery hidden object games, don’t forget to seek and find hidden objects along the way!
· Dark Lore & Atmospheric Storytelling!
The narrative unfolds through discovered journals, spectral visions, and haunted memories—elevating item search games into a rich journey. It’s a must-play for anyone who wants to solve mystery games with story-driven depth and immersive environmental storytelling!
· Reclaim Velimir’s Destiny!
Progress through an achievement system that rewards exploration, cleverness, and a sharp eye for hidden object games. From locating elusive talismans to completing search and find games challenges across various maps, every discovery brings you closer to uncovering the truth behind the legends!
Download the free-to-play "Hunter’s Journey: Tears of the Lake" adventure now and step into the hunt—because something beneath the lake is waiting for you!
-----

Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

iTip makes it fast and easy to calculate the right tip, round totals the way you want, and split the bill with confidence.
Whether you are dining out alone or with a group, iTip helps you quickly work out the tip amount, grand total, and per-person share using a simple, focused interface.

• Editable receipt names for cleaner saved data and PDF summaries
• Item splitting for scanned receipts, so you can assign items to people
• Improved voice entry with sample phrases, better error handling, and help when something goes wrong

• Use service quality mode for a more natural tipping experience

• Generate PDFs that include receipt details, receipt names, and split information
• Use voice entry to update the bill, tip, split, and totals conversationally
• Supports light mode, dark mode, and Dynamic Type
• VoiceOver accessible

iTip is built to be quick, practical, and easy to use when you need the answer right now.

bluejetty:00097099:ios.description:
Tap to deploy a fluffy critter onto the belt, where it tosses balls of yarn onto matching-colored pixel blocks. The number above its head shows how much yarn it has left—every throw counts. When it runs out, it hops off; if it still has yarn, it slips into one of the five holding spots, ready to jump back in when you tap again.
The conveyor can only handle so much at once, so timing your sends matters. Line up your woolies in the right order, manage the flow, and chip away at the board layer by layer. A simple loop with a satisfying rhythm: tap → release → clear.
Highlights
- Single-tap gameplay: Fast, effortless, perfect for quick sessions.
- Color-based hits: Wool creatures only affect blocks of their own color—no manual aiming.
- Conveyor limit: A soft strategy layer built around timing and throughput.
- Five creature slots: Store, reorder, and relaunch at the ideal moment.
- Short, addictive loops: Easy to start, hard to stop.
- Clean-up satisfaction: Watching yarn shots tidy up pixel clusters feels great.
Great for players who enjoy snappy action-puzzles, flow management, and that “just one more try” vibe. Your wool crew is ready… the blocks might not be.

Join Bubbu and his friends in the funniest animal school ever!
Welcome to the amazing world of Bubbu School! Do you like school or not? Don't worry, you rule in this animal school game! Play cute animal games, meet your favorite virtual pet and make learning in the animal school awesome.
Dress up your virtual pet in unique outfits and start with your favorite subject. No matter if you want to learn how to draw, play music for kids or learn abc. You can also learn how to play piano, discover puzzles for kids, learn multiplication and other fun educational games. Try them all within cute animal games and educate yourself while having fun. It's school time for your cute virtual pet! 
COLORING FOR KIDS
To express your creativity in this pet game, you can learn how to draw a painting with a perfect set of colored pencils. In addition, your creations can be decorated with a collection of beautiful stickers. Furthermore, you can spark your imagination with an exciting coloring minigame or make some crazy decorations with fruit and vegetables. Learn how to draw with cute animal games and coloring for kids. 
MUSIC FOR KIDS
Learn how to play piano, play music for kids or prepare a concert with your favorite instruments. You can enjoy a single instrument or a whole band with the guitar, piano, drums, trumpet, violin, cello, harp and singer. Decorate the scene with fog machine, confetti and disco ball. Dress up and fix the makeup. It's fun time in the animal school of rock!
GYM
Get some air & exercise or play in the schoolyard. It's always exciting to go down the slide or swing with a friend. Organize an hour of gymnastics or shoot some hoops in this fun pet game. 
IT'S SCHOOL TIME
Let's discover educational games with your virtual pet. You can play with geometric shapes or learn multiplication, addition, subtraction, and division at the difficulty level of your choice. Learn some basic English words or train your writing to learn abc. It's school time - make educational games fun with your virtual pet and cute animal games! 
SCHOOL RESTAURANT
Become a master chef. Prepare delicious sandwiches, sweet fruit, and salad for the hungry students or serve them a yummy birthday cake.
To return home safely, you can practice walking safely in a classic road crossing minigame.
PUZZLES FOR KIDS
Would you like to know our adorable virtual pets even better? Collect all the puzzles from their memory album, put them in the right place, and reveal what memories they hide. In addition, you'll unlock a unique colorful fish for each album page. Decorate the animal school with a relaxing aquarium full of all kinds of beautiful fishes.
It's time to try out this endless fun school game! Learn abc & how to draw with coloring for kids. Play music for kids & learn how to play piano or learn multiplication. Try them all within cute animal games. The cute pets - Bubbu cat, Duddu dog, Bunny, Crocodile, Piggy, Hedgehog, Owl, Penguin, and Panda are waiting for you in this virtual pet game!

Simple interactive pretend play game
Lots of exciting, fun and educational games
No rules or goals, just freedom to create your pets stories
Animal school game for girls, boys, and the whole family
Many cute animal games
Adorable jigsaw puzzles for kids
Beautiful high-quality HD graphics

bluejetty:00157229:ios.description:
POINT is one app to volunteer for any cause. 
We’re your starting point to do more good. 
How does POINT work? 
FOLLOW CAUSES & FIND NONPROFITS
There are 20 cause categories on POINT (think: poverty, education, homelessness, climate, etc.) and you can choose to follow any, or all, of them. Local volunteer opportunities related to the causes you pick will show up on your feed. You can also discover all the local nonprofits working for a specific cause by clicking into the icon. 
VOLUNTEER AT EVENTS
Your volunteer feed is personalized based on the causes you pick, and you can filter by the times you’re free. Find an event you’re excited about? Simply tap "go” and show up. POINT will tell you all the information you need to know on the app, before you arrive. 
MEET NEW PEOPLE 
See who else is going to volunteer, so you know you won’t show up alone. You can meet new people from your community, or you can share the event with your squad (because hey, sometimes you need to shake things up). 
Along with the POINT app, nonprofits and other organizations have access to the POINT dashboard, where they can post events and manage volunteers. More at https://pointapp.org/nonprofits/

ASV Bible for your iPhone, iPad or iPod that one can read easily. The Revised Version, Standard American Edition of the Bible, more commonly known as the American Standard Version (ASV), was released in the early 90's and it became part of books in the public domain. It is very popular in the united states and one of the widely used versions.
With the many Bible versions we have, this is another one you can use together with other Bibles like the KJV Bible. Learning the Bible and knowing God through the written word is what makes us who we are as children of the most High God. Jesus said "My word is life and truth"
Some have written that "It was originally best known by its full name such as the American Revised Version, the American Standard Revision, the American Standard Revised Bible, and the American Standard Edition". 
American Standard Version Bible or ASV Bible has the following features
1. Daily Bible Verse
We have selected great Bible verses that will inspire you everyday to read the word of God. Let us learn to meditate on God's word daily. Open your phone in the morning to a good and soothing Bible verse for inspiration
2. Daily Chapter in ASV Bible
If you make it a habit to read one chapter of the ASV Bible offline daily, you will be amazed that at the end of the year you will now know about 365 chapters which is great as a student of the word of God.
3. Topical Bible Verses from Bible ASV offline
In this American Standard Version Bible offline, you get to find specially picked verses that can help you in various situations. When you want to find quick access to love Bible verses, you can find it.
4. Track your progress in ASV Bible
Do you want to know how many scriptures or verses you have read, there is a progress bar that helps you to get that noted down. You should click on the tick and then it will show as chapter completed.

You can select either Old Testament of the ASV Bible or New Testament. The Old testament has 39 chapters and the new testament has 27 chapters. In total the American Standard Version Bible for offline use has 66 chapters just like all other Bibles

In this ASV Offline Bible, you can share a lot of the verses with other people. The sharing feature can also be done on image. This means you can personalize the Bible verses from the ASV Bible. You can easily share on Twitter, Facebook and other social media platform.

bluejetty:00039541:ios.description:
"مِلكة" هو تطبيق زواج، صُمم ليلبي احتياجات الباحثين والباحثات عن شريك الحياة بما يتوافق مع تعاليم ديننا الاسلامي وعادات وتقاليد مجتمعنا. 
مميزات تطبيق ملكة:
أولاً: التصفح والبحث
 1. تصفح مجاني: استكشف ملفات شخصية متنوعة دون الحاجة إلى اشتراك.
 2. بحث متقدم: استخدم تصفية النتائج لتحديد معايير البحث والعثور على الشريك المناسب.
 3. القبيلة: إمكانية البحث وفق معايير محددة مثل الانتماء لقبيلة معينة.
 4. استعراض الطلبات: المرسلة والمستقبلة لتتمكن من اضافة الاشخاص الملائمين فقط. 
 5. قائمة المفضلة: لتتمكن من العودة للاشخاص اللذين يناسبونك مبدئيا بسهولة.
ثانياً: جودة المجتمع
 6. مجتمع راقٍ: يتماشى مع تعاليم الإسلام.
 7. تقييد الإضافات: عدد المضافين محدود بـ 5 لضمان الجدية في التفاعل.
ثالثاً: التواصل والتفاعل
 8. تواصل آمن: المحادثات تبدأ بموافقة متبادلة فقط، مع خيارات أمان متقدمة.
 9. طلبات التواصل الفردية: شراء طلبات تواصل بشكل منفصل دون الحاجة للاشتراك في باقة شهرية.
 10. أسئلة متجددة: أسئلة متنوعة يمكن الإجابة عليها بالصوت أو النص، مع إمكانية اقتراح أسئلة تُرسل لجميع المستخدمين لتعزيز التفاعل.
 11. حالات ظهور متعددة: متاح للتواصل، طور محادثات هاتفية، علاقة جادة، غير متاح للتواصل
رابعاً: الخصوصية والأمان
 12. الفلتر الذكي: تحكم كامل في من يمكنه مشاهدة ملفك الشخصي من خلال فلترة كلمات محددة للحجب.
 13. خيارات التصفح:
 أ. وضع التصفح الخفي بالكامل.
 ب. إمكانية إخفاء إشعارات زيارة الملف الشخصي.
 ج. تخصيص الجنسيات اللتي يمكنها رؤية حسابك.
 14. إبلاغ سريع وآمن: تقديم بلاغات بسهولة عبر تصوير الشاشة ورفعها مباشرة مع ضمان السرية.
 15. خصوصية تامة: فريق ملكة يضمن سرية كاملة ولا يطّلع على المحادثات نهائياً.
 16. ارسال صور تفتح لمرة واحدة: مثل تطبيقات التواصل الشهيرة يمكنك ارسال صورة لعرضها لمرة واحدة، ويمنع تصوير الشاشة.
خامساً: الدعم والاستشارات
 17. مستشارون متخصصون: دعم من مستشارين ذوي خلفيات علمية ومهنية لتوجيهكم في رحلة البحث عن شريك الحياة.
 18. فريق دعم فني: فريق سريع ومتعاون لحل أي استفسار أو مشكلة تواجه المستخدمين.
سادساً: تصميم وتجربة المستخدم
 19. معلومات شاملة: ملفات شخصية تحتوي على أنماط الشخصيات، لغات الحب، والاهتمامات لفهم أعمق للشريك.
 20. انماط عرض مريحة: إمكانية التبديل بين النمط الداكن والنمط الفاتح لتجربة مريحة للعين.
سابعاً: العوائل والمصداقية
 21. حسابات عوائل: يتيح للعوائل إنشاء حسابات للتواصل نيابة عن الأبناء أو البنات.
انضموا إلينا اليوم وابدؤوا رحلتكم لإيجاد شريك الحياة المناسب.

listings.name: Melkah: Find Your Life Partner
listings.description:
Melkah — For marriage, not casual dating.

Melkah is a marriage app for men and women who are serious about finding a life partner, guided by Islamic values.

BROWSE AND DISCOVER
• Browse without a subscription: Explore profiles and discover potential matches.
• Advanced search: Filter results by the qualities that matter to you.
• Connection requests: Manage your sent and received requests and choose who you connect with.
• Favorites: Save profiles that interest you and revisit them anytime.

MEANINGFUL CONNECTIONS
• A respectful community: Meet people who share Islamic values and a commitment to marriage.
• Focused conversations: Connect with up to five people at a time to give each connection the attention it deserves.

COMMUNICATE WITH PURPOSE
• Mutual consent: Conversations begin only when both people agree to connect.
• Individual connection requests: Purchase requests separately without a monthly subscription.
• Profile questions: Share more about yourself through text or voice answers. You can also suggest new questions for the community.
• Availability status: Let others know whether you’re available to connect, at the phone-call stage, in a serious relationship, or unavailable.

PRIVACY AND SAFETY
• Smart filter: Restrict who can view your profile using specific keywords.
• Visibility controls: Browse in incognito mode, hide notifications of your profile visits, and choose which nationalities can see your profile.
• Confidential reporting: Submit a report by taking and uploading a screenshot.
• Private conversations: The Melkah team does not access your chats.
• View-once photos: Send photos that can be opened only once, with screenshots blocked.

GUIDANCE AND SUPPORT
• Experienced advisors: Get guidance from advisors with relevant academic and professional backgrounds throughout your search for a life partner.
• Responsive support: Get help with questions or technical issues.

A PERSONAL EXPERIENCE
• Detailed profiles: Explore personality types, love languages, and interests to better understand potential matches.
• Light and dark modes: Choose the display that feels most comfortable for you.

FAMILY INVOLVEMENT
• Family accounts: Families can create accounts and connect on behalf of their sons or daughters.

Join Melkah today and take the first step toward finding your life partner.

Website:
https://melkah.com

Make Me Old
Select any face image. Click on "Make Me Old" button and app will provide your futuristic face look.
Make Me Baby

Gender Swap
Select any face image. Click on Gender Swap button and it will swap your face image from "Male to Female" or "Female to Male" as per your selection.

Select 1 photo of celebrity and another any of your photos. You need to wait for few seconds and app will tell you the match between celebrities.

bluejetty:00129995:ios.description:
This is a tuner app that visualizes pitch and intonation over time.
◯ Basic Features
The app displays the pitch and intonation of incoming sound as a trace on the screen.
Try singing toward your iPhone—you'll instantly see how accurate your pitch is, including slides and scoops.
You can also tap the piano keyboard to play precise reference tones.
Perfect for vocal training.
Of course, it's not just for singing—you can also use it to tune or practice musical instruments.
It supports a wide pitch range from C0 to B7, making it ideal for practicing with whistling or voice-based instruments too.
◯ Audio Playback Features
Analyze and display the pitch of imported audio tracks.
By comparing the pitch of the original audio with your own in real time, you can train yourself to match the reference more accurately.
You can also change the key of the song during playback.
With the vocal separation feature powered by AI, you can split the vocals and accompaniment of the imported audio.
Play back "vocals only" or "accompaniment only" while displaying the pitch of the vocals—perfect for practicing along.
◯ Sheet Music
Import MIDI, MusicXML, or MuseScore files to view the score while it plays.
Sing along with the reference pitch, and practice with the metronome or by changing the key.
◯ VocalTuner Pro (In-App Purchase)
Even on the free plan, you can save and practice with songs, scores, and recordings (up to 2 songs, 2 scores, and 3 recordings).
Upgrade to VocalTuner Pro to save unlimited songs, scores, and recordings, and remove ads. It's a one-time purchase, not a subscription.
※ For feature requests or feedback, please use the review section or the in-app feedback feature.
