Try OU7 to get the following 
• workout videos with a detailed description for men and women;
• walk and run workouts with a map support and detailed analytics;

• individual meal plans: normal, gluten-free, lactose-free, vegan;
• water tracker with individual daily intake calculations and reminders;

• cool challenges.
Absolutely free. No ads, no in-app purchases.
• Exercise any place and any time 
At home or on vacation, in the office and anywhere else — you can exercise with a personal instructor in your smartphone.
• Video with detailed voice and text explanations
Perform the exercises correctly following video guide and detailed explanations.

Track your performance to reach the professional level of training and achieve the best results.

Track your progress and workout data in activity rings.

bluejetty:00061691:ios.description:
SnagBricks: Streamline Site Audits, Snag Lists, Punch Lists & Defect Tracking
SnagBricks is the ultimate tool for site audits, snagging, inspections, punch lists, snag lists, quality checks, defect tracking, checklists, risk assessments, and safety reports. It's also ideal for general site management, field reporting, maintenance, asset tracking, compliance, and team collaboration in construction, healthcare, facilities, and beyond.
Tired of chaotic notes slowing down your audits? SnagBricks transforms fieldwork into effortless efficiency: capture defects on-site with multiple photos (now up to 10 per snag), add precise markups, build detailed snag and punch lists, and generate professional PDF or Excel reports in minutes. No internet required—works fully offline with no signup needed.
Whether you're working solo or with a team, SnagBricks simplifies reporting snags, producing inspection reports, and delivering quotations—boosting productivity and ensuring compliance every time.
Key Features
Advanced Project Creation
- Effortlessly start projects with rich details: photos, names, reference numbers, locations, client info, and auditor details.
- Update, copy, or duplicate projects in real-time for quick setup on similar jobs.
- Sort, search, and filter projects with new advanced filters for instant access.
Powerful Snag, Punch & Inspection Lists
- Build detailed lists for snags, defects, inspections, or observations.
- Attach up to 10 photos per item and use enhanced markup tools to highlight issues clearly.
- Add titles, assignments, statuses, tags, priorities, and rich descriptions.
- Use predefined lists to save time and reduce typing.
- Copy individual snags or entire projects for rapid replication.
- Filter and sort issues easily for better organization.
Customized Reporting
- Export to customizable PDF and Excel formats with premium themes and font options.
- Adjust font styles, sizes, photo quality, and date formats app-wide.
- Apply report filters and modify labels (e.g., "snag" to "defect" or "observation").
- Update company details, logos, and auditor names.
- Enable/disable fields and sections to tailor reports to client needs.
Seamless Sharing & Collaboration
- Collaborate with multiple users on shared projects.
- Exchange snag details, updates, and reports instantly.
- Generate unified team reports from shared data for smooth handovers.
Versatile & Customizable for Any Industry
- Perfect for site auditing, snagging, quality assurance, and construction management.
- Handle inspections, punch lists, defect tracking, checklists, condition assessments, site walks, surveys, and safety inspections.
- Adapt terminology, workflows, and UI (now updated for the latest iOS) to fit healthcare, real estate, manufacturing, or facilities needs.
Feedback and Support
Questions or suggestions? Contact us at support@appculus.com or visit www.snagbricks.com.
Download SnagBricks today and elevate your audits—capture, collaborate, and report like a pro!

bluejetty:00013889:ios.description:
Com o app BTG Pactual Investimentos, você pode ter todas as vantagens do Maior Banco de Investimentos da América Latina na palma da mão. Da renda fixa à renda variável, pode investir nos ativos que fazem mais sentido para a sua carteira, passando por papéis do Tesouro, CDBs, fundos, ações, FIIs, câmbio, previdência e outros mais. 
No BTG Pactual, você conta com a assessoria de nossos especialistas para fazer as melhores escolhas de investimentos e, diante de qualquer necessidade, pode acionar o atendimento humanizado disponível 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana. 
Renda fixa 
Invista nos melhores ativos da renda fixa como CDBs, títulos do Tesouro Direto e outros papéis atrelados a diversos indicadores, como a taxa Selic e a inflação. No BTG Pactual Investimentos, você pode compor uma carteira de investimentos em renda fixa diversificada, com vários prazos, emissores e indexadores diferentes, permitindo que aplique seu patrimônio com eficiência. 
Oferecemos um catálogo completo, incluindo CDBs, LCIs, LCAs, CRIs, CRAs, debêntures e outros ativos. Pode contar ainda com os nossos especialistas para escolher as melhores opções de papéis e investir on-line diretamente no app BTG Pactual Investimentos. 
Os investimentos em renda fixa são ideais para compor uma parcela mais segura do seu portfólio, já que os riscos de perda são mínimos em comparação com outras classes de ativos. 
Renda variável 
O BTG Pactual Investimentos oferece plataformas de negociação ideais para você fazer suas operações na Bolsa de Valores de forma descomplicada. É possível investir em renda variável por meio das carteiras recomendadas e manter um portfólio diversificado, com o suporte de nossos assessores para escolher empresas com bons fundamentos. 
Fundos de investimentos 
Os fundos de investimentos são uma excelente opção para quem não tem conhecimentos suficiente da área para escolher os próprios papéis de forma independente ou prefere a gestão de um profissional para facilitar o processo e garantir escolhas mais certeiras. 
Há fundos de investimentos para todos os perfis, passando por opções de renda fixa, ações, câmbio e até fundos multimercado, que agregam diversas classes de ativos no mesmo fundo, permitindo que o investidor diversifique sua carteira apenas com as cotas de um único fundo de investimento. 
Câmbio 
Realize pagamentos e recebimentos do exterior com agilidade e segurança e conte com o auxílio de um assessor do Maior Banco de Investimentos da América Latina para grandes operações. 
Quer proteger seu patrimônio com moedas fortes, como o dólar e o euro? O BTG Pactual Investimentos oferece toda a segurança de que você precisa para realizar suas transações tranquilamente. 
Previdência 
No BTG Pactual, a previdência privada vai muito além de um complemento para a aposentadoria. Oferecemos uma plataforma multifundos diferenciada que faz com que seu dinheiro trabalhe por você, além do suporte de assessores especializados. 
Essa modalidade de investimento oferece diversos benefícios e permite que você construa seu patrimônio com maior flexibilidade, pensando no médio e longo prazo. O investimento não sofre come-cotas e ainda é possível abater até 12% da sua renda bruta anual tributável na declaração do Imposto de Renda no caso de aportes em planos PGBL. 
Flls 
Os Fundos Imobiliários (FIIs) são fundos de investimento voltados ao mercado imobiliário. Eles são isentos de Imposto de Renda e negociados na Bolsa de Valores, facilitando o acesso aos principais empreendimentos imobiliários do Brasil com um valor de entrada

bluejetty:00120840:ios.description:
The America's Got Talent App is the best way to PLAY ALONG and VOTE while you watch NBC's hit talent show on TV! 
Season 21 is here - only on NBC! 
Summer’s got star power with judges Simon Cowell, Sofia Vergara, Mel B and Howie Mandel, who join host Terry Crews for another season of unforgettable performances. 
Watch performances while playing along with judges and host Terry Crews. Use a buzzer personalized with iconic judge sound bites to bring the full America’s Got Talent experience to your phone. 
Get to know the performers you love with act profiles, featuring bios. Follow your favorite acts on Facebook, TikTok or Instagram, keep up with the latest AGT news and vote during the Live Shows. You never know who the next great American performer will be! 
With The America's Got Talent App, you can: 
VOTE AND PLAY ALONG 
• Vote for your favorite acts during Live Shows by logging in with your NBCUniversal Profile 
• Use your green, red and golden buzzers to sound off whenever you want, even when the show's not on TV 
STREAM EXCLUSIVE VIDEO CLIPS 
• Watch the latest videos of your favorite performances 
• Use video filters to stream your favorite clips and acts right from your phone 
GET SOCIAL 
• Join the conversation by following your favorite acts on Facebook, TikTok or Instagram 
• Get the latest entertainment news and updates right in the app with AGT's social feed 
Vote for your favorite acts and keep up with the latest news. Download The America’s Got Talent App today!

Video is accessible via 3G, 4G, LTE, 5G and Wi-Fi networks. Data charges may apply.

bluejetty:00015531:ios.description:
Noorani Qaida is an Arabic Learning Utility, designed to assist Muslim Kids and all those who are naïve to Quranic Alphabets. This App will facilitate the beginners in learning Arabic Alphabets in intuitive way that are the basics towards understanding Tajweed (rules) of Quran.
Noorani Qaida App contains chapters and the sequence of the chapters is in accordance to the level of learning from easy to complex.
Chapter no. 1: Chapter 1 contains all thirty Arabic Alphabets in alluring way. 
Chapter no. 2: Chapter 2 contains the widely used words of Quran and Arabic language in distinctive texture.
Chapter no. 3: Third chapter contains Huroof-e-Muqqataat which are the secret words mentioned in the start of 29 Chapter of Quran and the meaning is known to none, but Allah Almighty.
 Chapter no. 4 - 12: These chapters have covered all about Arabic Phonics i.e. how to pronounce the Arabic Alphabets and Arabic words with Sounds. This practice will make the beginners and kids perfect in learning the pronunciation of Arabic Alphabets and Words.
Instruction section has included in order to guide users further towards learning the precise pronunciation of Arabic Alphabets.
It will serve as Quran Teaching Application for all the kids and the beginners who are keen to learn Quran because Arabic Alphabets are the backbone towards learning the language of Quran. Download and rate – Jazak’Allah

bluejetty:00083002:ios.description:
AI Chat - AI Chatbot Assistant: Your Ultimate AI Companion
In today's digital landscape, staying productive and getting instant answers are more important than ever. Whether you’re a student, professional, or someone trying to optimize daily tasks, the AI Chat - AI Chatbot Assistant is the perfect tool to enhance your life. This AI-powered app combines advanced AI Chat Bot capabilities, image generation, document summarization, and essay writing into one seamless experience.
Key Features
Chat About Anything with AI
With the AI Chat - AI Chatbot Assistant, you can ask any question and get intelligent, accurate responses in seconds. Whether you’re looking for casual conversation, brainstorming ideas, or asking for complex solutions, the AI Chat Bot delivers high-quality answers. Powered by cutting-edge AI Chat GPT technology, the chatbot keeps the conversation relevant and engaging.
Generate Essays and Creative Content
Need help with writing? The AI Essay Writer feature allows you to generate well-researched and coherent essays on any topic. Perfect for students and professionals alike, this tool helps save time while ensuring quality. Just provide an outline or topic, and let the Chat Bot AI Assistant handle the writing for you.
Summarize Documents Quickly
If you're tired of going through long articles or reports, the Summarize Documents feature allows you to condense large texts into quick, digestible summaries. Whether it's an academic paper or a work-related report, this tool ensures you get the key takeaways without wasting time. With this smart assistant, document comprehension has never been easier.
Create Stunning Images with AI
The AI Image Generator enables you to create stunning visuals with just a few keywords. From abstract designs to practical graphics, you can turn your ideas into beautiful images instantly. Ideal for content creators, designers, and marketers, the app offers endless possibilities for creativity.
AI Voice Communication
For hands-free convenience, the app offers AI Voice communication. You can interact with the AI Bot by simply speaking your commands, making it easier to perform tasks on the go. The app’s voice recognition capabilities ensure smooth, natural conversations and enhance your overall productivity.
Translate & Interpret Languages
Need to communicate across languages? The AI Translator lets you translate text into multiple languages effortlessly. Whether you're working on international projects or simply need help understanding a foreign document, the AI Language Translator is there to break down language barriers. Additionally, it can interpret real-time conversations, making communication even smoother.
Professional Assistants for Every Task
The AI Chatbot Assistant isn’t just for casual conversations. It acts as your own smart assistant, helping with tasks such as organizing schedules, generating documents, or managing reminders. No matter how busy you are, this AI-powered assistant helps you stay on top of everything.
Why Choose AI Chat - AI Chatbot Assistant?
• Instant Responses: Get real-time answers to any query.
• Multi-Functionality: From generating images to summarizing documents, the app offers a wide range of features.
• User-Friendly Interface: Easy to navigate, even for beginners.
• Multilingual Support: With the AI Translator, you can communicate across multiple languages seamlessly.
• Voice Control: Interact with the AI Chatbot through voice commands, adding another layer of convenience.
Additional Features
• Free AI Chat for quick, casual conversations
• Text AI tools for instant content generation and document editing

bluejetty:00032350:ios.name: Match Miracle: Triple Match 3D
bluejetty:00032350:ios.summary:
Welcome to Match Miracle: Triple Tile 3D Game. Play with Ben and Jerry to solve fun tiles matching puzzles and unlock unique building and decoration systems. 
Find triple tiles, beat levels, train your matching skill in every single match
bluejetty:00032350:ios.description:
Welcome to Match Miracle: Triple Tile 3D Game. Play with Ben and Jerry to solve fun tiles matching puzzles and unlock unique building and decoration systems. 
Find triple tiles, beat levels, train your matching skill in every single match puzzle, and become a match master with your puzzle-solving abilities. It's easy to play for everyone who is into the 3d match games of all match skill levels. Just tap on the 3D tiles on the screen to arrange the matching tiles. Be aware of the timer ticking in each fresh puzzle level and keep up matching tiles to achieve the goal. Utilize the boosters and hints to unravel and master the match puzzles within the triple match tiles game.
Match Miracle: Triple 3D Game Features: 
- Tons of 3D objects are packed within each match triple 3D game level, including fruits, candies, cakes, lovely animals, balls… With each puzzle board cleared, the new 3D tiles will ensure you an enjoyable matching journey. 
- A diverse selection of 3D boosters, such as shuffle, bomb, blitz, magnet, will guide you through your magic 3D game journey and propel you towards mastering the triple match. 
- Discover a range of enchanting scenes and start off for a miracle match adventure. Sort goods, clear match puzzles and collect stars to build structures and objects within each scene. 
- Play with match master friends to win additional rewards and become a real match master.
Match Miracle is free to download and play. Get ready for a blast of matching fun with Match Miracle!

Let's grab the instruments and treat your animal patients! You have everything you need to become their favorite dentist!

Beat colorful match-3 levels to renovate a
bluejetty:00121438:ios.description:
Welcome to Homescapes, a truly heartwarming game from Playrix's Scapes™ series! Solve match-3 puzzles to restore a wonderful mansion on a verdant street. Exciting adventures start at the doorstep!
Beat colorful match-3 levels to renovate and decorate rooms in the mansion, unlocking ever more chapters in the exciting family story along the way! What are you waiting for? Make yourself at home!
The game features:
● Unique gameplay: help Austin renovate the house by swapping and matching pieces!
● Interior design: you decide what the house will look like.
● Exciting match-3 levels: tons of fun, featuring unique boosters and explosive combinations!
● A huge, beautiful mansion: discover all the secrets it holds!
● Fantastic characters: watch them live their lives and interact with each other in the in-game social network.
● A cute pet: meet а naughty and fluffy cat.
● Invite your Facebook friends to help you create your own cozy atmosphere in the house!
Homescapes is free to play, but some in-game elements (including randomized items) can be purchased for real money. If you don't want to use this option, simply turn it off in your device's Restrictions menu.
Enjoying Homescapes? Learn more about the game!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/homescapes/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/homescapes_mobile/
Questions? Contact our Tech Support by sending an email to support@playrix.com.

bluejetty:00073835:ios.name: Cuespeak
bluejetty:00073835:ios.summary: Supercharge your speech therapy with Cuespeak, the NHS-recommended rehabilitation tool for people with speech, language, and cognitive difficulties after stroke or brain injury. Designed for use in both home and clinic, Cuespeak offers a hu
bluejetty:00073835:ios.description:
Supercharge your speech therapy with Cuespeak, the NHS-recommended rehabilitation tool for people with speech, language, and cognitive difficulties after stroke or brain injury. Designed for use in both home and clinic, Cuespeak offers a huge range of exercises to work on aphasia and apraxia of speech, addressing speaking, understanding, reading and writing.
Key Features:
- Expert-Developed Content: Access hundreds of exercises developed by specialist speech and language therapists
- Personalise it: Customise your therapy sessions and add personalised content such as names of family and friends
- Engaging and Fun: Cuespeak’s interactive exercises are relevant to real life to keep you motivated
- Up to date: New content added every week, including the latest items from the news
- Share sessions via email: Allows you to get help from someone in another location
- Accessible on the move: Use Cuespeak on your iPhone or iPad, so you can practise anytime, anywhere, making therapy convenient and flexible
Who is it for?
- People with speech and language difficulties seeking a home therapy tool
- Caregivers and family members supporting a loved one’s recovery following stroke or brain injury
What users have said:
- “I just wanted to thank you for your marvellous programme. My husband has severe aphasia but has not lost his intelligence. Your programme stimulates his interest – there is no dumbing down. Keep up the good work. We love the humour in Cuespeak” Home user
- “This is the best therapy tool I have ever used” Elizabeth McBarnet, Speech & Language Therapist, N. Ireland
- "I can’t stress enough how much I love this app. I have been using it today with a lady with apraxia and aphasia and she was just so excited by how relevant it was to her life!” Bev Snowden, Senior Specialist SLT, North Devon Healthcare Trust

Own your workplace performance — starting now...
Amazing stuff happens every shift. ShiftOne lets you keep track. 
Own Your Performance.
ShiftOne puts your performance data directly in your palm. A simple tap lets you view customer ratings, access comments, and see how you stack up against coworkers across your region.

Step Up Your Game.
Let the brag wars begin. Race your way to the top of the leaderboards by stacking perfect ratings. Satisfied customers leave satisfying tips (it’s science). 
Have Fun!
Work is better with a little excitement. Spice up your shifts — starting now.
Hit Us Up.
ShiftOne is all about you. Tell us how we can make it better by tapping on your profile picture and selecting “give feedback.”
Happy snapping
— The ShiftOne team

bluejetty:00129082:ios.description:
Namaz vakti geldiğinde yön aramakla vakit kaybetmeyin. Kıble Yönü; evde, işte, seyahatte ya da hiç bilmediğiniz bir şehirde kıbleyi saniyeler içinde gösterir, namaz vakitlerini de her an yanınızda taşır.
KIBLEYİ SANİYELER İÇİNDE BULUN
Telefonunuzu düz tutun, gerisini Kıble Yönü'ne bırakın. Kıbleye döndüğünüz an pusula yeşile döner, telefonunuz hafifçe titrer. "Doğru yöne mi duruyorum?" diye düşünmenize gerek kalmaz.
• Hassas pusula: Kıble açısı konumunuza göre hesaplanır, gerçek kuzeye göre gösterilir.
• Kamerayla görün: Kameranızı açın, altın ışını takip edin; kıble tam karşınızda.
• Haritada izleyin: Konumunuzdan Kâbe'ye uzanan yolu ve mesafeyi görün.
• Yol gösteren rehber: Su terazisi göstergesi ve kalibrasyon kılavuzuyla daha doğru sonuç.
• Size uygun tasarım: Klasik, Ok, Geleneksel ve Sade pusulalar arasından seçin.
NAMAZ VAKİTLERİ HER AN YANINIZDA
Türkiye'de ya da dünyanın neresinde olursanız olun, Diyanet uyumlu vakitler cebinizde.
• Konumunuz otomatik bulunur; dilerseniz ülke, şehir ve ilçe seçin.
• Sıradaki vakte geri sayım, Hicri tarih ve günün tüm vakitleri tek bakışta.
• Vakitler cihazınızda saklanır, internet olmadan da açılır.
HİÇBİR VAKTİ KAÇIRMAYIN
• Vakit girdiğinde ezan sesiyle haber alın.
• Vakitten 5 ile 60 dakika önce hatırlatma kurun, hazırlanmaya zamanınız olsun.
• Her vakit için ayrı ses, ayrı hatırlatma.
ANA EKRANINIZDA, KİLİT EKRANINIZDA
• Uygulamayı açmadan vakitleri görün: küçük, orta ve büyük namaz vakitleri widget'ları.
• Kıble widget'ıyla yön her an bir bakış uzağınızda.
• Kilit ekranında Hicri tarih, günün vakitleri ve sıradaki vakte geri sayım.
BİLEĞİNİZDE KIBLE
• Apple Watch'ta kıble pusulası ve namaz vakitleri.
• Saat kadranınıza sıradaki vakit ve kıble komplikasyonlarını ekleyin.
• iPhone'unuz yanınızda olmasa bile çalışır.
HER DURUMDA YANINIZDA
• iPad'de de kullanın; pusulası olmayan cihazlarda kıble haritada çizilir.
• Konum izni vermek istemezseniz seçtiğiniz yere göre çalışır.
• Gece de göz yormayan koyu tema.
KIBLE BUL PRO
Reklamsız, sade bir ibadet deneyimi için Pro'ya geçin: reklamlar kalkar, tüm pusula tasarımları açılır ve geliştiriciye destek olursunuz. Pro, aylık ve yıllık abonelik seçenekleriyle sunulur.
• Ödeme, satın alma onaylandığında Apple Hesabınızdan alınır.
• Abonelik, dönem bitiminden en az 24 saat önce iptal edilmezse otomatik olarak yenilenir; yenileme ücreti dönem bitmeden önceki 24 saat içinde alınır.
• Aboneliğinizi App Store hesap ayarlarınızdan yönetebilir ve otomatik yenilemeyi kapatabilirsiniz.
• Ücretsiz deneme sunulduğunda, deneme süresinin kullanılmayan kısmı abonelik satın alındığında sona erer.
Kıble Yönü'nü şimdi indirin; namaza gönül rahatlığıyla, doğru yöne dönerek durun.
Kullanım Koşulları (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Gizlilik Politikası: https://codeida.com/privacy/kibleyonu.html

Motorbike riders will surely enjoy the immersive fast-paced gameplay or motorbike simulator. As highway rider dodge traffic on highway in fast real racing challenge or motorbike racing. Dodging cars and trucks while you speed up on the highway is a real challenge. Motorbike simulator racing game with insane and stunt action is best motorbike 2018 game with realistic motorbike physics or extreme stunt bike on highway with heavy traffic.

▶ Realistic Motorbike Physics.

bluejetty:00043856:ios.summary: Our team at Reviver has reimagined what a license plate can do with RPLATE®, the world's first digital license plate. The Reviver App is the companion mobile application for your RPLATE. Owners can change backgrounds and display banner mess
bluejetty:00043856:ios.description:
Our team at Reviver has reimagined what a license plate can do with RPLATE®, the world's first digital license plate. The Reviver App is the companion mobile application for your RPLATE. Owners can change backgrounds and display banner messages to personalize their RPLATE in ways a metal plate never could. Modern Licensing for Modern Living.
RPLATE's are currently available for purchase and DMV registration in AZ and CA. For drivers in these states, they are legal to drive anywhere throughout the U.S.
Features and Benefits:
 • Manage Visual Personalization of your RPlate, switch between light or dark mode, and personalize your banner message.

bluejetty:00145336:ios.description:
Stay updated with the Canadian Stock Market and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX) using a fast, simple and easy-to-use stock market app.
Track Canadian stocks, the S&P/TSX Composite Index, watchlists, portfolios, business news, charts, commodities, cryptocurrencies and currency exchange rates — all in one place. Whether you want to monitor TSX stocks, follow market trends, or keep an eye on your favourite companies, this app gives you essential stock market information in a clean, lightweight interface.
CANADA STOCK MARKET FEATURES
- Live stock prices and market information
- View Open, High, Low, Previous Close, Volume, Market Cap, P/E Ratio, EPS, 52 Week High and 52 Week Low
- Track Toronto Stock Exchange (TSE/TSX) stocks and major Canadian market indices
- Browse Top Gainers, Top Losers and Most Active stocks
- Create a personalised Watchlist to monitor your favourite stocks
- Manage your own Portfolio to track selected stocks in one place
- Read the latest Canada business and financial news
CHARTS AND MARKET DATA
- Interactive stock charts across 1 Day, 1 Month, 3 Months, 6 Months, 1 Year and 2 Years
- Historical price charts and company profile information
- Compare stock momentum and price trends over time
WATCHLIST
Save your favourite Canadian stocks and indices in a personal watchlist for quick access anytime, and follow price moves at a glance.
PORTFOLIO
Organise your selected stocks in a portfolio to track holdings and monitor market performance conveniently, all in one screen.
BUSINESS NEWS
Stay informed with the latest business and financial news related to the Canadian stock market, TSX-listed companies and the broader economy.
ADDITIONAL TOOLS
- Currency Converter for global exchange rates
- Cryptocurrency price list (Bitcoin, Ethereum and more)
- Commodities market information (gold, silver, oil)
- Major Canadian and global market indices
WHY CHOOSE CANADA STOCK MARKET: TSX LIVE?
- Fast and lightweight, with a simple, easy-to-use interface
- Focused Canadian stock market and TSX coverage
- Watchlist and portfolio support in one app
- Interactive charts, quotes and company data
- Currency, crypto and commodities data included
DISCLAIMER
This application is intended for informational and educational purposes only. It does not provide investment, trading or financial advice. Market data may be delayed depending on the data source. Please verify important information from official financial sources before making any financial decisions.

bluejetty:00140983:ios.description:
Welcome to the dangerous world of Apexlands - Idle Tower Defence game!
Your small watchtower is alone against countless troops of evil. Protect it, grow stronger, use different tactics, control warriors and build a whole castle to defend your lands. 
You will face many waves of monsters. Don’t be afraid of defeat, it’s a crucial part of the game. Use what you’ve learned in previous battles, upgrade your tower and warriors to another try!
***START EASILY AND HAVE FUN***
Apexlands gameplay is simple: defend the tower until its destruction. If you lose, gather strength and start again. You don’t need to be a skilled warlord in this Idle TD game!
***FIGHT AGAINST VICIOUS MONSTERS***
Your tower will be attacked by different enemies. They come from various worlds and have their own strengths and weaknesses. Test your strategic thinking and make quick tactical decisions. Even in an idle game you will always be in a rush! 
***UPGRADE YOUR TOWER***
Use iron during battle to manage resources, grow power and defense of your tower. After battle wisely invest gold into permanent upgrades. Pay attention to the long-term perspective and unlock new abilities, allowing you to make game-changing improvements. 
***MAKE ALLIANCES WITH WARRIORS***
You will start protecting the tower with a lonely archer. When your tower grows into a castle, you may need a whole army of defenders. Invite mighty warriors and protect your lands!
Did you like to play? We will be very glad to hear from you!

Let the bubbles fly in a charming bubble shooter downloaded by more than 45 
MILLION players! Match and pop colorful bubbles in over 10,000 captivating level 
games, and participate in special events to earn awesome rewards! Have lots of

shooting adventure bursting with a nearly endless supply of challenges! Grab 
your trusty slingshot and shoot those bubbles to drop the pigs and rescue the 
impossibly adorable Hatchlings. With special guests and events popping up all the

come with their fair share of rewards! One of a kind bubble pop games!

– Over 10,000 levels! New levels added every week.
– Tons of bubble popping puzzles to solve, from simple to difficult.

– Intuitive controls – tap, slingshot, or point to shoot with precision.
– Play fun, limited-time events for the best rewards.
– Save cute animals and take on a variety of game modes!
– Defeat enemies with the slingshot – those piggies have met their match!
– Fun and colorful graphics and animations.

bluejetty:00116783:ios.name: Hidden Objects - Items Find
bluejetty:00116783:ios.summary: Find Hidden Objects – game that takes you on an exciting journey through beautiful 2D locations, where hundreds of hidden items and objects await you! Explore picturesque landscapes, mysterious cities, and magical worlds to find what's hidd
bluejetty:00116783:ios.description:
Find Hidden Objects – game that takes you on an exciting journey through beautiful 2D locations, where hundreds of hidden items and objects await you! Explore picturesque landscapes, mysterious cities, and magical worlds to find what's hidden!
Key Features of game:
• A massive collection of levels to uncover hidden things – each with its own unique design and atmosphere!
• Spot the Differences mode – increasingly challenging tasks for true detectives!
• Beautiful 2D graphics in the object-finding game – detailed locations and smooth animations!
• Various themes – from ancient civilizations to fantasy worlds!
• Relaxing gameplay – perfect for relieving stress and enjoying the search for items!
• Hints – find even the hardest-hidden objects with helpful tips.
Discover incredible worlds like pirate adventures, medieval fantasy realms, or the futuristic landscapes of tech-savvy Asia in this Find Objects games! Spot items, earn additional hints, and unlock new maps even faster!
Each map is packed with dozens of hidden homages and Easter eggs, beautifully hand-crafted by talented artists.
Choose Your Adventure:
The Lost Treasures of Pirate Island – uncover ancient artifacts amidst palm trees and caverns.
Detective in Cyberpunk Tokyo – unveil the mysteries of the neon city while exploring its streets.
Secrets of the Dragon Castle – find magical artifacts within the halls of medieval castles.
Stroll through iconic landmarks around the world, from New York City to Paris, and collect souvenirs from across the globe!
Why Download This Game?
Finding items for free 
• Offline mode – play the hidden items game without the need for an internet connection!
• Suitable for all ages – enjoyable for kids and adults alike!
• Improves attention and memory – entertaining and beneficial for the brain!
• Regular updates with new locations and modes.
• Anti-stress and relaxing gameplay – similar to popping bubbles or molding slime.
• Search with magnifying tools or photo hints to locate objects.
• A uniquely creative hidden game - spot it!
• Secret objects – each map contains rare items that are tricky to find, adding extra challenge.
• Encourages focus and attentiveness – requiring players to concentrate on minute details and uncover hidden master items in richly detailed locations.
• Engaging quests – each scene has varying levels of difficulty, where players not only find items but solve puzzles too.
• Collection building – some levels let you gather themed sets of unique items as part of a collection.
This offline search game trains your memory and sharpens your focus while soothing you with its vivid maps and eye-pleasing colors! Play anytime, anywhere – whether on a plane, train, car, or even while waiting in line or relaxing outdoors. Dive into this immersive anti-stress game where you need to find objects and explore incredible scenes.
Find all the items in the relaxing game Find Objects!

bluejetty:00129439:ios.description:
freenet Mail ermöglicht es Dir kostenlos, bequem und sicher von überall E-Mails zu lesen und zu schreiben.
Nutze freenet Mail optimal angepasst für Dein iPhone und iPad, denn freenet Mail ist mehr als nur E-Mail:
- unterwegs komfortabel E-Mails lesen und schreiben für all Deine Postfächer
- Verwende mehrere E-Mail Konten in nur einer App - füge Adressen von anderen E-Mail Anbietern wie z.B. web.de, gmx.de und Outlook hinzu
- Einfacher Wechsel zwischen Deinen Postfächern
- Push-Benachrichtigung für neue E-Mails
- Sicheres Senden Deiner E-Mails durch automatische SSL-Verschlüsselung
- PIN-Sperre oder TouchID zum Schutz vor unbefugtem Zugriff (ohne sich abmelden zu müssen)
- Schnelles Löschen einer E-Mail per wischen
- E-Mail Anhänge wie z.B. Fotos öffnen, weiterleiten und speichern direkt aus der App
- Zugriff auf alle E-Mail Ordner und verschieben von E-Mails
- Auf Kontakte und Adressen auf Deinem Smartphone oder Tablet und aus Deinem Postfach zugreifen ohne lästiges synchronisieren
"E-Mail made in Germany"
Im Rahmen der Initiative "E-Mail made in Germany" von freenet, t-online.de, GMX und WEB.de wird eine umfassende SSL-Verschlüsselung auch aus der App heraus sichergestellt, um das Mitlesen Ihres E-Mail-Verkehrs im Internet zu verhindern.
Du hast noch kein Postfach bei freenet? Richte Dir jetzt kostenlos eine E-Mail Adresse unter http://email.freenet.de ein.
Feedback und Support:
Wir freuen uns über jegliches Feedback und entwickeln unsere Applikation stetig weiter. Wir bitten Dich Fehler oder Anmerkungen direkt an mail-iosapp@kundenservice.freenet.de zu senden, bevor Du uns eine schlechte Bewertung gibst. 
Bei Fragen, Anregungen oder Kritik zur freenet Mail App steht unser App-Team Ihnen gerne zur Verfügung.
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00015333:ios.summary:

Java is a general-purpose programming language that is class-based and object-oriented. It is intended to let applicati
bluejetty:00015333:ios.description:
Write Java code directly on your iPhone, iPad and iPod Touch! This app is ideal for learning and testing code snippets!
Java is a general-purpose programming language that is class-based and object-oriented. It is intended to let application developers write once, run anywhere (WORA), meaning that compiled Java code can run on all platforms that support Java without the need for recompilation. Java applications are typically compiled to bytecode that can run on any Java virtual machine (JVM) regardless of the underlying computer architecture.
Features:
- Compile and run your program
- View program output or detailed error 
- Custom keyboard for easy input of frequently used characters
- Optimized for connecting with external physical/bluetooth keyboard
- Advanced source code editor with syntax highlighting, bracket completion and line numbers
- Import files from your personal iCloud Drive account and export files that you create.
Limitations:
- Internet connection is required for compilation
- Maximum program running time is 20s
- One file can be run at a time
- Some file system, network and graphics functions may be limited
- This is a batch compiler; interactive programs are not supported. For example, if your program provides an input prompt, enter the input in the Input tab prior to compilation.

bluejetty:00146869:ios.name: gun.deals
bluejetty:00146869:ios.summary: Gun.deals is a fast and time-saving way to research thousands of stores and compare their offers in order to find what you need in just a few clicks. It is a place where users and visitors share the best gun-related deals available on the w
bluejetty:00146869:ios.description:
Gun.deals is a fast and time-saving way to research thousands of stores and compare their offers in order to find what you need in just a few clicks. It is a place where users and visitors share the best gun-related deals available on the web. 
Browse not just through thousands of guns, firearms, or knives, but also gun parts, ammunition, optics, and outdoor gear like military boots, overalls, protective vests, backpacks, cases, and even more.
Are you looking for a new handgun, shotgun, or rifle? 
Just select what you want and let our app save you a ton of time. Let us help you choose between a pistol or revolver, semi-automatic or bolt-action shotguns, and more. 
You can not make up your mind? 
No problem! With Gun.deals, you can compare different items and make the best possible choice that applies to you! 
We do not sell firearms - we simply present offers from various vendors to make it easier to search for the lowest price. You can also compare prices for the specific model you are interested in. If you are still not satisfied with the price, we will notify you when it drops below the limit price you set, or you can subscribe to a price drop. 
By selecting a specific rifle or gun, you can quickly access more detailed information, including model, action, gauge, caliber, chamber, capacity, barrel length, barrel description, barrel finish, barrel range, etc. We have you covered for any information you need. Choosing the right model could be a real bear, but Gun.deals can help by providing the information you need to reach your goals and enjoy your hobbies. Whether you are a newbie looking for fun on the range, or a veteran with refined tastes, there’s something for everyone.
*** Features: ***
- Search by price, brand, stores, or preferences - it's up to you! Whether you are looking for the lowest price or the best quality, you can always adjust your search to fit your needs.
- Find out the best today's deals and grab what you want!
- Stay up-to-date on the latest offers. We're constantly updating deals and offers, so you will never miss your target.
- Monitor new deals. You can set up the sound alarm and get notified when new deals are published.
- Compare two different items and make the best possible choice.
- Find exclusive discount codes.
- Subscribe for lower prices. Check what other people think and share opinions.
- Stay informed about out-of-stock or expired deals.

bluejetty:00039652:ios.description:
Believe it or not, we've done the impossible and proved the existence of the afterlife.
Just kidding!
What we actually did is develop an amazing app for film lovers - Kinorium from kinorium.com. On it, you can find:
- Info on all movies and stars.
- Instant search in multiple languages (Russian, English, and Ukrainian).
- You can easily comment and rate any movie or save it on the list for the future.
- Movies are grouped in convenient lists: Theaters, Online, Coming soon. From now on you'll always know what to watch.
- All TV shows you watch are in "My TV Shows" section. You'll never forget which episode you left off with.
- Helpful notifications about movie releases you're looking forward to and new episodes of TV shows you're watching.
- With Friend Feed, you are always on top of what your friends are watching: which films they enjoyed and which they hated.
- For a quick start, data import from IMDb and Letterboxd is available.
Try it - and you'll surely love it! Want a bet?
PS Don't forget to invite your friends and acquaintances to share your impressions of good (and less than good) films.
PPS if you get bored, launch Kinorium and shake your phone.

bluejetty:00157839:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00157839:ios.description:
Seven letters. Thirty seconds. How many four-letter words can you think of?
Scramgram is a new kind of daily word game — fast, competitive, and impossible to play just once. No tiles to drag. No grids to fill. Just letters, a countdown timer, and your brain. Tap the letters, make words, beat the clock. Every word you find adds 3 seconds. Miss one and it haunts you.
DAILY CHALLENGE
A fresh puzzle drops every day — same puzzle for everyone. Find common words for stars. Find the rare diamond word to prove you're sharp. Share your score card and dare your friends to do better. Tomorrow, everyone starts equal again.
QUICK PLAY
One daily puzzle not enough? Quick Play serves unlimited word scrambles — no stakes, no waiting, pure practice. Your vocabulary grows with every round, and you'll start spotting words you never noticed before.
TEST YOURSELF
This isn't a relaxing word game. It's a 30-second word test. The timer is real. The pressure is real. And when you find 7 words with 2 seconds left, that feeling is real. You'll surprise yourself with what you know under pressure.
SHARE THE CHALLENGE
Every game generates a score card you can text, WhatsApp, or drop in a group chat. "I found 8 words — can you beat this?" Links open right in the app. The best rivalries start with a shared score.
ANAGRAM SOLVER BUILT IN
Stuck in Scrabble? Need a word for Words with Friends? The built-in anagram solver finds every possible word from any set of letters. Two tools in one app — the game you play daily and the solver you reach for whenever you need it.
WHO PLAYS SCRAMGRAM
People who think Wordle is too slow. Bananagrams fans who want to play solo. Wordscapes players ready for a real test. Crossword addicts. Boggle lovers. Jumble solvers. Your mom. Probably your mom.
New to the App Store. No energy timers. No pay-to-win. Just you and the letters.
Download Scramgram. Your next four-letter word is waiting.

bluejetty:00115162:ios.description:
Twineo lets you create your own personal Digital Twin - an AI-powered version of you that learns from your experiences, opinions and preferences.
As you share more about yourself, your Twin gets to know you better, helping it understand and represent what you think and feel.
Together, you and your Twin can take part in research, share your perspectives with organisations and earn rewards.
How it works
1. Create your Digital Twin
Get started by creating your own personal Digital Twin.
2. Help your Twin get to know you
Share your experiences, opinions and preferences. The more your Twin learns, the better it can represent you.
3. Review what your Twin learns
See what your Twin knows, review its understanding and help it continue to learn and improve.
4. Let your Twin answer for you - and earn
Your Twin can answer research questions on your behalf, grounded in what it's learned from you. Keep sharing your views, helping your Twin improve and earning rewards through research opportunities.
You're always in control
Your Digital Twin is personal to you.
- You stay involved. Keep sharing your opinions and experiences to help your Twin learn and improve.
- You set the boundaries. Choose what information you're comfortable sharing.
- You stay in control. Review and manage what your Twin knows about you.
- Earn rewards. Get rewarded for eligible research activities involving you and your Twin.
Giving real people a voice in the age of AI
We're on a mission to make sure real people have a voice in the age of AI.
We believe AI should reflect what real people actually think and feel. That's why every Digital Twin on Twineo starts with a real person who helps create, shape and improve it over time.
Create your Digital Twin and make your voice count.

Whether you're an art enthusiast, designer, content creator, or simply someone looking to explore artistic creation, ETM makes it easy to bring your ideas to life. This tool is both simple to use and incredibly powerful. You can describe a dreamlike landscape, futuristic cities, or even fantasy creatures, and ETM will transform your words into vibrant visuals. Whether you're looking to enhance artistic effects or create unique visual works, this tool has you covered.

Want to try different facial effects or swap faces in a photo? ETM’s face swap feature lets you upload two images and, in just a few seconds, swap faces for a natural and realistic result. bluejetty:00175639:ios.name: Slow Shutter Cam
bluejetty:00175639:ios.summary: Slow Shutter Cam brings new life into your device's photo toolbox by letting you capture a variety of amazing slow shutter speed effects that you only thought you could get with a DSLR. Continue reading to learn more about this unique app!
bluejetty:00175639:ios.description:
Slow Shutter Cam brings new life into your device's photo toolbox by letting you capture a variety of amazing slow shutter speed effects that you only thought you could get with a DSLR. Continue reading to learn more about this unique app!
-----------------------
• Featured numerous times by Apple:
- App Store Essentials: Camera & Photography
- Photography for Professionals - Total Control
- Extraordinary Photo Apps
- Best New App
-----------------------
"It’s one of those rare photography apps that creates effects that few others are capable of, and it does it easily and with better results."
— Marty Yawnick, Life In LoFi
-----------------------
How many times have you tried to capture artful images with your iPhone camera but were left wishing you had more features to work with? Slow Shutter Cam puts an end to mere snapshots and gives you some of the most powerful features of a DSLR camera. All this, in a package that fits in your pocket.
Slow Shutter Cam offers three capture modes to capture unique images:
MOTION BLUR: Equivalent to the shutter priority mode on a DSLR, the Motion Blur mode is perfect for creating ghost images, waterfall effects or suggesting movement in your photographs by adding a blur.
LIGHT TRAIL: The Light Trail mode allows you to 'paint' with light, show car light trails and fireworks or capture any other moving light in a unique way. Unlike shooting with a DSLR and being tied to specific rigid settings to obtain good results, the Light Trail mode takes care of the essentials, letting your creativity soar!
LOW LIGHT: In low light conditions, this capture mode allows the camera to accumulate every photon of light hitting the sensor. The longer the shutter speed, the more light it will accumulate. You can even fine-tune the result using the exposure compensation slider to achieve the exact effect you want!
Highlights:
• Unlimited Shutter Speed and manual ISO
• Option to resume capture and create multiple exposure photos
• Real time live preview - See the result in real time
• Innovative 'Freeze' and ‘Blur Strength’ controls
• Tap to adjust focus/exposure
• Time-lapse Intervalometer
• Apple Watch support and handy Self-Timer 
• Full resolution support on every devices
• Camera Control support (iPhone 16)
With Slow Shutter Cam on your iPhone you get the features of a DSLR camera with the convenience of a device that you can drop in your pocket and take with you wherever you go. Download it now and put an end to mere snapshots!
Search #slowshuttercam on Instagram or visit the "Slow Shutter Cam - iPhone" group on flickr for amazing samples!

bluejetty:00028791:ios.summary:

Song
bluejetty:00028791:ios.description:
“All roads lead to our ‘Goodbye.’”
Boasting an epic soundtrack that can turn the world of gaming on its head, and some of the most stunning designs ever seen in a game, Bank of Innovation’s newest title, MementoMori, is finally here!
Songs performed by many renowned artists enhance the rich world of MementoMori.
*We recommend playing while wearing earphones or headphones.
◆ STORY:
A tale of “justice” woven by girls whose fragile hearts verge on shattering...
There are girls who many call “witches.”
Although they themselves are ordinary, they can wield slightly extraordinary powers.
However, when calamity spreads throughout the land, witches begin to be feared and detested.
Before long, the Church of Longinus commenced what would be known as “The Witch Hunt.”
“Witches are to blame for this calamity. If we kill them, then the calamity will vanish along with them!”
Witches are executed one by one.
But one day, as madness seizes control of the world, it is suddenly overrun by “Curses.”
A country incinerated by hellfire. A kingdom consumed by crystals. An empire purged by the Tree of Life.
Such are the woeful desires of those who are called “Witches of Qlipha.”
Without any means to defend themselves, nation after nation falls into ruin, until finally—
The fractured land is sent adrift high into the sky.
Meanwhile, the people have yet to take notice.
From within these girls cursed to be witches, there emanates glimmers of hope.
In order to save their decimated world, these girls set forth liberating the land from darkness.
For they believe that it is the right thing to do...
◆ GAME:
・Play utilizing both easy-to-use full auto-battles and high-level strategy!
・Behold stunning action-packed battles animated using Live2D!
・Harness the “Idle System” to gradually get stronger as the girls fight even while you’re away!
・Unlock tons of content as you advance the story!
・Discover infinite strategic possibilities by combining your wit with the girls’ magical powers!
・Enhance gear to precisely influence how the girls grow stronger!
・Communicate with your friends as you form the most powerful guild in the land!
◆ SOUND:
The girls of MementoMori are burdened with cruel pasts and inevitable fates.
・Cry to “Laments,” which sing each girl’s emotions to life.
・Play accompanied with a high-quality soundtrack not bound to the limits of game music.
The diversity of high-quality musical compositions heavily intertwines with the perilous world of MementoMori, providing a new and exciting gaming experience.
◆ CV/SONG:
Illya (CV Kana Hanazawa) (Song by Daoko)
Iris (CV Inori Minase) (Song by Hakubi)
Rosalie (CV Sumire Uesaka) (Song by Sayaka Yamamoto)
Soltina (CV Yoshino Nanjo) (Song by Koresawa)
Amleth (CV Atsumi Tanezaki) (Song by Atarayo)
Fenrir (CV Minami Takahashi) (Song by Kano)
Freesia (CV Yui Horie) (Song by Sonoko Inoue)
Belle (CV Yuu Asakawa) (Song by 96NEKO)
Luke (CV Ami Koshimizu) (Song by Ayaka Hirahara)
Carol (CV Hina Tachibana) (Song by kurokumo)
...and many more!
*The above is the Japanese cast for the game.
Voices can be changed from English to Japanese in the game’s settings.

- Can loop your favorite songs as you wish
- Cool user interface designs
- Easy backup your music to iCloud

- Private Space: Keep your secondary apps and data separate and secure.
- Fast Switching: Instantly switch between accounts with a single tap.

- Secure Access: Optional passcode or biometric lock for added privacy.
Download Parallel Accounts・Dual Space today and enjoy seamless control over multiple accounts on one device.

بكڕهو بفرۆشه تاكه بازاڕی ئۆنلاینه كه زۆرترین ئاسانكاری كردووه بۆ فرۆشتنی ئوتومبیلهكهت یان ههر كاڵایهكی تر. تهنها به یهك كلیك كاڵاكهت دابنێ و بیخه بهرچاوی سەدان ههزار كهس.
کاڵای دةستى دوو هەیەو نازانیت چی لێ بکەیت؟ لە بکڕەو بفرۆشە دایبنێ بۆ فرۆشتن.
بازرگانیت و دەتەوێت کاڵاکانت خەلک بیبینێت. لە بکڕەو بیفرۆشە دایبنێ زیاتر لە سەدان هەزار کەس دەیبینن.
کاتت نییە بچیتە بازاڕو ئوتومبیلەکەت بفرۆشیت؟ ئوتومبیلەکەت یان سەیارەکەت لە بکڕەو بفرۆشە دابنێ و زۆر لە بازاڕ زیاتر خەڵک دەیبینن.
ئێمە لێرە زۆرترین ئاسانکاریمان کردووەو بەردەوامیش نوێی دەکەینەوە بۆ ئەوەی هەرکەسێک ویستی زۆر بە ئاسانی کاڵاکانی بفرۆشێت.

Listen to around 900 radio stations from India. Live FM and online radio, Bollywood hits, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and Punjabi music, devotional songs, news, cricket, sports and podcasts. Free, no registration required.

LIVE RADIO
• Around 900 FM and online radio stations
• Search by name, genre or city
• Radio stations from neighbouring countries
• Podcasts and radio programmes

SONGS & PLAYLISTS
• Current song with title and cover art when available
• Recently played songs and station playlists
• Most played songs on each station
• Shazam song recognition and history

RADIO RECORDING
• Record live broadcasts with one tap
• Play, share or delete saved recordings

CARPLAY & AIRPLAY
• Apple CarPlay with station logos and song covers
• AirPlay to TVs and speakers
• Lock screen and headphone controls
• Sleep timer with countdown

PERSONALISATION
• Favourites with custom sorting
• Listening history
• Swipe to switch stations
• Station details: frequency, website and social media
• Light and dark themes

PREMIUM
Remove ads with a monthly or yearly subscription. Cancel anytime in App Store settings.

Internet connection required. Song information and some features depend on station support. Stations may be temporarily unavailable.

Privacy Policy: https://onlineindiaradio.com/privacy

 뺏고 뺏기는 치열한 전투! 천하통일의 주인공은 누구?
 든든한 세력원과 협동하여 천하를 쟁취하세요!
삼국지책략전 공식카페 : http://cafe.naver.com/samtactic
삼국지책략전 고객센터 : sam@potato-es.com
- 메일 문의 접수 시 아이디, 닉네임, 기기명, 발생일자, 발생현상을 기재하여 접수 바랍니다.
삼국지 책략전은 원활한 게임 플레이를 위해 아래의 권한을 필요로 하고있습니다.
- 기기 ID 및 통화 정보 : [필수] 기기 식별을 위한 권한
- 기기 및 앱 기록 : [필수] 게임 데이터 저장을 위한 권한
* 접근권한 철회방법
- 운영체제 6.0 이상 : 설정 > 어플리케이션 관리자 > 앱 선택 > 권한 > 접근권한 철회 선택
- 운영체제 6.0 미만 : 운영체제를 업그레이드하여 접근권한을 철회하거나 앱 삭제를 통해 철회
- 접근권한 철회 시 앱 중단 또는 게임 접속 불가 현상이 발생할 수 있습니다.

bluejetty:00128909:ios.summary:

Streets of Rage comes back for a seq
bluejetty:00128909:ios.description:
Punch your way through the Streets of Rage once again!
Streets of Rage 4 takes forward the Streets of Rage legacy in this retro beat'em up with hand-drawn comic inspired graphics and updated mechanics.
Streets of Rage comes back for a sequel 25 years after the last episode : a new crime syndicate seems to have taken control of the streets and corrupted the police. All you have to fight against them is your friends... and your fists ! Critically acclaimed, Streets of Rage 4 won several awards and nominated as Best Action Games at the 2020 Game Awards.
FEATURES
- Rediscover the classic Beat em up Streets of Rage Franchise with new fight mechanics
- Get thrilled by the Retro hand-drawn comics-inspired artistic direction by the studio behind Wonder Boy: The Dragon’s Trap serving juicy animations & vivid FX
- Unlock up to 5 new & emblematic playable characters and fight your way through 12 various stages to bring back order to the streets
- Challenge yourself in different modes : Story, Training, Arcade...
- Listen to a new Electro OST with world class musicians such as Olivier Derivière and legend Yuzo Koshiro
- Brand-new custom survival mode to the DLC (Mr. X Nightmare)
- New destroyables to help to maintain the combo counter"- Get retro with up to 13 alternative retro characters, secret retro levels or choose the SoR1&2 OST and enable the Retro Pixel graphics !
* NEW MAJOR FREE UPDATE*
- New co-op moves
- +300 in-game improvements
- Brand-new custom survival mode to the DLC (Mr. X Nightmare)
- New destroyables to help to maintain the combo counter
-MULTIPLAYER UPDATE-
- Play online with a partner and gang up to defeat the Y twins' evil plan together!
- Test your strength : hop in Battle Mode and fight your friends across your favorite levels"
-Mr. X Nightmare DLC-
The fight continues in Wood Oak City.
After the events of Streets of Rage 4, our heroes wanted to prepare themselves for future threats. Axel, Blaze and their mates will start a very special deranged training with the help of Dr. Zan, who built an AI program from the remnants of Mister X’s brain that simulates every kind of danger they could be facing. 
With this DLC, get ready for:
• 3 new playable characters
• A new Survival mode with weekly challenges
• Character customization: build your own fighting style with new moves
• New weapons and enemies!o note that multiplayer mode will not be available at launch but will come in a free update after release.
CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface
- Game Center achievements
- iCloud - Share your progress between iOS devices
- Compatible with MFicontrollers

Smack down the competition in this immersive wrestling simulation game. Step into the ring with a heavy-hitting roster of WWE Superstars and Legends.

bluejetty:00134583:ios.description:

Our camera produces photos that look more authentic than the stock iPhone camera. Enable portrait mode to allow you to add flash and depth blurring during edits. Capture with a preset or use random mode to get a uniquely generated edit.

bluejetty:00116331:ios.description:
Build Strength & Confidence with the 28-Day Calisthenics Mastery Plan for Men
Feeling unsure where to start with bodyweight training, or how to transform your physique and unlock raw, functional strength—no gym membership or equipment required? Introducing Calisthenics Workout, designed to help you master foundational movements, build lean muscle, and elevate your fitness—all from home.
Why This App is Your Ultimate Calisthenics Launchpad:
Whether you’re taking your first steps into fitness, reigniting a stalled routine, or craving a challenge that scales with your progress, this app is crafted for men of all fitness levels. Say goodbye to intimidation and hello to a structured, no-equipment plan that turns your body into your greatest gym.
Features Designed to Fuel Your Strength Journey:
28-Day Progressive Calisthenics Plan: Follow a day-by-day roadmap that starts with basics (push-ups, squats, planks) and evolves into advanced moves (pull-ups, dips, muscle-up prep). Each week builds strength and endurance, with rest days optimized for recovery.
Zero Equipment, Maximum Gains: Master bodyweight exercises that target every muscle group—chest, arms, core, legs, and back. Modify workouts to match your current ability, then ramp up difficulty as you grow stronger.
Step-by-Step Instructions: Get it right with HD video demos and audio cues that break down proper technique for every exercise, and common mistake alerts and tips to perfect your posture.
Flexible Workouts for Busy Schedules: Choose between 10-, 15-, 20- or 25-minute sessions. Squeeze in a workout during lunch breaks or after work.
Progress Tracking & Milestones: Log reps, track strength gains and weight loss. Earn badges to celebrate your consistency.
How It Works:
· Define Your Goals: Whether you aim to build muscle, lose weight, or simply enhance your overall fitness level, we have a plan that aligns with your objectives. 
· Select Your Focus Area - Choose to target specific areas like your chest, back, abs, legs, arms, or opt for full-body routines for a comprehensive workout.
· Personalize Your Experience: Input your age, height, weight, fitness level, and a brief overview of your lifestyle—we use this information solely to create your personalized plan.
· Receive Your Tailored Fitness Plan: Enjoy a unique workout plan that adapts in intensity to suit your fitness levels and lifestyle preferences.
· Track Your Fitness Journey with Ease: Log your weight and track your workout streaks, see your transformation along every step of the way.
Ready to Redefine Your Strength?
Stop scrolling through conflicting advice. This is your moment to build a physique that’s strong, agile, and unstoppable—no weights, just willpower. Download today and commit to the 28-day challenge. Your future self will thank you.
Start Now. No Equipment. No Limits.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Get a 7M Supporter subscription and enjoy full access to all features and content. The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before current period ends. You can go to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. If you subscribe before your free trial ends, the rest of your free trial period will be forfeited as soon as your purchase is confirmed.
Note: This app is developed for informational purposes only. You should always consult your physician or doctor before starting any new fitness program.
This app integrates with the Apple Health app.
Terms of use: https://www.workoutinc.net/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://www.workoutinc.net/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00183273:ios.description:
New York Times Cooking has thousands of quick recipes you’ll love to make, from easy weeknight dinners to holiday showstoppers. Editor-curated collections make it easy to find the right recipe, and helpful videos make them fun and simple to cook. With our digital Recipe Box, you can easily save favorites, plan a grocery list and organize the dishes you want to try. Each recipe in our collection is tested to make sure it’s accurate and delicious, every time. We publish new recipes and videos every day.
Subscribe to New York Times Cooking in the app, or if you’re already a subscriber, log in for unlimited access to our recipes and much more.
THE NYT COOKING APP INCLUDES:
DELICIOUS AND SIMPLE RECIPES
- Healthy, hearty, vegetarian or anything else: We have 30-minute dinner recipes for seamless meal planning.
- From morning muffins to desserts for a crowd, we have tried-and-true baking recipes for every occasion. 
- Our recipes include ratings, reviews and helpful tips from thousands of other home cooks.
COOKS YOU KNOW AND LOVE
- We have quick recipes and cooking videos from cooks you trust, including Samin Nosrat, Ina Garten and more.
- Plus, tips, tricks and demonstrations from our editors, including Melissa Clark and Eric Kim.
HELPFUL COOKING VIDEOS
- Follow step-by-step demonstrations and guides.
- Scroll through hundreds of short-form cooking videos to discover new recipes.
- Sit back and enjoy episodes of our longform shows, like Cooking 101 and The Veggie.
MEAL PREP MADE EASY
- Search our database of over 20,000 recipes by diet, cuisine, meal type and more.
- Save and organize the recipes you want to make each week in your Recipe Box.
- Add the ingredients to our built-in grocery list, or skip the hassle and order grocery delivery via Instacart.
EASY VIEWING WITH iPAD COMPATIBILITY
- Watch high-resolution cooking videos and photos on a larger screen.
- Keep multiple windows open for simpler cooking.
- Drag and drop simple recipes into folders in your Recipe Box.
BY DOWNLOADING THE NEW YORK TIMES COOKING APP, you agree to:
• The New York Times Privacy Policy: https://www.nytimes.com/privacy/privacy-policy
• The New York Times Cookie Policy: https://www.nytimes.com/privacy/cookie-policy
• The New York Times California Privacy Notices: https://www.nytimes.com/privacy/california-notice
• The New York Times Terms of Service: https://www.nytimes.com/content/help/rights/terms/terms-of-service.html

bluejetty:00161248:ios.summary:

Am Hazak brings Jewish prayer, the Hebrew calendar, Shabbat times and Torah learning into one thoughtfully designed app. Find th
bluejetty:00161248:ios.description:
Join more than 100,000 people in over 100 countries using Am Hazak for Jewish prayer, learning and daily life.
Am Hazak brings Jewish prayer, the Hebrew calendar, Shabbat times and Torah learning into one thoughtfully designed app. Find the prayers for today, check local zmanim, explore Jewish places nearby and keep your important dates and favorites organized.
• A Siddur that knows the day:
Today’s Prayers shows the prayers relevant to the day, helping you find what to say and when. Read Hebrew text with translations and choose your prayer tradition: Ashkenaz, Sefard or Edot HaMizrach.
• Prayers throughout the year:
Access daily services, blessings and Tehillim (Psalms), along with prayers for Shabbat, festivals, the High Holidays and Selichot. Keep the prayers you use regularly and those you need throughout the year within reach.
• Hebrew calendar and daily zmanim:
View Jewish dates, holidays and observances, and look ahead to what’s coming up. Check the daily times that guide prayer and observance, including sunrise, sunset and the times for Shema and Mincha.
• Shabbat times around the world:
Find candle lighting and Havdalah times for cities worldwide, for any week of the year. Save cities for home, family or travel, and follow a candle lighting countdown directly on your Lock Screen.
• Kosher restaurants and Jewish places nearby:
Find kosher restaurants, Chabad houses and mikvahs on an interactive map. Explore places near your current location or look around another destination before you travel.
• Daily and weekly learning:
Read the weekly parsha and haftarah, follow Daf Yomi for daily Talmud study, or explore every book of Tanach, the Hebrew Bible. Access Torah, Prophets and Writings, whether you’re following a regular study schedule or choosing a passage to read.
• Personal dates in your Hebrew calendar:
Use My Dates to add yahrzeits, Hebrew birthdays and anniversaries. Keep your family’s meaningful dates alongside Jewish holidays and observances, with your personal calendar dates saved to your account.
• Bookmarks and account sync:
Save prayers and passages you want to return to. Sign in to keep your bookmarks, saved Shabbat cities, personal dates and favorite restaurants in sync across your devices.
Prayers, translations, the Hebrew calendar, zmanim, Shabbat times, Daf Yomi, Tanach, Explore and My Dates are free to use.
Am Hazak Pro is an optional subscription that adds listening, transliterations and more saved Shabbat cities and bookmarks. Listen and follow along as each word is highlighted when spoken. Transliterations let you read the Hebrew in familiar letters.
Download Am Hazak and make prayer, learning and planning part of your day.
Am Hazak Pro renews automatically. Payment is charged to your Apple Account, and you can manage or cancel anytime in your Account Settings.

Terms of Service: https://www.amhazak.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.amhazak.com/privacy

bluejetty:00068714:ios.name: Cross Stitch Creator
bluejetty:00068714:ios.summary: Turn pictures of your favorite moments into beautiful cross stitch tapestries of almost any size! Cross Stitch Creator is an embroidery app that allows you to generate cross stitch patterns from pictures (or create them from scratch) and tr
bluejetty:00068714:ios.description:
Turn pictures of your favorite moments into beautiful cross stitch tapestries of almost any size! Cross Stitch Creator is an embroidery app that allows you to generate cross stitch patterns from pictures (or create them from scratch) and track your progress on them. You can also save patterns as PDFs to print or share with your friends! There are no subscriptions or in app purchases - after the initial app purchase you can create as many patterns and PDFs as you want.
Features:
• Generate cross stitch patterns from pictures or from scratch up to 800 x 800 stitches
• Use hundreds of different colors in a single pattern
• 489 different DMC thread colors to choose from
• Create your own color palettes to use for generating (such as colors you already own)
• Several generation parameters such as maximum number of colors allowed and dithering
• Track your progress on patterns (details below)
• Edit your patterns after generating to perfect them or build one from scratch (details below)
• See a preview of what your pattern will look like when it's fully stitched
• Print patterns from directly within the app
• Share patterns as PDFs via Email, iMessage, and more
• Help popups to guide you through using the app
Progress tracking:
• Colorize individual stitches to mark progress
• Quick and easy symbol/color lookup
• Lockable stitches
• Sortable key
• Pattern metadata such as size, date created, number of colors, percent complete...
Pattern editor:
• Clean up generated patterns or create patterns from scratch
• Tools include draw, erase, fill, and undo/redo
• Effects such as reducing the number of colors used, conforming to a given palette, and resizing/cropping
• Note: Only full stitches and backstitches are supported. Half stitches, quarter stitches, french knots, etc. are not.
Disclaimer:
Although we try our best, thread colors may not appear to be completely accurate. Perception of thread color depends on multiple factors including, but not limited to, display settings such as brightness and night shift, ambient light conditions, and neighboring colors in the pattern. Please use your best judgement in determining which colors to actually use when stitching the pattern.

apple-macos:6795891745.name: Calliary - Sticker Calendar
apple-macos:6795891745.description:
Decorate your calendar like a diary and share it with your partner, friends, or family.
Plan together on one calendar, and see it on your Home Screen widget exactly as you decorated it.
■ Turn your photos into stickers
Pick a photo and the background is removed automatically. It becomes a sticker with a white border. Put your favorite person, your dog, or today's dessert straight onto the calendar. No scissors, no glue.
■ One calendar, shared and decorated together
Share a whole calendar, not just a few events. Invite people with an invite code, and they add events to the same calendar in real time. Their stickers and plans appear right where they put them. The calendar's creator decides whether others can decorate it too. Create a calendar, invite people, and look at categories together.
■ Your decorated calendar, on your widgets
Widgets show your calendar exactly as you decorated it. Add a sticker and the widget changes too. There are eight widgets: Calliary Calendar, Text Calendar, Upcoming, One Page, Countdown, Countdown Counter, Cycle, and At a Glance. Calliary Calendar, Text Calendar, Upcoming, and One Page let you pick the calendar for each widget: your own or a shared calendar. Lock Screen widgets work on iPhone and iPad; StandBy widgets on iPhone.
■ A calendar and lined notes on one page
A lined MEMO section sits below the month grid on the same page. Add events to the grid and monthly plans to the lines below.
■ One diary page a day
Text and stickers together on one page. Write by hand on iPad with Apple Pencil, and see it on iPhone and Mac too. One sticker and a line are enough for a day.
■ Fonts and 6 themes
Use handwriting, sans serif, and serif fonts, or any font on your device. Six theme presets change your fonts and colors to match today's mood.
■ Cycle tracking
Log your period and Calliary predicts your next cycle, ovulation, and fertile window. Record mood, symptoms, contraception, and basal body temperature; insight charts show trends. It imports Health data and saves your logs to Health. If you like, share your current cycle with a partner.
Sensitive data, strict rules:
· No ads. Cycle data is never used for advertising or tracking.
· Lock Screen notifications can hide their wording. You choose what shows.
■ Small everyday features
· Weather on the grid, before you plan
· A checklist for everything due this month
· Countdowns for exams, trips, and anniversaries
· Repeating events, reminders, and medication alerts
· Lunar dates and public holidays for 49 countries
· Categories like school, work, and home, so you see just what you need
· Import from Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, or .ics files
· Face ID or Touch ID to lock the app
■ Share your month as an image
Save your month as an image and share it anywhere. An Instagram Story preset is built in.
■ iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch
Calliary syncs through iCloud. Stickers you place on iPhone appear on iPad and Mac, and today's plans show up on your wrist.
■ 19 languages
Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, and more, with sticker search in each language.
■ Decorating tools
Fill your calendar, MEMO, and diary with stickers, notes, photos, and drawings. Create your own calendar theme, and pick icon sets and fonts to make it yours. Save your finished calendar as an image without the Calliary mark, or export it as a PDF. On iPad, write your diary with Apple Pencil.
Some decorating tools are available with Calliary Pro. Choose a monthly or yearly subscription, or pay once for a lifetime pass. All of them support Family Sharing.
■ Calliary is for you if…
· you want a decorated calendar you'll keep using for years
· you'd like to plan and decorate with your partner or friends
· you love decorating your calendar with stickers
Start by putting one sticker on today's date.

apple-macos:6755721145.description:
Language readers for English, Spanish, French, German and Italian: read real books at your level and tap any word to see its translation right above it.
ReadLingua turns reading into language practice. Pick a graded reader from A1 to C1, a classic novel or a short story, tap an unfamiliar word or a whole phrase, and keep reading. Every word you translate goes to your vocabulary, so you can review it later with flashcards and quick games.
WHAT YOU CAN READ
• Language readers by level, A1 to C1: easy stories, classics and full-length books in English, Spanish, French, German and Italian
• Fresh articles picked for you from international news sites
• Any website in the language you are learning: news, blogs, forums, encyclopedias
• Audiobooks
• Your own EPUB books (Premium)
HOW IT WORKS
• Tap a word to translate it in place, without leaving the page
• Tap the first and last word of a phrase to translate the whole phrase at once
• Translation runs on your device when the language pack is downloaded
• Translated words are saved to your vocabulary: flashcards, a multiple-choice quiz and the Meteor Words game
• Reading statistics show your progress day by day
WHY LANGUAGE READERS WORK
A graded language reader lets you finish a whole book at a level you can follow. You meet new words in context, see them again in the next chapter and remember them without drilling lists. Start with easy language readers and move up as reading gets comfortable.
FREE AND PREMIUM
• Free: 30 translations a day, the whole library of books and websites, basic reading statistics
• Premium: unlimited translations, longer phrases, your own EPUB books and the multiple-choice vocabulary quiz
SUBSCRIPTION
Premium is available as an auto-renewable monthly or yearly subscription. Prices may vary by location and are shown in the app before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple Account settings.

TYPESET LIKE A PUBLISHER
• Running heads and page numbers in the right places
• Chapters that open on right-hand pages, with drop caps or small-caps first lines
• Widow and orphan control, so no lonely lines at the top of a page
• Title page, copyright page and table of contents generated for you
• Margins that grow with your page count, as print-on-demand printers require
47 TEMPLATES, THEN MAKE IT YOURS
Browse templates as real typeset pages — classic and literary fiction, thriller, mystery, romance, fantasy, sci-fi, horror, nonfiction, business, self-help, cookbook, poetry, children's, workbooks, journals, large print and more — then change anything:

• Indented or spaced paragraphs, chapter number styles, alignment and sink depth
• 40 decorative ornaments — squiggles, stars, flourishes, laurels, rules — above or below chapter titles or as scene breaks
• Running head and page number styles, text and accent colors
• Custom CSS for complete control
